/* DEV-only private identity controls. Public callers never access this store.
 * All operations run under the installation ScriptLock in processRequest_. */

  version: 3,
  tables: [
    { name: '_Control_Migrations', columns: ['Version', 'Schema_Hash', 'Created_At', 'Backup_Drive_ID'] },

function authControlDefinition_(name) {
  var found = AUTH_CONTROL_SCHEMA.tables.filter(function (table) { return table.name === name; });
  if (found.length !== 1) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
  return found[0];
}
function authControlTime_(value) {
  try { return identityTime_(value); } catch (_) { failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE'); }
}
function authControlShape_(ss, name) {
  var definition = authControlDefinition_(name), sheet = rpcSheet_(ss, name), lastRow = sheet ? sheet.getLastRow() : 0;
  if (!sheet || !same_(rowValues_(sheet, lastRow), definition.columns) || lastRow > 3001) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
  return { sheet: sheet, definition: definition, lastRow: lastRow };
}
function authControlRows_(ss, name) {
  var shape = authControlShape_(ss, name), definition = shape.definition, sheet = shape.sheet;
  var values = rpcRows_(sheet, shape.lastRow, definition.columns.length);
  return { sheet: sheet, columns: definition.columns, rows: values.map(function (values, index) {
    var row = { number: index + 2 };
    definition.columns.forEach(function (key, i) { row[key] = values[i]; }); return row;
  }) };
}
function authControlInstalled_(ss) {
  var history = authControlRows_(ss, '_Control_Migrations'), seen = new Set(), latest = 0;
  // Frozen hashes of approved historical schemas; never derive from mutable current definitions.
  var legacy = '357da73009e9d28b09650f78dbc8c59b2114ee13f23dbe5b6a2a6334b11d75f2';
  var v2 = '64f663ff15c59f2185c10ebd685ae9fbd15c088aecb60b1975fd0486a217de6c';
  history.rows.forEach(function (row) {
    if (![1, 2, 3].includes(row.Version) || seen.has(row.Version) || row.Version <= latest ||
        row.Schema_Hash !== (row.Version === 1 ? legacy : row.Version === 2 ? v2 : digest_(JSON.stringify(AUTH_CONTROL_SCHEMA)))) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    seen.add(row.Version); latest = row.Version;
  });
  return latest;
}
function authControlStore_(c) {
  if (c.environment !== 'dev') failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  storage_(c, false); // Validate public-data bindings as well as the private store.
  var id = scriptProperties_().getProperty('IDENTITY_CONTROL_SPREADSHEET_ID');
  if (!id) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
  var cacheKey = JSON.stringify([c.environment, c.installationId, c.spreadsheetId, c.driveRootId, id]);
  if (RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_ && RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.controls[cacheKey]) return RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.controls[cacheKey];
  assertMarker_(resourceFile_(id), c, 'identity-controls');
  var ss = resourceSheet_(id);
  primeSchemaHeaders_(ss,AUTH_CONTROL_SCHEMA.tables);
  if (authControlInstalled_(ss) !== 3) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
  // Migration rows were already validated; remaining store checks need headers and capacity only.
  AUTH_CONTROL_SCHEMA.tables.forEach(function (table) { if (table.name !== '_Control_Migrations') authControlShape_(ss, table.name); });
  if (RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_) RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.controls[cacheKey] = ss;
  return ss;
}
function provisionDevelopmentAuthControls() {
  var c = baseSettings_(); requireOwnerDev_(c);
  return withLock_(function () {
    var store = storage_(c, true); assertSchema_(store.spreadsheet);
    var props = scriptProperties_(), id = props.getProperty('IDENTITY_CONTROL_SPREADSHEET_ID');
    if (!id) {
      var created = SpreadsheetApp.create('Livraria DEV private controls ' + c.installationId);
      var file = resourceFile_(created.getId()); file.setDescription(marker_(c, 'identity-controls'));
      file.moveTo(resourceFolder_(c.driveRootId)); id = created.getId();
      props.setProperty('IDENTITY_CONTROL_SPREADSHEET_ID', id);
    }
    var resource = resourceFile_(id); assertMarker_(resource, c, 'identity-controls');
    var ss = resourceSheet_(id);
    AUTH_CONTROL_SCHEMA.tables.forEach(function (table) {
      var sheet = ss.getSheetByName(table.name);
      if (sheet && sheet.getLastRow() && !same_(rowValues_(sheet), table.columns)) failure_('SCHEMA_CONFLICT');
    });
    var history = ss.getSheetByName('_Control_Migrations');
    var installed = history && history.getLastRow() > 1 ? authControlInstalled_(ss) : 0;
    if (installed === 3) { authControlStore_(c); return { environment: 'dev', version: 3, changed: false }; }
    // Each initial/resumed migration backs up BEFORE any header mutation.
    var backup = resource.makeCopy('DEV controls before v3 ' + new Date().toISOString(), store.backup);
    AUTH_CONTROL_SCHEMA.tables.forEach(function (table) {
      var sheet = ss.getSheetByName(table.name) || ss.insertSheet(table.name);
      if (!sheet.getLastRow()) sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, table.columns.length).setValues([table.columns]);
      sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
      table.columns.forEach(function (column, index) {
        if (!['Version', 'Attempt_Count', 'Penalty_Level', 'Authorization_Version', 'Counter', 'Expected_Counter'].includes(column)) {
          sheet.getRange(2, index + 1, Math.max(1, sheet.getMaxRows() - 1), 1).setNumberFormat('@');
        }
      });
    });
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    ss.getSheetByName('_Control_Migrations').appendRow([3, digest_(JSON.stringify(AUTH_CONTROL_SCHEMA)), new Date().toISOString(), backup.getId()]);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush(); authControlStore_(c);
    return { environment: 'dev', version: 3, changed: true };
  });
}
function authControlExact_(payload, keys) {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object' || Array.isArray(payload) || !same_(Object.keys(payload).sort(), keys.slice().sort())) failure_('CHALLENGE_REJECTED');
}
function authControlSave_(table, row) {
  invalidateRpcRows_(table.sheet);
  var values = table.columns.map(function (key) { return row[key]; });
  if (row.number) table.sheet.getRange(row.number, 1, 1, values.length).setValues([values]);
  else {
    if (table.rows.length >= 3000) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    table.sheet.appendRow(values);
  }
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
}
function authAttempt_(ss, payload, now) {
  authControlExact_(payload, ['accountKey', 'originKey']);
  if (![payload.accountKey, payload.originKey].every(function (key) { return typeof key === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(key); })) failure_('CHALLENGE_REJECTED');
  var table = authControlRows_(ss, '_Auth_Limits'), seen = new Set();
  table.rows.forEach(function (row) {
    if (typeof row.Key !== 'string' || !/^(account|origin):[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(row.Key) || seen.has(row.Key)) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    seen.add(row.Key);
  });
  var retry = 0, plans = [ ['account:' + payload.accountKey, 5], ['origin:' + payload.originKey, 30] ].map(function (policy) {
    var matches = table.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.Key === policy[0]; });
    var row = matches.length ? matches[0] : { Key: policy[0], Window_Start: new Date(now).toISOString(), Attempt_Count: 0, Blocked_Until: '', Penalty_Level: 0, Updated_At: new Date(now).toISOString() };
    var before=matches.length?table.columns.map(function(k){return row[k];}):null;
    var start = authControlTime_(row.Window_Start), updated = authControlTime_(row.Updated_At);
    var until = row.Blocked_Until === '' ? 0 : authControlTime_(row.Blocked_Until);
    if (start > now || updated > now || updated < start || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.Attempt_Count) || row.Attempt_Count < 0 || row.Attempt_Count > policy[1] + 1 ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(row.Penalty_Level) || row.Penalty_Level < 0 || row.Penalty_Level > 7 || until > now + 3600000) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    if (until > now) retry = Math.max(retry, Math.ceil((until - now) / 1000));
    if (now - updated >= 86400000) row.Penalty_Level = 0;
    if ((until && until <= now) || now - start >= 900000) { row.Window_Start = new Date(now).toISOString(); row.Attempt_Count = 0; row.Blocked_Until = ''; }
    return { row: row, maximum: policy[1],before:before };
  });
  if (retry) return { allowed: false, retryAfterSeconds: retry };
  if (table.rows.length + plans.filter(function (plan) { return !plan.row.number; }).length > 3000) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
  plans.forEach(function (plan) {
    var row = plan.row; row.Attempt_Count++; row.Updated_At = new Date(now).toISOString();
    if (row.Attempt_Count > plan.maximum) {
      row.Penalty_Level = Math.min(7, row.Penalty_Level + 1);
      var delay = Math.min(3600, 60 * Math.pow(2, row.Penalty_Level - 1));
      row.Blocked_Until = new Date(now + delay * 1000).toISOString(); retry = Math.max(retry, delay);
    }
  });
  // A partial write fails closed; retry can spend another attempt, never grant one.
  if(retry)securityBlock_(ss,plans,baseSettings_(),now,retry);else plans.forEach(function (plan) { authControlSave_(table, plan.row); });
  return { allowed: retry === 0, retryAfterSeconds: retry };
}
function authSubjectCurrent_(c, subjectId, version, purpose) {
  var ss = storage_(c, false).spreadsheet;
  var users = identityRows_(ss, 'Usuarios').rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Usuario === subjectId; });
  var epochs = identityRows_(ss, 'Configuracoes').rows.filter(function (row) { return row.Chave === 'identity.version.' + subjectId; });
  if (users.length !== 1 || epochs.length !== 1 || users[0].Status !== 'ATIVO' || !['ATENDENTE', 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(users[0].Perfil) ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(epochs[0].Valor) || epochs[0].Valor !== version ||
      users[0].Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido !== (purpose !== 'ACTIVATE')) return false;
  return true;
}
function authChallengeOperation_(ss, c, action, payload, now) {
  var keys = ['challengeId', 'subjectId', 'purpose', 'tokenHash', 'authorizationVersion'];
  authControlExact_(payload, keys);
  if (!identityUuid_(payload.challengeId) || !identityUuid_(payload.subjectId) || !['ACTIVATE', 'RECOVER', 'DEVICE'].includes(payload.purpose) ||
      typeof payload.tokenHash !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(payload.tokenHash) ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(payload.authorizationVersion) || payload.authorizationVersion < 1) failure_('CHALLENGE_REJECTED');
  var table = authControlRows_(ss, '_Auth_Challenges'), seen = new Set(), hashes = new Set();
  table.rows.forEach(function (row) {
    if (!identityUuid_(row.ID) || !identityUuid_(row.Subject_ID) || typeof row.Token_Hash !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(row.Token_Hash) ||
        !['ACTIVATE', 'RECOVER', 'DEVICE'].includes(row.Purpose) || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.Authorization_Version) || row.Authorization_Version < 1 ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(row.Attempt_Count) || row.Attempt_Count < 0 || row.Attempt_Count > 5 || seen.has(row.ID) || hashes.has(row.Token_Hash)) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    var created = authControlTime_(row.Created_At), expires = authControlTime_(row.Expires_At);
    if (created > now || expires <= created || expires - created > 600000) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    seen.add(row.ID); hashes.add(row.Token_Hash);
  });
  var matches = table.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID === payload.challengeId; });
  var current = authSubjectCurrent_(c, payload.subjectId, payload.authorizationVersion, payload.purpose);
  if (action === 'identity.challenge.create') {
    if (!current) failure_('CHALLENGE_REJECTED');
    if (matches.length) {
      var prior = matches[0];
      if (prior.Subject_ID !== payload.subjectId || prior.Purpose !== payload.purpose || !constantEqual_(prior.Token_Hash, payload.tokenHash) ||
          prior.Authorization_Version !== payload.authorizationVersion || prior.Consumed_At !== '' || prior.Revoked_At !== '' || Date.parse(prior.Expires_At) <= now) failure_('CHALLENGE_REJECTED');
      return { challengeId: prior.ID, expiresAt: Date.parse(prior.Expires_At) };
    }
    if (hashes.has(payload.tokenHash) || table.rows.length >= 3000) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    // Reissue invalidates the prior code before appending the new one.
    table.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.Subject_ID === payload.subjectId && row.Purpose === payload.purpose && row.Consumed_At === '' && row.Revoked_At === ''; }).forEach(function (row) {
      row.Revoked_At = new Date(now).toISOString(); authControlSave_(table, row);
    });
    authControlSave_(table, { ID: payload.challengeId, Subject_ID: payload.subjectId, Purpose: payload.purpose,
      Token_Hash: payload.tokenHash, Created_At: new Date(now).toISOString(), Expires_At: new Date(now + 600000).toISOString(),
      Consumed_At: '', Attempt_Count: 0, Authorization_Version: payload.authorizationVersion, Revoked_At: '' });
    return { challengeId: payload.challengeId, expiresAt: now + 600000 };
  }
  if (!matches.length) return { verified: false };
  var row = matches[0];
  if (row.Consumed_At !== '' || row.Revoked_At !== '' || Date.parse(row.Expires_At) <= now || row.Attempt_Count >= 5) return { verified: false };
  row.Attempt_Count++;
  var valid = current && row.Subject_ID === payload.subjectId && row.Purpose === payload.purpose && row.Authorization_Version === payload.authorizationVersion && constantEqual_(row.Token_Hash, payload.tokenHash);
  if (valid) row.Consumed_At = new Date(now).toISOString();
  else if (row.Attempt_Count >= 5) row.Revoked_At = new Date(now).toISOString();
  authControlSave_(table, row);
  return { verified: valid };
}
function authControlOperation_(request, c) {
  if (c.environment !== 'dev') failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  if (!['identity.guard.attempt', 'identity.challenge.create', 'identity.challenge.consume'].includes(request.action)) failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  recoverSecurityIntent_(c);var ss = authControlStore_(c), now = Date.now();
  return request.action === 'identity.guard.attempt' ? authAttempt_(ss, request.payload, now) : authChallengeOperation_(ss, c, request.action, request.payload, now);
}

;
// END AuthControl.gs

// BEGIN Catalog.gs sha256=0cc52d969869d564da8e3a79de5b7d69562c523a044b0c203d0b0f3d56023422
/* Authenticated DEV catalog, positive stock receipts and admin-only removal.
 * Dispatcher owns the installation lock; durable intent precedes projections. */
var CATALOG_COLUMNS = ['Command_ID', 'Actor_ID', 'Actor_Role', 'Product_ID', 'Expected_Version', 'Command_Hash', 'Before_JSON', 'After_JSON', 'Created_At', 'State', 'Completed_At', 'Record_Hash'];
function catalogFail_(code) { failure_(code || 'CATALOG_INVALID'); }
function catalogJournalHash_(row) { return digest_(JSON.stringify(CATALOG_COLUMNS.filter(function (key) { return key !== 'Record_Hash'; }).map(function (key) { return row[key]; }))); }
function catalogJournal_(c) {
  var id = scriptProperties_().getProperty('CATALOG_JOURNAL_ID');
  if (!id) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  assertMarker_(resourceFile_(id), c, 'catalog-journal');
  var sheet = resourceSheet_(id).getSheetByName('_Product_Commands');
  if (!sheet || !same_(rowValues_(sheet), CATALOG_COLUMNS) || sheet.getLastRow() > 1001) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  var values = sheet.getLastRow() < 2 ? [] : sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, CATALOG_COLUMNS.length).getValues();
  var ids = new Set();
  return { sheet: sheet, columns: CATALOG_COLUMNS, rows: values.map(function (values, index) {
    var row = { number: index + 2 }; CATALOG_COLUMNS.forEach(function (key, i) { row[key] = values[i]; });
    if (!identityUuid_(row.Command_ID) || ids.has(row.Command_ID) || !identityUuid_(row.Actor_ID) || !['SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'ATENDENTE'].includes(row.Actor_Role) || !identityUuid_(row.Product_ID) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(row.Expected_Version) || row.Expected_Version < 0 || !accessHash_(row.Command_Hash) ||
        !['PENDING', 'COMPLETE'].includes(row.State) || typeof row.Before_JSON !== 'string' || typeof row.After_JSON !== 'string') catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
    authControlTime_(row.Created_At); if (row.State === 'COMPLETE') authControlTime_(row.Completed_At);
    if (row.State === 'PENDING' && row.Completed_At !== '' || !accessHash_(row.Record_Hash) || !constantEqual_(catalogJournalHash_(row), row.Record_Hash)) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
    ids.add(row.Command_ID); return row;
  }) };
}
function provisionDevelopmentCatalog() {
  var c = baseSettings_(); requireOwnerDev_(c);
  return withLock_(function () {
    var store = storage_(c, true); assertSchema_(store.spreadsheet);
    var props = scriptProperties_(), owner = props.getProperty('IDENTITY_OWNER_USER_ID');
    if (!identityUuid_(owner)) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    var id = props.getProperty('CATALOG_JOURNAL_ID');
    if (!id) {
      var created = SpreadsheetApp.create('Livraria DEV catalog journal ' + c.installationId), file = resourceFile_(created.getId());
      file.setDescription(marker_(c, 'catalog-journal')); file.moveTo(resourceFolder_(c.driveRootId));
      id = created.getId(); props.setProperty('CATALOG_JOURNAL_ID', id);
    }
    var resource = resourceFile_(id); assertMarker_(resource, c, 'catalog-journal');
    var journal = resourceSheet_(id), sheet = journal.getSheetByName('_Product_Commands');
    if (sheet && sheet.getLastRow() && !same_(rowValues_(sheet), CATALOG_COLUMNS)) failure_('SCHEMA_CONFLICT');
    if (!sheet || !sheet.getLastRow()) {
      resource.makeCopy('DEV catalog before v1 ' + new Date().toISOString(), store.backup);
      sheet = sheet || journal.insertSheet('_Product_Commands'); sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, CATALOG_COLUMNS.length).setValues([CATALOG_COLUMNS]); sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
      CATALOG_COLUMNS.forEach(function (key, index) { if (key !== 'Expected_Version') sheet.getRange(2, index + 1, Math.max(1, sheet.getMaxRows() - 1), 1).setNumberFormat('@'); });
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }
    catalogJournal_(c);
    var niches = identityRows_(store.spreadsheet, 'Nichos');
    if (!niches.rows.length) accessSaveMain_(niches, { ID_Nicho: Utilities.getUuid(), Nome: 'Geral', Descricao: '', Cor_Destaque: '#205b43', Ordem_Exibicao: 0, Ativo: true, Criado_Por: owner, Criado_Em: new Date().toISOString() });
    return { environment: 'dev', prepared: true };
  });
}
function catalogText_(value, max, required) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > max || value !== value.trim() || required && !value || /[\x00-\x08\x0b-\x1f\x7f]/.test(value) || /^[=+@-]/.test(value)) catalogFail_();
}
function catalogRecord_(p) {
  authControlExact_(p, ['isbn', 'internalCode', 'title', 'author', 'publisher', 'edition', 'supplier', 'priceCents', 'minimumStock', 'category', 'coverUrl', 'year', 'pages', 'synopsis', 'nicheIds', 'active']);
  [['isbn', 13], ['internalCode', 31], ['title', 300], ['author', 300], ['publisher', 160], ['edition', 80], ['supplier', 160], ['category', 80], ['coverUrl', 2000], ['synopsis', 5000]].forEach(function (pair) { catalogText_(p[pair[0]], pair[1], pair[0] === 'title'); });
  if (p.isbn ? !/^(978|979)\d{10}$/.test(p.isbn) || p.internalCode !== '' || p.isbn.split('').reduce(function (sum, n, i) { return sum + Number(n) * (i % 2 ? 3 : 1); }, 0) % 10 !== 0 : !/^INT[A-Z0-9]{6,28}$/.test(p.internalCode)) catalogFail_();
  [['priceCents', 100000000], ['minimumStock', 1000000], ['year', 3000], ['pages', 100000]].forEach(function (pair) { if (!Number.isSafeInteger(p[pair[0]]) || p[pair[0]] < 0 || p[pair[0]] > pair[1]) catalogFail_(); });
  if (p.year && p.year < 1000 || typeof p.active !== 'boolean' || !Array.isArray(p.nicheIds) || !p.nicheIds.length || p.nicheIds.length > 20 ||
      p.nicheIds.some(function (id) { return !identityUuid_(id); }) || new Set(p.nicheIds).size !== p.nicheIds.length || !same_(p.nicheIds, p.nicheIds.slice().sort())) catalogFail_();
  if (p.coverUrl) {
    var match = /^https:\/\/([^/?#]+)(\/[^#]*)?$/.exec(p.coverUrl), host = match && match[1];
    if (!host || host.indexOf('.') < 0 || /[^a-z0-9.-]/.test(host) || host.endsWith('.') || /^[\d.]+$/.test(host) || /(?:^|\.)(?:localhost|local|internal|invalid|test)$/.test(host)) catalogFail_();
  }
  var canonical = {}; ['isbn', 'internalCode', 'title', 'author', 'publisher', 'edition', 'supplier', 'priceCents', 'minimumStock', 'category', 'coverUrl', 'year', 'pages', 'synopsis', 'nicheIds', 'active'].forEach(function (key) { canonical[key] = p[key]; }); return canonical;
}
function catalogProducts_(ss) {
  var table = identityRows_(ss, 'Produtos'), ids = new Set(), barcodes = new Set(), internal = new Set();
  table.rows.forEach(function (row) {
    if (!identityUuid_(row.ID_Produto) || ids.has(row.ID_Produto) || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.Versao_Registro) || row.Versao_Registro < 1 ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(row.Estoque_Atual) || row.Estoque_Atual < 0 || typeof row.Ativo !== 'boolean') catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
    ids.add(row.ID_Produto);
    if (row.Ativo) {
      if (row.ISBN && barcodes.has(row.ISBN) || row.Codigo_Interno && internal.has(row.Codigo_Interno)) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
      if (row.ISBN) barcodes.add(row.ISBN); if (row.Codigo_Interno) internal.add(row.Codigo_Interno);
    }
  }); return table;
}
function catalogNiches_(ss) {
  var table = identityRows_(ss, 'Nichos'), ids = new Set();
  if (table.rows.length > 200) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  table.rows.forEach(function (row) {
    if (!identityUuid_(row.ID_Nicho) || ids.has(row.ID_Nicho) || typeof row.Ativo !== 'boolean' || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.Ordem_Exibicao) || row.Ordem_Exibicao < 0 || !/^#[a-fA-F0-9]{6}$/.test(row.Cor_Destaque)) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
    catalogText_(row.Nome, 100, true); ids.add(row.ID_Nicho);
  }); return table;
}
function catalogLinks_(ss) {
  var table = identityRows_(ss, 'Produto_Nichos'), seen = new Set();
  table.rows.forEach(function (row) {
    if (row.ID_Produto === '' && row.ID_Nicho === '') return;
    var key = row.ID_Produto + ':' + row.ID_Nicho;
    if (!identityUuid_(row.ID_Produto) || !identityUuid_(row.ID_Nicho) || seen.has(key)) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE'); seen.add(key);
  }); return table;
}
function catalogLinkIds_(table, id) { return table.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto === id; }).map(function (row) { return row.ID_Nicho; }).sort(); }
function catalogReferences_(products, links, niches) {
  var ids = new Set(products.rows.map(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto; })), targets = new Set(niches.rows.map(function (row) { return row.ID_Nicho; }));
  links.rows.forEach(function (row) { if (row.ID_Produto !== '' && (!ids.has(row.ID_Produto) || !targets.has(row.ID_Nicho))) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE'); });
}
function catalogDto_(row, links, detailed) {
  var p = { id: row.ID_Produto, isbn: row.ISBN, internalCode: row.Codigo_Interno, title: row.Titulo, author: row.Autor, publisher: row.Editora, edition: row.Edicao,
    priceCents: row.Preco_Venda, minimumStock: row.Estoque_Minimo, category: row.Categoria, coverUrl: row.Capa_URL_Externa, year: row.Ano_Publicacao,
    pages: row.Paginas, nicheIds: catalogLinkIds_(links, row.ID_Produto), active: row.Ativo, stock: row.Estoque_Atual, version: row.Versao_Registro, updatedAt: row.Atualizado_Em,hasPhoto:row.Capa_Drive_ID !== '' };
  if (detailed) { p.supplier = row.Fornecedor; p.synopsis = row.Sinopse; } return p;
}
function catalogSnapshot_(table, row, links) { return row ? { values: table.columns.map(function (key) { return row[key]; }), nicheIds: catalogLinkIds_(links, row.ID_Produto) } : null; }
function catalogValidateSnapshot_(snapshot, columns, id) {
  if (!snapshot || !Array.isArray(snapshot.values) || snapshot.values.length !== columns.length || snapshot.values[0] !== id || !Array.isArray(snapshot.nicheIds)) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  var row = {}; columns.forEach(function (key, i) { row[key] = snapshot.values[i]; });
  var dto = catalogDto_(row, { rows: snapshot.nicheIds.map(function (niche) { return { ID_Produto: id, ID_Nicho: niche }; }) }, true);
  var record = {}; ['isbn', 'internalCode', 'title', 'author', 'publisher', 'edition', 'supplier', 'priceCents', 'minimumStock', 'category', 'coverUrl', 'year', 'pages', 'synopsis', 'nicheIds', 'active'].forEach(function (key) { record[key] = dto[key]; }); catalogRecord_(record);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(row.Estoque_Atual) || row.Estoque_Atual < 0 || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.Versao_Registro) || row.Versao_Registro < 1) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  return row;
}
// Validate an intent independently of its current projection. Inventory replay
// uses completed metadata intents as stock-preserving version checkpoints.
function catalogIntent_(c, command, columns) {
  var before, after;
  try { before = JSON.parse(command.Before_JSON); after = JSON.parse(command.After_JSON); } catch (_) { catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE'); }
  if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(after,'auditVersion')&&after.auditVersion!==2)catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  var desired = catalogValidateSnapshot_(after, columns, command.Product_ID);
  if (before !== null) catalogValidateSnapshot_(before, columns, command.Product_ID);
  if (desired.Versao_Registro !== command.Expected_Version + 1 || before === null && command.Expected_Version !== 0 || before && before.values[columns.indexOf('Versao_Registro')] !== command.Expected_Version) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  var record = catalogDto_(desired, { rows: after.nicheIds.map(function (id) { return { ID_Produto: command.Product_ID, ID_Nicho: id }; }) }, true);
  delete record.id; delete record.stock; delete record.version; delete record.updatedAt; delete record.hasPhoto;
  record = catalogRecord_(record);
  var canonical = { commandId: command.Command_ID, id: command.Product_ID, expectedVersion: command.Expected_Version, record: record };
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(after,'photoHash')) {
    if (after.photoHash !== 'REMOVE' && !accessHash_(after.photoHash)) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
    canonical.photoHash = after.photoHash;
    if (after.photoHash === 'REMOVE') { if (desired.Capa_Drive_ID !== '') catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE'); }
    else { var file = coverFile_(c,desired.Capa_Drive_ID,command.Product_ID,after.photoHash,false); if (file.marker.commandId !== command.Command_ID || desired.Capa_URL_Externa !== '') catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE'); }
  }
  if (digest_(JSON.stringify(canonical)) !== command.Command_Hash ||
      desired.Atualizado_Em !== command.Created_At || desired.Atualizado_Por !== command.Actor_ID ||
      before === null && (desired.Estoque_Atual !== 0 || desired.Criado_Em !== command.Created_At || desired.Criado_Por !== command.Actor_ID) ||
      before && ['Estoque_Atual', 'Criado_Em', 'Criado_Por'].some(function (key) { return before.values[columns.indexOf(key)] !== desired[key]; }) ||
      !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(after,'photoHash') && desired.Capa_Drive_ID !== (before ? before.values[columns.indexOf('Capa_Drive_ID')] : '')) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  return { before: before, after: after, desired: desired };
}
function catalogAuditSummary_(snapshot,columns,version){
 if(!snapshot)return {version:version};var at=function(k){return snapshot.values[columns.indexOf(k)];};
 return {version:version,isbn:at('ISBN'),internalCode:at('Codigo_Interno'),title:at('Titulo'),author:at('Autor'),publisher:at('Editora'),edition:at('Edicao'),supplier:at('Fornecedor'),priceCents:at('Preco_Venda'),minimumStock:at('Estoque_Minimo'),category:at('Categoria'),year:at('Ano_Publicacao'),pages:at('Paginas'),stock:at('Estoque_Atual'),active:at('Ativo'),nicheIds:snapshot.nicheIds,hasPhoto:!!at('Capa_Drive_ID'),hasExternalCover:!!at('Capa_URL_Externa')};
}
function catalogProject_(c, command) {
  var ss = storage_(c, false).spreadsheet, products = catalogProducts_(ss), links = catalogLinks_(ss);
  catalogReferences_(products, links, catalogNiches_(ss));
  var intent = catalogIntent_(c, command, products.columns), before = intent.before, after = intent.after, desired = intent.desired;
  var found = products.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto === command.Product_ID; }), actual = found.length ? catalogSnapshot_(products, found[0], links) : null;
  if (actual && !same_(actual.values, after.values) && (!before || !same_(actual.values, before.values)) || !actual && before) catalogFail_('CATALOG_CONFLICT');
  var allowed = (before ? before.nicheIds : []).concat(after.nicheIds);
  if (catalogLinkIds_(links, command.Product_ID).some(function (id) { return allowed.indexOf(id) < 0; })) catalogFail_('CATALOG_CONFLICT');
  // Recheck duplicates before restoring a partially applied product.
  if (desired.Ativo && products.rows.some(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto !== command.Product_ID && row.Ativo && (desired.ISBN && row.ISBN === desired.ISBN || desired.Codigo_Interno && row.Codigo_Interno === desired.Codigo_Interno); })) catalogFail_('CATALOG_DUPLICATE');
  var audit = identityRows_(ss, 'Logs_Auditoria'), logged = audit.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Log === command.Command_ID; });
  var log = { ID_Log: command.Command_ID, Data_Hora: command.Created_At, ID_Usuario: command.Actor_ID, Perfil: command.Actor_Role, Acao: before ? 'PRODUCT_UPDATE' : 'PRODUCT_CREATE', Entidade: 'Produtos', ID_Entidade: command.Product_ID,
    Antes: JSON.stringify({ version: command.Expected_Version }), Depois: JSON.stringify({ version: command.Expected_Version + 1 }), Resultado: 'SUCESSO', ID_Requisicao: command.Command_ID };
  if(after.auditVersion===2){var oldSummary=catalogAuditSummary_(before,products.columns,command.Expected_Version),newSummary=catalogAuditSummary_(after,products.columns,command.Expected_Version+1),oldAt=function(k){return before?before.values[products.columns.indexOf(k)]:'';};newSummary.coverChanged=oldAt('Capa_Drive_ID')!==desired.Capa_Drive_ID||oldAt('Capa_URL_Externa')!==desired.Capa_URL_Externa;newSummary.synopsisChanged=oldAt('Sinopse')!==desired.Sinopse;log.Antes=JSON.stringify(oldSummary);log.Depois=JSON.stringify(newSummary);}
  if (logged.length > 1 || logged.length && !audit.columns.every(function (key) { return logged[0][key] === log[key]; }) || !logged.length && audit.rows.length >= 5000) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  if (!actual || !same_(actual.values, after.values)) { if (found.length) desired.number = found[0].number; accessSaveMain_(products, desired); }
  // Each relation is its own recoverable row; other products are never cleared.
  links.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto === command.Product_ID && after.nicheIds.indexOf(row.ID_Nicho) < 0; }).forEach(function (row) { links.sheet.getRange(row.number, 1, 1, 2).setValues([['', '']]); SpreadsheetApp.flush(); });
  after.nicheIds.forEach(function (id) {
    var current = catalogLinks_(ss);
    if (current.rows.some(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto === command.Product_ID && row.ID_Nicho === id; })) return;
    var empty = current.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto === '' && row.ID_Nicho === ''; })[0];
    accessSaveMain_(current, { number: empty && empty.number, ID_Produto: command.Product_ID, ID_Nicho: id });
  });
  if (!logged.length) accessSaveMain_(audit, log);
}
function recoverCatalog_(c) {
  var journal = catalogJournal_(c), pending = journal.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.State === 'PENDING'; });
  // New writes always recover first; two unfinished intents imply corruption.
  if (pending.length > 1) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  pending.forEach(function (row) {
    catalogProject_(c, row); row.State = 'COMPLETE'; row.Completed_At = new Date().toISOString(); row.Record_Hash = catalogJournalHash_(row); accessSaveMain_(journal, row);
  });
}
function catalogSave_(c, principal, p) {
  var hasPhoto = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(p,'photo');
  authControlExact_(p, ['commandId', 'id', 'expectedVersion', 'record'].concat(hasPhoto ? ['photo']:[]));
  if (!identityUuid_(p.commandId) || !identityUuid_(p.id) || !Number.isSafeInteger(p.expectedVersion) || p.expectedVersion < 0 || p.expectedVersion > 1000000000) catalogFail_();
  p.record = catalogRecord_(p.record);
  var canonical = { commandId: p.commandId, id: p.id, expectedVersion: p.expectedVersion, record: p.record };
  if (hasPhoto) { coverPhotosEnabled_(); if (p.photo !== null) { coverDescriptor_(p.photo); if (p.record.coverUrl) catalogFail_(); } canonical.photoHash = p.photo === null ? 'REMOVE':p.photo.sha256; }
  var journal = catalogJournal_(c), hash = digest_(JSON.stringify(canonical)), prior = journal.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.Command_ID === p.commandId; });
  if (prior.length) {
    if (prior[0].Actor_ID !== principal.id || prior[0].Product_ID !== p.id || prior[0].Command_Hash !== hash) catalogFail_('CATALOG_CONFLICT');
    return { id: p.id, version: prior[0].Expected_Version + 1 };
  }
  if (identityRows_(storage_(c, false).spreadsheet, '_Eventos_Dominio').rows.some(function (row) { return row.ID_Evento === p.commandId; })) catalogFail_('CATALOG_CONFLICT');
  if (journal.rows.length >= 1000) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  var ss = storage_(c, false).spreadsheet, products = catalogProducts_(ss), links = catalogLinks_(ss), niches = catalogNiches_(ss);
  catalogReferences_(products, links, niches);
  var matches = products.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto === p.id; }), existing = matches[0];
  if (existing ? existing.Versao_Registro !== p.expectedVersion : p.expectedVersion !== 0) catalogFail_('CATALOG_CONFLICT');
  if (!existing && products.rows.length >= 5000) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  // A forged save must not bypass the dedicated administrative removal route.
  if ((!existing && !p.record.active || existing && p.record.active !== existing.Ativo) && !['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(principal.role)) failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  if (existing && existing.Capa_Drive_ID && p.record.coverUrl && !hasPhoto) catalogFail_();
  if (p.record.nicheIds.some(function (id) { return !niches.rows.some(function (row) { return row.ID_Nicho === id && (row.Ativo || existing&&catalogLinkIds_(links,existing.ID_Produto).includes(id)); }); })) catalogFail_();
  if (p.record.active && products.rows.some(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto !== p.id && row.Ativo && (p.record.isbn && row.ISBN === p.record.isbn || p.record.internalCode && row.Codigo_Interno === p.record.internalCode); })) catalogFail_('CATALOG_DUPLICATE');
  var now = new Date().toISOString(), row = {};
  products.columns.forEach(function (key) { row[key] = existing ? existing[key] : ''; });
  var map = { ISBN: 'isbn', Codigo_Interno: 'internalCode', Titulo: 'title', Autor: 'author', Editora: 'publisher', Edicao: 'edition', Fornecedor: 'supplier', Preco_Venda: 'priceCents', Estoque_Minimo: 'minimumStock', Categoria: 'category', Capa_URL_Externa: 'coverUrl', Ano_Publicacao: 'year', Paginas: 'pages', Sinopse: 'synopsis', Ativo: 'active' };
  Object.keys(map).forEach(function (key) { row[key] = p.record[map[key]]; });
  row.ID_Produto = p.id; row.Versao_Registro = p.expectedVersion + 1; row.Atualizado_Em = now; row.Atualizado_Por = principal.id;
  if (!existing) { row.Estoque_Atual = 0; row.Criado_Em = now; row.Criado_Por = principal.id; }
  var before = catalogSnapshot_(products, existing, links), after = { values: products.columns.map(function (key) { return row[key]; }), nicheIds: p.record.nicheIds,auditVersion:2 };
  if (hasPhoto) after.photoHash = canonical.photoHash;
  if (before) catalogValidateSnapshot_(before, products.columns, p.id);
  catalogValidateSnapshot_(after, products.columns, p.id);
  if (links.rows.length + p.record.nicheIds.length > 5000 || identityRows_(ss, 'Logs_Auditoria').rows.length >= 5000) catalogFail_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
  if (hasPhoto) { row.Capa_Drive_ID = p.photo === null ? '':ensureCoverPhoto_(c,p.id,p.commandId,p.photo); after.values = products.columns.map(function (key) { return row[key]; }); }
  var intent = { Command_ID: p.commandId, Actor_ID: principal.id, Actor_Role: principal.role, Product_ID: p.id, Expected_Version: p.expectedVersion, Command_Hash: hash,
    Before_JSON: JSON.stringify(before), After_JSON: JSON.stringify(after), Created_At: now, State: 'PENDING', Completed_At: '' };
  intent.Record_Hash = catalogJournalHash_(intent); accessSaveMain_(journal, intent);
  recoverCatalog_(c); synchronizeStockNotifications_(ss); return { id: p.id, version: p.expectedVersion + 1 };
}
function catalogOperation_(request, c) {
  if (c.environment !== 'dev' || !request.actor || !accessHash_(request.actor.sessionTokenHash) || Object.keys(request.actor).length !== 1) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  var principal = identitySessionOperation_({ action: 'identity.session.read', payload: { tokenHash: request.actor.sessionTokenHash } }, c);
  if (!['ATENDENTE', 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(principal.role)) failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  recoverCatalog_(c);
  var p = request.payload, ss = storage_(c, false).spreadsheet;
  // A failed checkout must finish its durable projections before exposing stock.
  recoverSales_(ss);
  if (request.action === 'catalog.receive') return receiveStock_(request, c, principal, ss);
  if (request.action === 'catalog.remove') {
    if (!['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(principal.role) || !['mfa', 'passkey'].includes(principal.assurance)) failure_('FORBIDDEN');
    authControlExact_(p, ['commandId', 'id', 'expectedVersion']);
    if (!identityUuid_(p.commandId) || !identityUuid_(p.id) || !Number.isSafeInteger(p.expectedVersion) || p.expectedVersion < 1 || p.expectedVersion > 1000000000) catalogFail_();
    var prior = catalogJournal_(c).rows.filter(function (row) { return row.Command_ID === p.commandId; });
    if (prior.length) {
      var old = catalogIntent_(c, prior[0], rowValues_(ss.getSheetByName('Produtos')));
      if (prior[0].Actor_ID !== principal.id || prior[0].Product_ID !== p.id || prior[0].Expected_Version !== p.expectedVersion || !old.before || old.desired.Ativo !== false || old.before.values[rowValues_(ss.getSheetByName('Produtos')).indexOf('Ativo')] !== true) catalogFail_('CATALOG_CONFLICT');
      return { id: p.id, version: p.expectedVersion + 1 };
    }
    var row = catalogProducts_(ss).rows.filter(function (product) { return product.ID_Produto === p.id; })[0];
    if (!row) catalogFail_('CATALOG_NOT_FOUND');
    if (row.Ativo !== true) catalogFail_('CATALOG_CONFLICT');
    var record = catalogDto_(row, catalogLinks_(ss), true);
    ['id', 'stock', 'version', 'updatedAt', 'hasPhoto'].forEach(function (key) { delete record[key]; }); record.active = false;
    return catalogSave_(c, principal, { commandId: p.commandId, id: p.id, expectedVersion: p.expectedVersion, record: record });
  }
  if (request.action === 'catalog.save') return catalogSave_(c, principal, p);
  if (request.action === 'catalog.niches') {
    authControlExact_(p, []); return { niches: nicheDtos_(ss,catalogNiches_(ss).rows) };
  }
  var products = catalogProducts_(ss), links = catalogLinks_(ss);
  catalogReferences_(products, links, catalogNiches_(ss));
  if (['catalog.get','catalog.cover'].includes(request.action)) {
    authControlExact_(p, ['id']); if (!identityUuid_(p.id)) catalogFail_();
    var found = products.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto === p.id; }); if (found.length !== 1) catalogFail_('CATALOG_NOT_FOUND');
    if (request.action === 'catalog.cover') return readCoverPhoto_(c,found[0]);
    return { product: catalogDto_(found[0], links, true) };
  }
  if (request.action !== 'catalog.list') failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  authControlExact_(p, ['search', 'offset', 'nicheId', 'includeInactive']);
  if (typeof p.search !== 'string' || p.search.length > 100 || !Number.isSafeInteger(p.offset) || p.offset < 0 || p.offset > 5000 || p.nicheId !== '' && !identityUuid_(p.nicheId) || typeof p.includeInactive !== 'boolean') catalogFail_();
  var needle = p.search.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  var filtered = products.rows.filter(function (row) { return (p.includeInactive || row.Ativo) && (!p.nicheId || catalogLinkIds_(links, row.ID_Produto).indexOf(p.nicheId) >= 0) &&
    [row.Titulo, row.Autor, row.ISBN, row.Codigo_Interno].join(' ').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').indexOf(needle) >= 0; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.Titulo.localeCompare(b.Titulo) || a.ID_Produto.localeCompare(b.ID_Produto); });
  var page = filtered.slice(p.offset, p.offset + 10);
  return { products: page.map(function (row) { return catalogDto_(row, links, false); }), total: filtered.length, nextOffset: p.offset + page.length < filtered.length ? p.offset + page.length : null };
}
function recoverDevelopmentCatalog() { var c = baseSettings_(); requireOwnerDev_(c); return withLock_(function () { recoverCatalog_(c); return { recovered: true }; }); }

;
// END Catalog.gs

// BEGIN Code.gs sha256=309724ed4ea8feedfa7b7942417973c2aad7970903fa7bf0e1a9bbf5f85eb69f
/* Signed DEV identity, catalog and independently gated anonymous checkout. */
function failure_(code) { throw new Error(code); }
function hex_(bytes) { return bytes.map(function (b) { return ('0' + ((b + 256) % 256).toString(16)).slice(-2); }).join(''); }
function secretBytes_(secret) { return secret.match(/../g).map(function (h) { var n = parseInt(h, 16); return n > 127 ? n - 256 : n; }); }
function hmac_(message, secret, direction) {
  return hex_(Utilities.computeHmacSha256Signature(Utilities.newBlob(direction + '.v1.' + message).getBytes(), secretBytes_(secret)));
}
function digest_(text) { return hex_(Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, text, Utilities.Charset.UTF_8)); }
function constantEqual_(a, b) {
  if (typeof a !== 'string' || typeof b !== 'string' || a.length !== 64 || b.length !== 64) return false;
  var diff = 0; for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) diff |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
  return diff === 0;
}
function jsonOutput_(value) { return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(value)).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON); }
function baseSettings_() {
  var p = scriptProperties_().getProperties();
  if (!['dev', 'prod'].includes(p.APP_ENV) || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(p.INSTALLATION_ID || '') || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(p.SIGNING_SECRET || '') || !p.OWNER_EMAIL) failure_('CONFIGURATION_UNAVAILABLE');
  return { environment: p.APP_ENV, installationId: p.INSTALLATION_ID, secret: p.SIGNING_SECRET,
    owner: p.OWNER_EMAIL.toLowerCase(), spreadsheetId: p.SPREADSHEET_ID,
    driveRootId: p.DRIVE_ROOT_ID, backupsId: p.BACKUPS_FOLDER_ID };
}
function requireOwnerDev_(c) {
  if (c.environment !== 'dev' || Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase() !== c.owner) failure_('FORBIDDEN');
}
function marker_(c, kind) {
  return JSON.stringify({ application: 'livraria-ipb', environment: c.environment, installationId: c.installationId, kind: kind });
}
function assertMarker_(resource, c, kind) {
  var marker;
  try { marker = JSON.parse(resource.getDescription()); } catch (_) { failure_('BINDING_MISMATCH'); }
  if (!marker || marker.application !== 'livraria-ipb' || marker.environment !== c.environment || marker.installationId !== c.installationId || marker.kind !== kind) failure_('BINDING_MISMATCH');
  if (resource.getSharingAccess() !== DriveApp.Access.PRIVATE) failure_('BINDING_MISMATCH');
}
// Populated only inside one signed HTTP operation under ScriptLock. Never cache
// users, sessions, permissions, row contents or validation across requests.
var RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_ = null;
// Read snapshots exist only while one signed identity command holds ScriptLock.
// Copy on read so callers cannot mutate a cached row before a durable save.
// Every identity write invalidates before touching Sheets, including failures.
function rpcRows_(sheet, lastRow, width) {
  var cache = RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_ && RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.identityRows;
  var values = cache && cache.get(sheet);
  if (!values) {
    values = lastRow < 2 ? [] : sheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, width).getValues();
    if (cache) cache.set(sheet, values);
  }
  return values.map(function(row) { return row.slice(); });
}
function invalidateRpcRows_(sheet) {
  if (RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_ && RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.identityRows) RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.identityRows.delete(sheet);
}
function rpcSheet_(spreadsheet, name) {
  if (!RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_) return spreadsheet.getSheetByName(name);
  var sheets = RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.sheets.get(spreadsheet);
  if (!sheets) { sheets = new Map(); RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.sheets.set(spreadsheet, sheets); }
  if (!sheets.has(name)) sheets.set(name, spreadsheet.getSheetByName(name));
  return sheets.get(name);
}
function storage_(c, withBackup) {
  var cacheKey = JSON.stringify([c.environment, c.installationId, c.spreadsheetId, c.driveRootId, c.backupsId || '', !!withBackup]);
  if (RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_ && RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.main[cacheKey]) return RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.main[cacheKey];
  if (!c.spreadsheetId || !c.driveRootId) failure_('BINDING_MISMATCH');
  assertMarker_(resourceFile_(c.spreadsheetId), c, 'spreadsheet');
  assertMarker_(resourceFolder_(c.driveRootId), c, 'root');
  var backup = null;
  if (withBackup) {
    if (!c.backupsId) failure_('BINDING_MISMATCH');
    backup = resourceFolder_(c.backupsId); assertMarker_(backup, c, 'backups');
  }
  var result = { spreadsheet: resourceSheet_(c.spreadsheetId), backup: backup };
  if (RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_) RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.main[cacheKey] = result;
  return result;
}
function withLock_(fn, waitMs) {
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  var wait=waitMs===undefined?20000:waitMs;
  var waiting=Date.now();
  if (!lock.tryLock(wait)) { try { console.info(JSON.stringify({metric:'rpc.lockBusy',waitMs:Date.now()-waiting,limitMs:wait})); } catch (_) {} failure_('BUSY'); }
  try { return fn(); } finally { lock.releaseLock(); }
}
function rowValues_(sheet, knownLastRow) {
  // Runtime commands never edit row 1. Reuse only its header during this locked
  // invocation; authorization and business rows are always read afresh.
  if (RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_ && RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.headers.has(sheet)) return RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.headers.get(sheet).slice();
  var header = (knownLastRow === undefined ? sheet.getLastRow() : knownLastRow) ? sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, sheet.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0] : [];
  if (RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_) RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.headers.set(sheet, header.slice());
  return header;
}
// Advanced Sheets batches the same header rows without caching across RPCs.
// Bindings are checked before callers invoke this helper. No business bodies,
// identities or permissions are fetched or cached here.
function primeSchemaHeaders_(spreadsheet, definitions) {
  if(!RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_||typeof Sheets==='undefined')return;
  var selected=definitions.map(function(definition){var sheet=rpcSheet_(spreadsheet,definition.name);return {name:definition.name,sheet:sheet,width:sheet?sheet.getLastColumn():0};}).filter(function(item){return item.sheet&&!RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.headers.has(item.sheet);});
  if(!selected.length)return;
  var result;RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.batchReads=(RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.batchReads||0)+1;
  try { result=Sheets.Spreadsheets.Values.batchGet(spreadsheet.getId(),{ranges:selected.map(function(item){return "'"+item.name.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'!1:1";}),majorDimension:'ROWS',valueRenderOption:'UNFORMATTED_VALUE'}); }
  catch(_){failure_('UNAVAILABLE');}
  if(!result||result.spreadsheetId!==spreadsheet.getId()||!Array.isArray(result.valueRanges)||result.valueRanges.length!==selected.length)failure_('UNAVAILABLE');
  var pending=[];
  result.valueRanges.forEach(function(value,index){
    if(!value||typeof value.range!=='string'||value.majorDimension!=='ROWS')failure_('UNAVAILABLE');
    var bang=value.range.lastIndexOf('!'),title=value.range.slice(0,bang),range=value.range.slice(bang+1);
    if(title.charAt(0)==="'"&&title.charAt(title.length-1)==="'")title=title.slice(1,-1).replace(/''/g,"'");
    if(bang<1||title!==selected[index].name||!/^A1(?::[A-Z]+1)?$|^1:1$/.test(range))failure_('UNAVAILABLE');
    var rows=value.values===undefined?[]:value.values;
    if(!Array.isArray(rows)||rows.length>1||rows.length&&(!Array.isArray(rows[0])||rows[0].length>20000))failure_('UNAVAILABLE');
    var header=rows.length?rows[0]:[],width=selected[index].width;
    if(!Number.isSafeInteger(width)||width<0||width>20000||header.length>width)failure_('UNAVAILABLE');
    if(header.some(function(cell){return cell!==null&&!['string','number','boolean'].includes(typeof cell);}))failure_('UNAVAILABLE');
    pending.push({sheet:selected[index].sheet,header:Array.from({length:width},function(_,i){return header[i]===undefined?'':header[i];})});
  });
  pending.forEach(function(item){RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.headers.set(item.sheet,item.header);});
}
function same_(a, b) { return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b); }
function migrationRows_(spreadsheet) {
  var sheet = spreadsheet.getSheetByName('_Migracoes'), lastRow = sheet ? sheet.getLastRow() : 0;
  return lastRow < 2 ? [] : sheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 4).getValues();
}
function migrationVersion_(rows) {
  if (rows.some(function (r) { return !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(r[0])) || Number(r[0]) < 1; })) failure_('SCHEMA_INVALID');
  if (new Set(rows.map(function (r) { return Number(r[0]); })).size !== rows.length) failure_('SCHEMA_INVALID');
  return rows.length ? Math.max.apply(null, rows.map(function (r) { return Number(r[0]); })) : 0;
}
function version_(spreadsheet) { return migrationVersion_(migrationRows_(spreadsheet)); }
function preflight_(spreadsheet) {
  LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.tables.forEach(function (table) {
    var sheet = spreadsheet.getSheetByName(table.name);
    if (sheet && sheet.getLastRow() && !same_(rowValues_(sheet), table.columns)) failure_('SCHEMA_CONFLICT');
  });
}
function assertSchema_(spreadsheet) {
  var rows = migrationRows_(spreadsheet);
  if (migrationVersion_(rows) !== LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.version) failure_('SCHEMA_REQUIRED');
  if (!rows.some(function (r) { return Number(r[0]) === LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.version && r[3] === digest_(JSON.stringify(LIVRARIA_SCHEMA)); })) failure_('SCHEMA_REQUIRED');
  primeSchemaHeaders_(spreadsheet,LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.tables);
  // Read every header once, on every invocation. No cross-request cache.
  // Conflicting nonempty headers still take precedence over missing sheets.
  var missing = false;
  LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.tables.forEach(function (table) {
    var sheet = rpcSheet_(spreadsheet, table.name), lastRow = sheet ? sheet.getLastRow() : 0;
    if (!sheet || !lastRow) { missing = true; return; }
    if (!same_(rowValues_(sheet, lastRow), table.columns)) failure_('SCHEMA_CONFLICT');
  });
  if (missing) failure_('SCHEMA_REQUIRED');
}
function migrate_(c) {
  var store = storage_(c, true), ss = store.spreadsheet;
  preflight_(ss);
  var installed = version_(ss);
  if (installed > LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.version) failure_('SCHEMA_NEWER');
  if (installed === LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.version) { assertSchema_(ss); return { changed: false, schemaVersion: installed }; }
  // Validate every header BEFORE copying or mutating. Back up BEFORE the first write.
  var backup = resourceFile_(c.spreadsheetId).makeCopy('Livraria DEV before schema v' + LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.version + ' ' + new Date().toISOString(), store.backup);
  LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.tables.forEach(function (table) {
    var sheet = ss.getSheetByName(table.name) || ss.insertSheet(table.name);
    if (!sheet.getLastRow()) sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, table.columns.length).setValues([table.columns]);
    sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
    table.text_columns.forEach(function (column) {
      sheet.getRange(2, table.columns.indexOf(column) + 1, Math.max(1, sheet.getMaxRows() - 1), 1).setNumberFormat('@');
    });
  });
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  ss.getSheetByName('_Migracoes').appendRow([LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.version, new Date().toISOString(), backup.getId(), digest_(JSON.stringify(LIVRARIA_SCHEMA))]);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return { changed: true, schemaVersion: LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.version, backupId: backup.getId() };
}
function migrateDevelopmentSchema() {
  var c = baseSettings_(); requireOwnerDev_(c);
  return withLock_(function () { return migrate_(c); });
}
function inspectDevelopmentSchema() {
  var c = baseSettings_(); requireOwnerDev_(c);
  return withLock_(function () {
    assertSchema_(storage_(c, true).spreadsheet);
    var result = { environment: 'dev', schemaVersion: LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.version, tables: LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.tables.length };
    console.info(JSON.stringify(result)); // Owner-only verification; never keys, IDs or personal data.
    return result;
  });
}
function provisionDevelopment() {
  var c = baseSettings_(); requireOwnerDev_(c);
  return withLock_(function () {
    var props = scriptProperties_();
    var root;
    if (c.driveRootId) { root = resourceFolder_(c.driveRootId); assertMarker_(root, c, 'root'); }
    else {
      root = DriveApp.createFolder('Livraria DEV ' + c.installationId);
      root.setDescription(marker_(c, 'root')); c.driveRootId = root.getId(); props.setProperty('DRIVE_ROOT_ID', c.driveRootId);
    }
    assertMarker_(root, c, 'root');
    if (!c.spreadsheetId) {
      var sheet = SpreadsheetApp.create('Livraria DEV ' + c.installationId), file = resourceFile_(sheet.getId());
      file.setDescription(marker_(c, 'spreadsheet')); file.moveTo(root);
      c.spreadsheetId = sheet.getId(); props.setProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID', c.spreadsheetId);
    }
    // Never relabel existing resources: mismatched markers refuse further writes.
    assertMarker_(resourceFile_(c.spreadsheetId), c, 'spreadsheet');
    ['covers', 'profiles', 'documents', 'exports', 'backups'].forEach(function (kind) {
      var property = kind.toUpperCase() + '_FOLDER_ID';
      var existing = props.getProperty(property);
      if (kind === 'backups') property = 'BACKUPS_FOLDER_ID';
      if (existing) assertMarker_(resourceFolder_(existing), c, kind);
      else {
        var folder = root.createFolder(kind); folder.setDescription(marker_(c, kind));
        assertMarker_(folder, c, kind);
        props.setProperty(property, folder.getId());
      }
    });
    c.backupsId = props.getProperty('BACKUPS_FOLDER_ID');
    var result = migrate_(c);
    return { environment: c.environment, installationId: c.installationId, schemaVersion: result.schemaVersion,
      spreadsheetId: c.spreadsheetId, driveRootId: c.driveRootId, backupsId: c.backupsId };
  });
}
function readMessage_(envelope, c) {
  if (!envelope || typeof envelope.message !== 'string' || envelope.message.length > 180000 || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(envelope.message) || !constantEqual_(hmac_(envelope.message, c.secret, 'request'), envelope.signature)) failure_('UNAUTHORIZED');
  var request = JSON.parse(Utilities.newBlob(Utilities.base64Decode(envelope.message)).getDataAsString('UTF-8'));
  var now = Date.now();
  if (request.version !== 1 || !Number.isSafeInteger(request.issuedAt) || now - request.issuedAt > 120000 || request.issuedAt - now > 30000 || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(request.nonce || '') || !/^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/i.test(request.requestId || '')) failure_('UNAUTHORIZED');
  if (request.environment !== c.environment || request.installationId !== c.installationId || request.resources?.spreadsheetId !== c.spreadsheetId || request.resources?.driveRootId !== c.driveRootId) failure_('BINDING_MISMATCH');
  return request;
}
function registerNonce_(request, spreadsheet) {
  var sheet = spreadsheet.getSheetByName('_Requisicoes'), now = Date.now();
  var rows = sheet.getLastRow() < 2 ? [] : sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, 4).getValues();
  var live = rows.filter(function (r) { return Date.parse(r[2]) > now; });
  var hash = digest_(request.nonce);
  if (live.some(function (r) { return r[0] === hash; })) failure_('REPLAY');
  if (live.length >= 5000) failure_('SERVICE_CAPACITY');
  if (rows.length !== live.length) {
    sheet.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, 4).clearContent();
    if (live.length) sheet.getRange(2, 1, live.length, 4).setValues(live);
  }
  // getLastRow reflects cleared rows. No raw session token or PIN is stored.
  sheet.appendRow([hash, new Date(now).toISOString(), new Date(now + 300000).toISOString(), request.requestId]);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
}
function processRequest_(request, c) {
  var started=Date.now();
  return withLock_(function () {
    var acquired=Date.now(),bound=acquired,validated=acquired;
    var previousScope = RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_;
    RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_ = { main: {}, controls: {}, sheets: new WeakMap(), headers: new WeakMap(), identityRows: /^identity\.(access\.|passkey\.|guard\.)/.test(request.action) ? new WeakMap() : null, batchReads:0 };
    try {
    if(scriptProperties_().getProperty('MAINTENANCE_MODE')==='true')failure_('MAINTENANCE_ACTIVE');
    var ss;
    try { ss=storage_(c, false).spreadsheet; } finally { bound=Date.now();validated=bound; }
    try { assertSchema_(ss); } finally { validated=Date.now(); }
    registerNonce_(request, ss);
    // Service readiness is not a user login: no roles, PII or table names.
    // Full installation bindings, schema, signature and durable nonce still apply.
    if (request.action === 'system.ping' && c.environment === 'dev') {
      return { ready: true, environment: 'dev', schemaVersion: LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.version };
    }
    if (typeof request.action === 'string' && (request.action.indexOf('staff.') === 0 || request.action.indexOf('identity.staffAccess.') === 0)) {
      var staffProps = scriptProperties_();
      if (c.environment !== 'dev' || !staffEnabled_() || ['IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED','IDENTITY_ACCESS_ENABLED','IDENTITY_GUARDS_ENABLED','IDENTITY_PASSKEYS_ENABLED'].some(function(key){return staffProps.getProperty(key)!=='true';})) failure_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE');
      return request.action.indexOf('staff.') === 0 ? staffOperation_(request,c) : staffAccessOperation_(request,c);
    }
    if (typeof request.action === 'string' && request.action.indexOf('customers.') === 0) {
      var customerProps=scriptProperties_();
      if(c.environment!=='dev'||['CUSTOMERS_ENABLED','IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function(key){return customerProps.getProperty(key)!=='true';})) failure_('CUSTOMERS_UNAVAILABLE');
      return customerOperation_(request,c);
    }
    if(typeof request.action==='string'&&request.action.indexOf('insights.')===0){if(c.environment!=='dev'||['CUSTOMER_INSIGHTS_ENABLED','CUSTOMERS_ENABLED','REPORTS_ENABLED','CATALOG_ENABLED','IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function(k){return scriptProperties_().getProperty(k)!=='true';}))failure_('REPORT_UNAVAILABLE');return customerInsightsOperation_(request,c);}
    if(typeof request.action==='string'&&request.action.indexOf('reports.')===0){if(c.environment!=='dev'||['REPORTS_ENABLED','CATALOG_ENABLED','IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function(k){return scriptProperties_().getProperty(k)!=='true';}))failure_('REPORT_UNAVAILABLE');return reportsOperation_(request,c);}
    if(typeof request.action==='string'&&request.action.indexOf('audit.')===0){if(c.environment!=='dev'||['AUDIT_ENABLED','CATALOG_ENABLED','IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function(k){return scriptProperties_().getProperty(k)!=='true';}))failure_('AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');return auditOperation_(request,c);}
    if(typeof request.action==='string'&&request.action.indexOf('schedules.')===0){if(c.environment!=='dev'||['SCHEDULES_ENABLED','CATALOG_ENABLED','NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED','IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function(k){return scriptProperties_().getProperty(k)!=='true';}))failure_('SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE');return schedulesOperation_(request,c);}
    if(typeof request.action==='string'&&request.action.indexOf('niches.')===0){if(c.environment!=='dev'||['NICHES_ENABLED','CATALOG_ENABLED','IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function(k){return scriptProperties_().getProperty(k)!=='true';}))failure_('NICHES_UNAVAILABLE');return nichesOperation_(request,c);}
    if(typeof request.action==='string'&&request.action.indexOf('profile.')===0){
      if(c.environment!=='dev'||scriptProperties_().getProperty('PROFILE_ENABLED')!=='true'||scriptProperties_().getProperty('IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED')!=='true')failure_('PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE');
      return profileOperation_(request,c);
    }
    if(typeof request.action==='string'&&request.action.indexOf('operations.')===0){
      var operationProps=scriptProperties_();
      if(c.environment!=='dev'||['OPERATIONS_ENABLED','CATALOG_ENABLED','IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function(key){return operationProps.getProperty(key)!=='true';}))failure_('OPERATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');
      return operationsOperation_(request,c);
    }
    if (['sales.checkout','sales.receipt'].includes(request.action)) {
      var checkoutProps = scriptProperties_();
      if (c.environment !== 'dev' || ['CHECKOUT_ENABLED', 'CATALOG_ENABLED', 'IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function (key) { return checkoutProps.getProperty(key) !== 'true'; })) failure_('CHECKOUT_UNAVAILABLE');
      return checkoutOperation_(request, c);
    }
    if (typeof request.action === 'string' && request.action.indexOf('notifications.') === 0) {
      var notificationProps = scriptProperties_();
      if (c.environment !== 'dev' || ['NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED', 'CATALOG_ENABLED', 'IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function (key) { return notificationProps.getProperty(key) !== 'true'; })) failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');
      return notificationOperation_(request, c);
    }
    if (['catalog.list', 'catalog.get', 'catalog.niches', 'catalog.save', 'catalog.cover', 'catalog.receive', 'catalog.remove'].includes(request.action)) {
      var catalogProps = scriptProperties_();
      if (c.environment !== 'dev' || catalogProps.getProperty('CATALOG_ENABLED') !== 'true' || catalogProps.getProperty('IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED') !== 'true') failure_('CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE');
      return catalogOperation_(request, c);
    }
    if(typeof request.action==='string'&&request.action.indexOf('keys.')===0){if(c.environment!=='dev'||['KEY_MANAGEMENT_ENABLED','IDENTITY_PASSKEYS_ENABLED','IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function(k){return scriptProperties_().getProperty(k)!=='true';}))failure_('KEY_MANAGEMENT_UNAVAILABLE');return keyManagementOperation_(request,c);}
    if(request.action==='identity.security.record'){if(c.environment!=='dev'||['IDENTITY_ACCESS_ENABLED','IDENTITY_GUARDS_ENABLED','IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function(k){return scriptProperties_().getProperty(k)!=='true';}))failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');return securityRecord_(request,c);}
    if (typeof request.action === 'string' && request.action.indexOf('identity.access.') === 0) {
      var props = scriptProperties_();
      if (c.environment !== 'dev' || ['IDENTITY_ACCESS_ENABLED', 'IDENTITY_GUARDS_ENABLED', 'IDENTITY_PASSKEYS_ENABLED', 'IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED'].some(function (key) { return props.getProperty(key) !== 'true'; })) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
      if (request.action === 'identity.access.loginLookup') return accessLoginLookup_(request,c);
      if (request.action === 'identity.access.startGuarded') return accessStartGuarded_(request, c);
      if (request.action === 'identity.access.emailGuarded') return accessEmailGuarded_(request, c);
      if (request.action === 'identity.access.pinReadGuarded') return accessPinReadGuarded_(request, c);
      if (request.action === 'identity.access.options') return accessOptions_(request, c);
      if (request.action === 'identity.access.prepareCompletion') return accessPrepareCompletion_(request, c);
      return ownerAccessOperation_(request, c);
    }
    if (['identity.passkey.list', 'identity.passkey.begin', 'identity.passkey.take', 'identity.passkey.register', 'identity.passkey.counter'].includes(request.action)) {
      if (c.environment !== 'dev' || scriptProperties_().getProperty('IDENTITY_PASSKEYS_ENABLED') !== 'true') failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
      return passkeyOperation_(request, c);
    }
    if (['identity.guard.attempt', 'identity.challenge.create', 'identity.challenge.consume'].includes(request.action)) {
      if (c.environment !== 'dev' || scriptProperties_().getProperty('IDENTITY_GUARDS_ENABLED') !== 'true') failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
      return authControlOperation_(request, c);
    }
    if (['identity.session.read', 'identity.session.revoke', 'identity.session.revokeOthers'].includes(request.action)) {
      if (c.environment !== 'dev' || scriptProperties_().getProperty('IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED') !== 'true') failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
      return identitySessionOperation_(request, c);
    }
    var actor = request.actor;
    if (request.action !== 'system.schema') failure_('FORBIDDEN');
    if (c.environment !== 'dev' || scriptProperties_().getProperty('IDENTITY_SESSIONS_ENABLED') !== 'true') failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    if (!actor || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(actor.sessionTokenHash || '')) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
    // Re-resolve INSIDE this operation's lock. A prior Node lookup cannot
    // authorize metadata after a concurrent logout, disable or epoch change.
    var principal = identitySessionOperation_({ action: 'identity.session.read', payload: { tokenHash: actor.sessionTokenHash } }, c);
    if (actor.id !== principal.id || actor.role !== principal.role || actor.assurance !== principal.assurance || actor.authenticatedAt !== principal.authenticatedAt ||
        !['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(principal.role) || !['mfa', 'passkey'].includes(principal.assurance) || Date.now() - principal.authenticatedAt > 300000) failure_('FORBIDDEN');
    return { schemaVersion: LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.version, tables: LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.tables.map(function (t) { return t.name; }) };
    } finally {
      // Fixed numeric fields only: no payloads, identifiers, PINs or email codes.
      var tags={'identity.access.loginLookup':'LOGIN_LOOKUP','identity.access.login':'LOGIN_FLOW','identity.access.startGuarded':'START','identity.access.start':'START','identity.access.read':'STATE','identity.access.emailGuarded':'EMAIL','identity.access.pinReadGuarded':'PIN_READ','identity.access.pin':'PIN_SAVE','identity.access.options':'OPTIONS','identity.access.prepareCompletion':'COMPLETE_PREPARE','identity.access.commit':'COMMIT','identity.passkey.take':'PASSKEY_TAKE','identity.passkey.register':'PASSKEY_REGISTER','identity.passkey.counter':'PASSKEY_COUNTER','identity.guard.attempt':'GUARD'};
      var operation=typeof request.action==='string'&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(tags,request.action)?tags[request.action]:'OTHER';
      try { console.info(JSON.stringify({metric:'rpc.duration',operation:operation,schemaBatchReads:RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_.batchReads||0,lockMs:acquired-started,bindingsMs:bound-acquired,schemaMs:Math.max(0,validated-bound),workMs:Date.now()-validated,totalMs:Date.now()-started})); }
      catch (_) {} finally { RPC_STORAGE_SCOPE_ = previousScope; }
    }
  }, 5000);
}
function signedResponse_(c, request, ok, data, code) {
  var result = { version: 1, environment: c.environment, installationId: c.installationId,
    requestId: request.requestId, nonce: request.nonce, sentAt: Date.now(), ok: ok };
  if (ok) result.data = data; else result.error = { code: code };
  var message = Utilities.base64Encode(Utilities.newBlob(JSON.stringify(result)).getBytes());
  return jsonOutput_({ message: message, signature: hmac_(message, c.secret, 'response') });
}
function doPost(event) {
  var c, request;
  try {
    c = baseSettings_();
    if (!event || !event.postData || typeof event.postData.contents !== 'string' || event.postData.contents.length > 190000) failure_('UNAUTHORIZED');
    request = readMessage_(JSON.parse(event.postData.contents), c);
  } catch (_) { return jsonOutput_({ error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' } }); }
  try { return signedResponse_(c, request, true, processRequest_(request, c)); }
  catch (error) {
    var allowed = ['EMERGENCY_RECOVERY_UNAVAILABLE','KEY_MANAGEMENT_RATE_LIMITED','KEY_MANAGEMENT_UNAVAILABLE','KEY_MANAGEMENT_REJECTED','KEY_MANAGEMENT_CONFLICT','KEY_MANAGEMENT_LAST_KEY','KEY_MANAGEMENT_CAPACITY','CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND','CUSTOMER_CONTACT_NOT_AUTHORIZED','REPORT_UNAVAILABLE','INVALID_REPORT','REPORT_CHANGED','REPORT_CONFLICT','REPORT_CAPACITY','SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE','REPLAY', 'BUSY', 'SERVICE_CAPACITY', 'MAINTENANCE_ACTIVE', 'SCHEMA_REQUIRED', 'SCHEMA_CONFLICT', 'FORBIDDEN', 'BINDING_MISMATCH', 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE', 'CHALLENGE_REJECTED', 'PASSKEY_REJECTED', 'ACCESS_REJECTED', 'CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE', 'CATALOG_INVALID', 'CATALOG_CONFLICT', 'CATALOG_DUPLICATE', 'CATALOG_NOT_FOUND', 'CATALOG_STOCK_HISTORY', 'COVER_PHOTOS_UNAVAILABLE', 'COVER_PHOTO_INVALID'];
    allowed = allowed.concat(['CHECKOUT_UNAVAILABLE', 'INVALID_SALE', 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT', 'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK', 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE', 'SALE_PRICE_CHANGED', 'JOURNAL_CAPACITY', 'JOURNAL_INVALID', 'PROJECTION_CONFLICT']);
    allowed = allowed.concat(['STAFF_UNAVAILABLE','INVALID_STAFF','STAFF_CONFLICT','STAFF_DUPLICATE','STAFF_CAPACITY','STAFF_CPF_DUPLICATE','STAFF_EMAIL_DUPLICATE']);
    allowed = allowed.concat(['CUSTOMERS_UNAVAILABLE','INVALID_CUSTOMER','CUSTOMER_CONFLICT','CUSTOMER_DUPLICATE','CUSTOMER_CAPACITY','CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE']);
    allowed = allowed.concat(['EMAIL_CHANGE_UNAVAILABLE','EMAIL_CHANGE_REJECTED','EMAIL_CHANGE_CONFLICT','EMAIL_CHANGE_RATE_LIMITED','EMAIL_CHANGE_DELIVERY']);
    allowed = allowed.concat(['AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE','INVALID_AUDIT','AUDIT_CHANGED','AUDIT_CONFLICT','AUDIT_CAPACITY','AUDIT_EXPORT_LIMIT']);
    allowed = allowed.concat(['SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE','INVALID_SCHEDULE','SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND','SCHEDULE_CONFLICT','SCHEDULE_CAPACITY','SCHEDULE_EMPLOYEE_UNAVAILABLE','SCHEDULE_NO_CHANGE','SCHEDULE_OVERLAP']);
    allowed = allowed.concat(['NICHES_UNAVAILABLE','INVALID_NICHE','NICHE_CONFLICT','NICHE_DUPLICATE','NICHE_NOT_FOUND']);
    allowed = allowed.concat(['PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE','INVALID_PROFILE','PROFILE_CONFLICT','PROFILE_NOT_FOUND','PROFILE_CPF_DUPLICATE','PROFILE_CPF_LOCKED']);
    allowed = allowed.concat(['OPERATIONS_UNAVAILABLE','INVALID_OPERATION','SALE_NOT_FOUND','OPERATION_CONFLICT','STOCK_NO_CHANGE']);
    allowed = allowed.concat(['INVALID_STOCK_RECEIPT', 'STOCK_LIMIT']);
    allowed = allowed.concat(['NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE', 'INVALID_NOTIFICATION', 'NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND', 'NOTIFICATION_CONFLICT', 'NOTIFICATION_CAPACITY']);
    return signedResponse_(c, request, false, null, allowed.includes(error.message) ? error.message : 'UNAVAILABLE');
  }
}
function doGet() { return jsonOutput_({ error: { code: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED' } }); }

// BEGIN CoverPhotos.gs sha256=08ad6db44570cb221547a63fc3559631ca5634d7ed3212023122940a23c9fe86
/* Private Drive covers. Called only under the catalog's signed/session lock.
 * Browsers never choose Drive IDs or get public sharing URLs. */
function coverPhotosEnabled_() { if (scriptProperties_().getProperty('COVER_PHOTOS_ENABLED') !== 'true') failure_('COVER_PHOTOS_UNAVAILABLE'); }
function coverFolder_(c) {
  if (c.environment !== 'dev') failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  storage_(c,false);
  var id = scriptProperties_().getProperty('COVERS_FOLDER_ID');
  if (!id) failure_('COVER_PHOTOS_UNAVAILABLE');
  var folder = resourceFolder_(id); assertMarker_(folder,c,'covers'); return folder;
}
function coverBytesHash_(bytes) { return hex_(Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,bytes)); }
function coverDescriptor_(photo) {
  authControlExact_(photo,['bytes','sha256']);
  if (typeof photo.bytes !== 'string' || photo.bytes.length > 65536 || !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(photo.bytes) || !accessHash_(photo.sha256)) failure_('COVER_PHOTO_INVALID');
  var bytes = Utilities.base64Decode(photo.bytes);
  if (bytes.length < 4 || bytes.length > 49152 || (bytes[0]+256)%256 !== 255 || (bytes[1]+256)%256 !== 216 ||
      (bytes[bytes.length-2]+256)%256 !== 255 || (bytes[bytes.length-1]+256)%256 !== 217 || Utilities.base64Encode(bytes) !== photo.bytes || coverBytesHash_(bytes) !== photo.sha256) failure_('COVER_PHOTO_INVALID');
  return bytes;
}
function coverFile_(c, id, productId, expectedHash, allowUnmarked, folder) {
  folder = folder || coverFolder_(c);
  var file = resourceFile_(id), parents = file.getParents(), belongs = false;
  while (parents.hasNext()) if (parents.next().getId() === folder.getId()) belongs = true;
  if (!belongs || file.getSharingAccess() !== DriveApp.Access.PRIVATE || file.getMimeType() !== 'image/jpeg' || file.getSize() > 49152 || file.getSize() < 4) failure_('BINDING_MISMATCH');
  var bytes = file.getBlob().getBytes(), hash = coverBytesHash_(bytes), marker;
  try { marker = JSON.parse(file.getDescription()); } catch (_) { marker = null; }
  if (!marker && !allowUnmarked) failure_('BINDING_MISMATCH');
  if (marker) {
    assertMarker_(file,c,'cover');
    if (marker.productId !== productId || !identityUuid_(marker.commandId) || !constantEqual_(hash,marker.sha256)) failure_('BINDING_MISMATCH');
  }
  if (expectedHash && !constantEqual_(hash,expectedHash)) failure_('CATALOG_CONFLICT');
  coverDescriptor_({bytes:Utilities.base64Encode(bytes),sha256:hash});
  return {file:file,bytes:Utilities.base64Encode(bytes),sha256:hash,marker:marker};
}
function ensureCoverPhoto_(c, productId, commandId, photo) {
  coverPhotosEnabled_(); var bytes = coverDescriptor_(photo), folder = coverFolder_(c);
  var name = 'cover-' + productId + '-' + commandId + '.jpg', matches = folder.getFilesByName(name), files = [];
  while (matches.hasNext()) { files.push(matches.next()); if (files.length > 1) failure_('COVER_PHOTOS_UNAVAILABLE'); }
  var file = files.length ? files[0] : folder.createFile(Utilities.newBlob(bytes,'image/jpeg',name));
  // Deterministic name + hash permit resuming after file creation but before
  // acknowledgement/marker. Never overwrite an existing file's bytes.
  var checked = coverFile_(c,file.getId(),productId,photo.sha256,true,folder);
  if (checked.marker && checked.marker.commandId !== commandId) failure_('BINDING_MISMATCH');
  if (!checked.marker) {
    var marker = JSON.parse(marker_(c,'cover')); marker.productId = productId; marker.commandId = commandId; marker.sha256 = photo.sha256;
    file.setDescription(JSON.stringify(marker));
  }
  coverFile_(c,file.getId(),productId,photo.sha256,false,folder);
  return file.getId();
}
function readCoverPhoto_(c, row) {
  coverPhotosEnabled_();
  if (!row.Capa_Drive_ID) failure_('CATALOG_NOT_FOUND');
  var cover = coverFile_(c,row.Capa_Drive_ID,row.ID_Produto,null,false);
  return {bytes:cover.bytes,sha256:cover.sha256};
}

 * No provider calls, sending, recommendation writes or new persistent tables. */
function insightSource_(ss,c,id){

function customerInsightsOperation_(request,c){

}

// BEGIN Customers.gs sha256=528e310124192db981cb64392b9d6b9596d01c44f90c4eabdace93a670ab71ca
/* Private customer records and recoverable updates. Dispatcher holds ScriptLock.
 * PII lives in an authenticated encrypted contact envelope in Clientes.Nome. */
function customerFail_(code){failure_(code||'INVALID_CUSTOMER');}
function customerRevision_(ss,id){var row=staffConfig_(ss,'customer.revision.'+id).row;if(!row)return 0;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(row.Valor)||row.Valor<1)customerFail_('CUSTOMERS_UNAVAILABLE');return row.Valor;}
function customerRows_(ss){
 var table=identityRows_(ss,'Clientes'),ids=new Set(),cpfs=new Set();
 table.rows.forEach(function(r){if(!identityUuid_(r.ID_Cliente)||ids.has(r.ID_Cliente)||!staffSealed_(r.Nome)||!accessHash_(r.CPF_Indice)||cpfs.has(r.CPF_Indice)||!['NONE','WHATSAPP','EMAIL'].includes(r.Preferencia_Contato)||typeof r.Consentimento_Marketing!=='boolean'||['CPF','Email','Whatsapp','CEP','Logradouro','Numero','Complemento','Bairro','Cidade','UF'].some(function(k){return r[k]!=='';}))customerFail_('CUSTOMERS_UNAVAILABLE');ids.add(r.ID_Cliente);cpfs.add(r.CPF_Indice);authControlTime_(r.Data_Cadastro);if(r.Ultima_Compra!=='')authControlTime_(r.Ultima_Compra);if(r.Data_Consentimento!=='')authControlTime_(r.Data_Consentimento);});return table;
}
function customerDto_(ss,r){return {id:r.ID_Cliente,contact:r.Nome,revision:customerRevision_(ss,r.ID_Cliente),createdAt:r.Data_Cadastro,lastPurchase:r.Ultima_Compra,consentAt:r.Data_Consentimento,contactPreference:r.Preferencia_Contato,marketingConsent:r.Consentimento_Marketing};}
function customerCommands_(ss){return identityRows_(ss,'Configuracoes').rows.filter(function(r){return r.Chave.indexOf('customer.command.')===0;}).map(function(r){
 var v;try{v=JSON.parse(r.Valor);}catch(_){customerFail_('CUSTOMERS_UNAVAILABLE');}

 authControlTime_(v.at);var clone=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));delete clone.state;delete clone.hash;if(!constantEqual_(digest_(JSON.stringify(clone)),v.hash))customerFail_('CUSTOMERS_UNAVAILABLE');return v;
});}
function customerProject_(ss,v){
 var table=identityRows_(ss,'Clientes'),cols=table.columns;if(v.after.length!==cols.length||v.before!==null&&v.before.length!==cols.length||v.after[cols.indexOf('ID_Cliente')]!==v.id)customerFail_('CUSTOMERS_UNAVAILABLE');
 var found=table.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Cliente===v.id;});if(found.length>1||!found.length&&v.before!==null)customerFail_('CUSTOMER_CONFLICT');
 var values=found.length?cols.map(function(k){return found[0][k];}):null;if(!same_(values,v.before)&&!same_(values,v.after))customerFail_('CUSTOMER_CONFLICT');
 if(!same_(values,v.after)){var row={number:found.length?found[0].number:undefined};cols.forEach(function(k,i){row[k]=v.after[i];});accessSaveMain_(table,row);}
 staffPut_(ss,'customer.revision.'+v.id,v.revision,v.at,v.actor);
 var audit=identityRows_(ss,'Logs_Auditoria'),prior=audit.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Log===v.commandId;}),log={ID_Log:v.commandId,Data_Hora:v.at,ID_Usuario:v.actor,Perfil:v.role,Acao:v.before===null?'CUSTOMER_CREATE':'CUSTOMER_UPDATE',Entidade:'Clientes',ID_Entidade:v.id,
 Antes:JSON.stringify({revision:v.revision-1}),Depois:JSON.stringify({revision:v.revision,contactPreference:v.after[cols.indexOf('Preferencia_Contato')],marketingConsent:v.after[cols.indexOf('Consentimento_Marketing')]}),Resultado:'SUCESSO',ID_Requisicao:v.commandId};
 if(prior.length>1||prior.length&&!audit.columns.every(function(k){return prior[0][k]===log[k];}))customerFail_('CUSTOMERS_UNAVAILABLE');if(!prior.length)accessSaveMain_(audit,log);
 v.state='COMPLETE';staffPut_(ss,'customer.command.'+v.commandId,JSON.stringify(v),v.at,v.actor);
}
function recoverCustomers_(ss){var pending=customerCommands_(ss).filter(function(v){return v.state==='PENDING';});if(pending.length>1)customerFail_('CUSTOMERS_UNAVAILABLE');pending.forEach(function(v){customerProject_(ss,v);});}
function customerOperation_(request,c){
 var ss=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet;recoverCustomers_(ss);
 if(ss.getSheetByName('_Eventos_Dominio').getLastRow()>1){if(scriptProperties_().getProperty('CATALOG_JOURNAL_ID'))recoverCatalog_(c);recoverSales_(ss);}
 if(!request.actor||!accessHash_(request.actor.sessionTokenHash))failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');var principal=identitySession_(ss,request.actor.sessionTokenHash,Date.now()).principal,p=request.payload,users=customerRows_(ss);
 if(!['ATENDENTE','ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(principal.role))failure_('FORBIDDEN');
