function emergencyStartCommit_(ss,c,current,p,now){if(!emergencyEnabled_()||!recoveryEnabled_())emergencyFail_();var row=current.row,subject=recoverySubject_(c,row),ceremony=passkeyCeremonies_(ss).rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID===p.ceremonyId;}),keys=passkeyCredentials_(ss),main=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet,kit=emergencyKit_(c,row.Subject_ID);if(row.State!=='PASSKEY'||!Number.isSafeInteger(row.Authorization_Version+1)||!emergencyFlow_(c,row)||row.Ceremony_ID!==p.ceremonyId||ceremony.length!==1||ceremony[0].Subject_ID!==row.Subject_ID||ceremony[0].Authorization_Version!==row.Authorization_Version||ceremony[0].Purpose!=='REGISTER'||!ceremony[0].Consumed_At||ceremony[0].Completed_At!==''||authControlTime_(ceremony[0].Expires_At)<=now||!accessHash_(p.sessionTokenHash)||!passkeyText_(p.credentialId,2,1400)||!passkeyText_(p.publicKey,20,4096)||!Number.isSafeInteger(p.counter)||p.counter<0||p.counter>4294967295||!Array.isArray(p.transports)||p.transports.length>7||p.transports.some(function(t){return !['ble','cable','hybrid','internal','nfc','smart-card','usb'].includes(t);})||keys.rows.some(function(k){return k.Credential_ID===p.credentialId||k.Registration_Ceremony_ID===p.ceremonyId;})||keys.rows.length>=3000||identityRows_(main,'Sessoes').rows.length>=5000||identityRows_(main,'Logs_Auditoria').rows.length>=5000||identityRows_(main,'Logs_Auditoria').rows.some(function(r){return r.ID_Log===row.ID;}))accessReject_();accessPinRecord_(row.Pin_JSON);
 var v={version:1,environment:c.environment,installationId:c.installationId,flowId:row.ID,userId:row.Subject_ID,epoch:row.Authorization_Version,role:subject.row.Perfil,tokenHash:row.Token_Hash,sessionHash:p.sessionTokenHash,ceremonyId:p.ceremonyId,kitId:kit.id,pin:row.Pin_JSON,key:{id:p.credentialId,publicKey:p.publicKey,counter:p.counter,transports:p.transports},at:new Date(now).toISOString()};emergencySave_(c,'IDENTITY_RESCUE_PENDING',v,'emergency.commit');emergencyProject_(c,v);return {stored:true};
}
function emergencyProject_(c,v){

 if(row.State==='PASSKEY'){row.State='COMMITTING';row.Session_Token_Hash=v.sessionHash;row.Commit_Started_At=v.at;authControlSave_(flows,row);}if(row.Session_Token_Hash!==v.sessionHash||row.Commit_Started_At!==v.at)emergencyFail_();
 kit.state='INVALID';kit.recoveredBy=v.flowId;emergencySave_(c,'IDENTITY_RESCUE_CODES_'+v.userId,kit,'emergency.codes');staffPut_(main,'identity.version.'+v.userId,target,v.at,v.userId);
 var pins=accessPins_(priv),pin=pins.rows.filter(function(r){return r.Subject_ID===v.userId;});if(pin.length!==1||![v.epoch,target].includes(pin[0].Authorization_Version)||pin[0].Authorization_Version===target&&pin[0].Record_JSON!==v.pin)emergencyFail_();pin[0].Record_JSON=v.pin;pin[0].Authorization_Version=target;pin[0].Created_At=v.at;authControlSave_(pins,pin[0]);

 var ceremonies=passkeyCeremonies_(priv),ceremony=ceremonies.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID===v.ceremonyId;});if(ceremony.length!==1||ceremony[0].Purpose!=='REGISTER'||ceremony[0].Subject_ID!==v.userId||ceremony[0].Authorization_Version!==v.epoch||!ceremony[0].Consumed_At||ceremony[0].Credential_ID!==''&&ceremony[0].Credential_ID!==v.key.id||ceremony[0].Completed_At!==''&&ceremony[0].Completed_At!==v.at)emergencyFail_();ceremony[0].Credential_ID=v.key.id;ceremony[0].Completed_At=v.at;authControlSave_(ceremonies,ceremony[0]);

 var audit=identityRows_(main,'Logs_Auditoria'),prior=audit.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Log===v.flowId;}),log={ID_Log:v.flowId,Data_Hora:v.at,ID_Usuario:v.userId,Perfil:v.role,Acao:'IDENTITY_PASSKEY_RECOVERED',Entidade:'Usuarios',ID_Entidade:v.userId,Antes:JSON.stringify({authorizationVersion:v.epoch}),Depois:JSON.stringify({authorizationVersion:target,otherSessionsRevoked:true}),Resultado:'SUCESSO',ID_Requisicao:v.flowId};if(prior.length>1||prior.length&&!audit.columns.every(function(k){return prior[0][k]===log[k];}))emergencyFail_();if(!prior.length)accessSaveMain_(audit,log);row.State='COMPLETE';row.Completed_At=v.at;row.Pin_JSON='';authControlSave_(flows,row);scriptProperties_().setProperty('IDENTITY_RESCUE_PENDING','');
}
function recoverEmergencyRecovery_(c){var v=emergencyRead_(c,'IDENTITY_RESCUE_PENDING','emergency.commit');if(v)emergencyProject_(c,v);}
function emergencyRecoveryCommit_(ss,c,current,p,now,background){recoverEmergencyRecovery_(c);var found=accessFlows_(ss).rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID===current.row.ID;});if(found.length!==1||found[0].State!=='COMPLETE'||found[0].Session_Token_Hash!==p.sessionTokenHash||!emergencyFlow_(c,found[0]))accessReject_();return background?null:identitySession_(storage_(c,false).spreadsheet,p.sessionTokenHash,now).principal;}

;
// END EmergencyRecovery.gs

// BEGIN Maintenance.gs sha256=23306f6755a03f993de16e44e530d8b2d928a11c3899a2078844e912464d6524
/* Privileged DEV maintenance. No function in this file is routed by doPost.
 * Recovery uses an isolated resource map under ScriptLock; active bindings stay intact. */
var MAINTENANCE_CONTEXT_ = null;
function scriptProperties_() {
  return MAINTENANCE_CONTEXT_
    ? MAINTENANCE_CONTEXT_.properties
    : PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
}
function maintenanceId_(id) {
  return (MAINTENANCE_CONTEXT_ && MAINTENANCE_CONTEXT_.aliases[id]) || id;
}
function resourceFile_(id) {
  return DriveApp.getFileById(maintenanceId_(id));
}
function resourceFolder_(id) {
  return DriveApp.getFolderById(maintenanceId_(id));
}
function resourceSheet_(id) {
  return SpreadsheetApp.openById(maintenanceId_(id));
}
function maintenanceFail_(code) {
  failure_(code || "MAINTENANCE_INVALID");
}
function maintenanceOwner_() {
  var c = baseSettings_();
  requireOwnerDev_(c);
  var active = Session.getActiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase();
  if (!active || active !== c.owner) maintenanceFail_("FORBIDDEN");
  return c;
}
function maintenanceKey_() {
  var p = scriptProperties_(),
    k = p.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_BACKUP_KEY");
  if (!accessHash_(k) || k === p.getProperty("SIGNING_SECRET"))
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFIGURATION");
  return k;
}
function maintenanceGuard_(resume) {
  var c = maintenanceOwner_();
  if (scriptProperties_().getProperty("MAINTENANCE_MODE") !== "true")
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED");
  maintenanceKey_();
  if (
    !resume &&
    Object.keys(scriptProperties_().getProperties()).some(function (k) {
      return (
        /^MAINTENANCE_.*_PENDING$/.test(k) && scriptProperties_().getProperty(k)
      );
    })
  )
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_PENDING");
  return c;
}
function maintenanceAcl_(folder) {
  if (folder.getSharingAccess() !== DriveApp.Access.PRIVATE)
    maintenanceFail_("BINDING_MISMATCH");
  var allowed = [
    baseSettings_().owner,
    scriptProperties_().getProperty("MAINTENANCE_RECOVERY_EMAIL"),
  ].filter(Boolean);
  if (
    folder
      .getEditors()
      .concat(folder.getViewers())
      .some(function (u) {
        return !allowed.includes(u.getEmail().toLowerCase());
      })
  )
    maintenanceFail_("BINDING_MISMATCH");
}
function maintenanceFolder_(c) {
  var folder = storage_(c, true).backup;
  maintenanceAcl_(folder);
  return folder;
}
function maintenanceSign_(body) {
  return hmac_(JSON.stringify(body), maintenanceKey_(), "maintenance.archive");
}
function maintenanceWrite_(folder, name, body) {
  var file = folder.createFile(
    Utilities.newBlob(
      JSON.stringify({ body: body, signature: maintenanceSign_(body) }),
      "application/json",
      name,
    ),
  );
  file.setDescription(marker_(baseSettings_(), "maintenance-archive"));
  return file;
}
function maintenanceRead_(id) {
  var c = baseSettings_(),
    folder = maintenanceFolder_(c),
    file = resourceFile_(id),
    parents = file.getParents(),
    belongs = false;
  while (parents.hasNext())
    if (parents.next().getId() === folder.getId()) belongs = true;
  if (!belongs) maintenanceFail_("BINDING_MISMATCH");
  assertMarker_(file, c, "maintenance-archive");
  if (file.getSize() > 24000000) maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CAPACITY");
  var raw;
  try {
    raw = JSON.parse(file.getBlob().getDataAsString("UTF-8"));
  } catch (_) {
    maintenanceFail_();
  }
  if (
    !raw ||
    !constantEqual_(raw.signature, maintenanceSign_(raw.body)) ||
    raw.body.installationId !== c.installationId ||
    raw.body.environment !== "dev"
  )
    maintenanceFail_();
  return raw.body;
}
function beginDevelopmentMaintenance() {
  var c = maintenanceOwner_();
  return withLock_(function () {
    maintenanceKey_();
    storage_(c, true);
    scriptProperties_().setProperty("MAINTENANCE_MODE", "true");
    return { environment: "dev", maintenance: true };
  });
}
function maintenanceTables_(ss) {
  var sheets = ss.getSheets();
  if (sheets.length > 40) maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CAPACITY");
  return sheets
    .map(function (s) {
      var h = s.getLastRow(),
        w = s.getLastColumn();
      if (h > 5001 || w > 100) maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CAPACITY");
      var range = h && w ? s.getRange(1, 1, h, w) : null;
      if (
        range &&
        range.getFormulas &&
        range.getFormulas().some(function (r) {
          return r.some(Boolean);
        })
      )
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_FORMULA");
      return {
        name: s.getName(),
        rows: range ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(range.getValues())) : [],
      };
    })
    .sort(function (a, b) {
      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });
}
function maintenanceSnapshot_(c, id) {
  var p = scriptProperties_().getProperties(),
    properties = {};
  Object.keys(p)
    .sort()
    .forEach(function (k) {
      if (
        ![
          "MAINTENANCE_BACKUP_KEY",
          "MAINTENANCE_NEXT_SIGNING_SECRET",
          "MAINTENANCE_PERSONAL_INDEX_KEY",
        ].includes(k)
      )
        properties[k] = p[k];
    });
  var files = [
      ["SPREADSHEET_ID", "spreadsheet"],
      ["IDENTITY_CONTROL_SPREADSHEET_ID", "identity-controls"],
      ["CATALOG_JOURNAL_ID", "catalog-journal"],
    ],
    sheets = [];
  files.forEach(function (pair) {
    if (!p[pair[0]]) return;
    var f = resourceFile_(p[pair[0]]);
    assertMarker_(f, c, pair[1]);
    sheets.push({
      id: p[pair[0]],
      kind: pair[1],
      tables: maintenanceTables_(resourceSheet_(p[pair[0]])),
    });
  });
  var folders = [],
    assets = [],
    ids = new Set();
  Object.keys(p)
    .sort()
    .filter(function (k) {
      return /_FOLDER_ID$/.test(k) && k !== "BACKUPS_FOLDER_ID";
    })
    .forEach(function (k) {
      if (!p[k] || ids.has(p[k])) return;
      ids.add(p[k]);
      var f = resourceFolder_(p[k]),
        m;
      try {
        m = JSON.parse(f.getDescription());
      } catch (_) {
        maintenanceFail_("BINDING_MISMATCH");
      }
      assertMarker_(f, c, m.kind);
      folders.push({ id: p[k], kind: m.kind });
      var it = f.getFiles();
      while (it.hasNext()) {
        var a = it.next();
        if (
          assets.length >= 1000 ||
          a.getSharingAccess() !== DriveApp.Access.PRIVATE ||
          a.getSize() > 4000000
        )
          maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CAPACITY");
        var bytes = a.getBlob().getBytes();
        assets.push({
          id: a.getId(),
          folder: p[k],
          name: a.getName(),
          mime: a.getMimeType(),
          description: a.getDescription(),
          bytes: Utilities.base64Encode(bytes),
          sha256: hex_(
            Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, bytes),
          ),
        });
      }
    });
  var body = {
    version: 1,
    kind: "BACKUP",
    environment: "dev",
    installationId: c.installationId,
    id: id,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    properties: properties,
    sheets: sheets,
    folders: folders,
    assets: assets,
  };
  if (Utilities.newBlob(JSON.stringify(body)).getBytes().length > 22000000)
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CAPACITY");
  return body;
}
function maintenanceBackup_(c, id) {
  if (!identityUuid_(id)) maintenanceFail_();
  var folder = maintenanceFolder_(c),
    name = "maintenance-backup-" + id + ".json",
    it = folder.getFilesByName(name),
    files = [];
  while (it.hasNext()) files.push(it.next());
  if (files.length > 1) maintenanceFail_();
  if (files.length) {
    var prior = maintenanceRead_(files[0].getId());
    if (prior.kind !== "BACKUP" || prior.id !== id) maintenanceFail_();
    return { fileId: files[0].getId(), hash: digest_(JSON.stringify(prior)) };
  }
  var snapshot = maintenanceSnapshot_(c, id),
    file = maintenanceWrite_(folder, name, snapshot);
  return { fileId: file.getId(), hash: digest_(JSON.stringify(snapshot)) };
}
function backupDevelopmentInstallation(commandId) {
  var c = maintenanceGuard_();
  return withLock_(function () {
    var saved = maintenanceBackup_(c, commandId);
    var body = maintenanceRead_(saved.fileId);
    maintenanceLog_(commandId, body.createdAt, "MAINTENANCE_BACKUP", {
      count: body.sheets.length,
    });
    return { environment: "dev", backupId: saved.fileId, hash: saved.hash };
  });
}
function maintenanceWithCopy_(body, aliases, fn) {
  if (MAINTENANCE_CONTEXT_) maintenanceFail_();
  var values = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(body.properties));
  MAINTENANCE_CONTEXT_ = {
    aliases: aliases,
    properties: {
      getProperties: function () {
        return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(values));
      },
      getProperty: function (k) {
        return values[k] || null;
      },
      setProperty: function (k, v) {
        values[k] = v;
      },
      deleteProperty: function (k) {
        delete values[k];
      },
    },
  };
  try {
    return fn(baseSettings_());
  } finally {
    MAINTENANCE_CONTEXT_ = null;
  }
}
function maintenanceSettle_(c) {
  var p = scriptProperties_(),
    ss = storage_(c, false).spreadsheet;
  if (p.getProperty("IDENTITY_CONTROL_SPREADSHEET_ID")) {
    recoverEmergencyRecovery_(c);
    recoverKeyManagement_(c);
    recoverSecurityIntent_(c);
    recoverStaff_(c);
    recoverProfiles_(c);
    recoverRecoveryIntents_(c);
    recoverEmailChanges_(c);
    recoverNiches_(c);
    recoverSchedules_(c);
    accessRecoverIntents_(authControlStore_(c), c, Date.now());
  }
  if (p.getProperty("CATALOG_JOURNAL_ID")) {
    recoverCatalog_(c);
    recoverSales_(ss);
  }
}
function restoreDevelopmentCopy(backupId, commandId) {
  var c = maintenanceGuard_();
  return withLock_(function () {
    if (!identityUuid_(commandId)) maintenanceFail_();
    var body = maintenanceRead_(backupId);
    if (body.kind !== "BACKUP" || body.version !== 1) maintenanceFail_();
    var folder = maintenanceFolder_(c),
      name = "maintenance-restore-" + commandId + ".json",
      existing = folder.getFilesByName(name);
    if (existing.hasNext()) {
      var previous = maintenanceRead_(existing.next().getId());
      if (previous.source !== backupId)
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
      maintenanceLog_(commandId, previous.createdAt, "MAINTENANCE_RESTORE", {
        count: body.sheets.length,
      });
      return {
        environment: "dev",
        restoreId: previous.id,
        isolated: true,
        recovered: previous.recovered,
      };
    }
    var root = folder.createFolder("Restore DEV " + commandId);
    root.setDescription(marker_(c, "root"));
    var aliases = {},
      cloneFolders = {};
    aliases[body.properties.DRIVE_ROOT_ID] = root.getId();
    var backups = root.createFolder("backups");
    backups.setDescription(marker_(c, "backups"));
    aliases[body.properties.BACKUPS_FOLDER_ID] = backups.getId();
    body.folders.forEach(function (f) {
      var next = root.createFolder(f.kind);
      next.setDescription(marker_(c, f.kind));
      aliases[f.id] = next.getId();
      cloneFolders[f.id] = next;
    });
    body.sheets.forEach(function (s) {
      var ss = SpreadsheetApp.create("Restore " + s.kind + " " + commandId),
        file = DriveApp.getFileById(ss.getId());
      file.setDescription(marker_(c, s.kind));
      file.moveTo(root);
      aliases[s.id] = ss.getId();
      s.tables.forEach(function (t) {
        var sheet = ss.getSheetByName(t.name) || ss.insertSheet(t.name);
        if (t.rows.length) {
          var range = sheet.getRange(1, 1, t.rows.length, t.rows[0].length);
          range.setNumberFormat("@");
          range.setValues(t.rows);
        }
      });
      ss.getSheets()
        .filter(function (t) {
          return !s.tables.some(function (saved) {
            return saved.name === t.getName();
          });
        })
        .forEach(function (t) {
          ss.deleteSheet(t);
        });
    });
    body.assets.forEach(function (a) {
      var bytes = Utilities.base64Decode(a.bytes);
      if (
        hex_(
          Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, bytes),
        ) !== a.sha256 ||
        !cloneFolders[a.folder]
      )
        maintenanceFail_();
      var file = cloneFolders[a.folder].createFile(
        Utilities.newBlob(bytes, a.mime, a.name),
      );
      file.setDescription(a.description);
      aliases[a.id] = file.getId();
    });
    var recovered = maintenanceWithCopy_(body, aliases, function (copy) {
      assertSchema_(storage_(copy, true).spreadsheet);
      body.sheets.forEach(function (s) {
        if (!same_(maintenanceTables_(resourceSheet_(s.id)), s.tables))
          maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
      });
      maintenanceSettle_(copy);
      return {
        properties: scriptProperties_().getProperties(),
        tables: body.sheets.map(function (s) {
          return {
            id: s.id,
            hash: digest_(
              JSON.stringify(maintenanceTables_(resourceSheet_(s.id))),
            ),
          };
        }),
      };
    });
    var result = {
      version: 1,
      kind: "RESTORE",
      environment: "dev",
      installationId: c.installationId,
      id: commandId,
      source: backupId,
      aliases: aliases,
      recovered: true,
      restoredProperties: recovered.properties,
      tableHashes: recovered.tables,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    maintenanceWrite_(folder, name, result);
    maintenanceLog_(commandId, result.createdAt, "MAINTENANCE_RESTORE", {
      count: body.sheets.length,
    });
    return {
      environment: "dev",
      restoreId: commandId,
      isolated: true,
      recovered: true,
    };
  });
}
function maintenanceCommandUnused_(id) {
  if (
    identityRows_(
      storage_(baseSettings_(), false).spreadsheet,
      "Logs_Auditoria",
    ).rows.some(function (r) {
      return r.ID_Log === id;
    })
  )
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
}
function maintenanceQuiescent_() {
  var p = scriptProperties_().getProperties();
  if (
    Object.keys(p).some(function (k) {
      return /_PENDING$/.test(k) && p[k];
    })
  )
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_PENDING");
  var ss = storage_(baseSettings_(), false).spreadsheet;
  assertSchema_(ss);
  ss.getSheets().forEach(function (s) {
    var values = s.getLastRow()
        ? s.getRange(1, 1, s.getLastRow(), s.getLastColumn()).getValues()
        : [],
      col = values.length ? values[0].indexOf("State") : -1;
    if (
      col >= 0 &&
      values.slice(1).some(function (r) {
        return ["PENDING", "COMMITTING", "PROVING"].includes(r[col]);
      })
    )
      maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_PENDING");
  });
  if (
    p.IDENTITY_CONTROL_SPREADSHEET_ID &&
    accessFlows_(authControlStore_(baseSettings_())).rows.some(function (r) {
      return r.State === "COMMITTING";
    })
  )
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_PENDING");
  Object.keys(p)
    .filter(function (k) {
      return /^IDENTITY_KEYS_[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(k);
    })
    .forEach(function (k) {
      if (
        ["PROVING", "COMMITTING"].includes(
          keyFlowRead_(baseSettings_(), k.slice("IDENTITY_KEYS_".length)).state,
        )
      )
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_PENDING");
    });
  var configs = identityRows_(ss, "Configuracoes");
  if (
    configs.rows.some(function (r) {
      if (typeof r.Valor !== "string" || r.Valor[0] !== "{") return false;
      try {
        return ["PENDING", "COMMITTING", "PROVING"].includes(
          JSON.parse(r.Valor).state,
        );
      } catch (_) {
        return false;
      }
    })
  )
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_PENDING");
  if (
    p.CATALOG_JOURNAL_ID &&
    catalogJournal_(baseSettings_()).rows.some(function (r) {
      return r.State !== "COMPLETE";
    })
  )
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_PENDING");
}
function reconcileDevelopmentInstallation(commandId) {
  var c = maintenanceGuard_();
  return withLock_(function () {
    var old = identityRows_(
      storage_(c, false).spreadsheet,
      "Logs_Auditoria",
    ).rows.filter(function (r) {
      return r.ID_Log === commandId;
    });
    if (old.length) {
      if (old.length !== 1 || old[0].Acao !== "MAINTENANCE_RECONCILED")
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
      return {
        environment: "dev",
        reconciled: true,
        backupId: maintenanceBackup_(c, commandId).fileId,
      };
    }
    var backup = maintenanceBackup_(c, commandId);
    maintenanceSettle_(c);
    maintenanceQuiescent_();
    maintenanceLog_(
      commandId,
      maintenanceRead_(backup.fileId).createdAt,
      "MAINTENANCE_RECONCILED",
      { otherSessionsRevoked: false },
    );
    return { environment: "dev", reconciled: true, backupId: backup.fileId };
  });
}
function endDevelopmentMaintenance() {
  maintenanceGuard_();
  return withLock_(function () {
    maintenanceQuiescent_();
    scriptProperties_().setProperty("MAINTENANCE_MODE", "false");
    return { environment: "dev", maintenance: false };
  });
}
function maintenanceFinishMarker_(property, commandId, kind) {
  var props = scriptProperties_(),
    pointer = props.getProperty(property);
  if (!pointer) return;
  var plan = maintenanceRead_(pointer);
  if (plan.id !== commandId || plan.kind !== kind)
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
  props.setProperty(property, "");
}
function rotateDevelopmentSigningKey(commandId) {
  var c = maintenanceGuard_(true);
  return withLock_(function () {
    var props = scriptProperties_(),
      pointer = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_ROTATION_PENDING"),
      plan;
    var last = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_LAST_ROTATION");
    if (last) {
      last = JSON.parse(last);
      if (last.id === commandId) {
        var staged = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_NEXT_SIGNING_SECRET");
        if (
          digest_(props.getProperty("SIGNING_SECRET")) !== last.afterHash ||
          (staged && digest_(staged) !== last.afterHash)
        )
          maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
        maintenanceFinishMarker_(
          "MAINTENANCE_ROTATION_PENDING",
          commandId,
          "ROTATION",
        );
        return {
          environment: "dev",
          rotated: true,
          backupId: last.backupId,
          backendConfigurationRequired: true,
        };
      }
    }
    if (pointer) {
      plan = maintenanceRead_(pointer);
      if (plan.kind !== "ROTATION" || plan.id !== commandId)
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
    } else {
      if (!identityUuid_(commandId)) maintenanceFail_();
      maintenanceCommandUnused_(commandId);
      maintenanceQuiescent_();
      var next = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_NEXT_SIGNING_SECRET");
      if (!accessHash_(next) || next === c.secret || next === maintenanceKey_())
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFIGURATION");
      var backup = maintenanceBackup_(c, commandId),
        all = props.getProperties(),
        changes = {};
      Object.keys(all)
        .sort()
        .forEach(function (k) {
          var domain, v;
          if (/^IDENTITY_KEYS_[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(k)) {
            v = keyFlowRead_(c, k.slice("IDENTITY_KEYS_".length));
            domain = "passkey.management";
            if (
              ["PROVING", "COMMITTING"].includes(v.state) ||
              (["AUTH", "REGISTER"].includes(v.state) &&
                Date.parse(v.expiresAt) > Date.now())
            )
              maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_PENDING");
            if (["AUTH", "REGISTER"].includes(v.state)) v.state = "CANCELLED";
          } else if (/^IDENTITY_RESCUE_CODES_[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(k)) {
            v = emergencyKit_(c, k.slice("IDENTITY_RESCUE_CODES_".length));
            domain = "emergency.codes";
          } else return;
          var clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
          delete clone.hash;
          v.hash = hmac_(JSON.stringify(clone), next, domain);
          changes[k] = JSON.stringify(v);
        });
      plan = {
        version: 1,
        kind: "ROTATION",
        environment: "dev",
        installationId: c.installationId,
        id: commandId,
        backupId: backup.fileId,
        before: c.secret,
        after: next,
        changes: changes,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      var f = maintenanceWrite_(
        maintenanceFolder_(c),
        "maintenance-rotation-" + commandId + ".json",
        plan,
      );
      props.setProperty("MAINTENANCE_ROTATION_PENDING", f.getId());
    }
    if (
      ![plan.before, plan.after].includes(props.getProperty("SIGNING_SECRET"))
    )
      maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
    Object.keys(plan.changes).forEach(function (k) {
      props.setProperty(k, plan.changes[k]);
    });
    props.setProperty("SIGNING_SECRET", plan.after);
    props.deleteProperty("MAINTENANCE_NEXT_SIGNING_SECRET");
    maintenanceLog_(commandId, plan.createdAt, "MAINTENANCE_KEY_ROTATED", {
      count: Object.keys(plan.changes).length,
    });
    props.setProperty(
      "MAINTENANCE_LAST_ROTATION",
      JSON.stringify({
        id: commandId,
        at: plan.createdAt,
        backupId: plan.backupId,
        afterHash: digest_(plan.after),
      }),
    );
    props.setProperty("MAINTENANCE_ROTATION_PENDING", "");
    return {
      environment: "dev",
      rotated: true,
      backupId: plan.backupId,
      backendConfigurationRequired: true,
    };
  });
}
/* Only expired technical records are compacted. Business/audit/journal rows stay intact. */
function compactDevelopmentTechnicalRecords(commandId, cutoff) {
  var c = maintenanceGuard_(true);
  return withLock_(function () {
    var props = scriptProperties_(),
      pointer = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_COMPACTION_PENDING"),
      plan;
    if (pointer) {
      plan = maintenanceRead_(pointer);
      if (
        plan.kind !== "COMPACTION" ||
        plan.id !== commandId ||
        plan.cutoff !== cutoff
      )
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
    } else {
      if (
        !identityUuid_(commandId) ||
        typeof cutoff !== "string" ||
        !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(cutoff)) ||
        new Date(cutoff).toISOString() !== cutoff ||
        Date.parse(cutoff) > Date.now() - 30 * 86400000
      )
        maintenanceFail_();
      var last = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_LAST_COMPACTION");
      if (last) {
        last = JSON.parse(last);
        if (last.id === commandId) {
          if (last.cutoff !== cutoff) maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
          return {
            environment: "dev",
            compacted: last.removed,
            backupId: last.backupId,
          };
        }
      }
      maintenanceCommandUnused_(commandId);
      maintenanceQuiescent_();
      var backup = maintenanceBackup_(c, commandId),
        changes = [],
        removed = 0;
      var sources = [
        { id: c.spreadsheetId, name: "Sessoes", time: "Expira_Em" },
        { id: c.spreadsheetId, name: "_Requisicoes", time: null },
      ];
      var priv = props.getProperty("IDENTITY_CONTROL_SPREADSHEET_ID");
      if (priv) {
        sources.push({
          id: priv,
          name: "_Auth_Challenges",
          time: "Expires_At",
        });
        sources.push({ id: priv, name: "_Identity_Flows", time: "Expires_At" });
      }
      var pinned = new Set(),
        all = props.getProperties();
      Object.keys(all)
        .filter(function (k) {
          return /^IDENTITY_RESCUE_CODES_[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(k);
        })
        .forEach(function (k) {
          emergencyKit_(
            c,
            k.slice("IDENTITY_RESCUE_CODES_".length),
          ).entries.forEach(function (e) {
            if (e.flowId) pinned.add(e.flowId);
          });
        });
      sources.forEach(function (source) {
        var sheet = resourceSheet_(source.id).getSheetByName(source.name);
        if (!sheet) return;
        var values = maintenanceTables_(resourceSheet_(source.id)).filter(
          function (t) {
            return t.name === source.name;
          },
        )[0].rows;
        if (!values.length) return;
        var cols = values[0],
          index = source.time ? cols.indexOf(source.time) : 2,
          id = cols.indexOf("ID"),
          state = cols.indexOf("State");
        if (index < 0) maintenanceFail_();
        var keep = values.slice(1).filter(function (row) {
          var at = row[index];
          if (typeof at !== "string" || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(at)))
            maintenanceFail_();
          if (
            Date.parse(at) >= Date.parse(cutoff) ||
            (id >= 0 && pinned.has(row[id])) ||
            (state >= 0 && ["COMMITTING", "PROVING"].includes(row[state]))
          )
            return true;
          return false;
        });
        removed += values.length - 1 - keep.length;
        if (keep.length !== values.length - 1)
          changes.push({
            resource: source.id,
            table: source.name,
            columns: cols,
            before: values.length,
            after: [cols].concat(keep),
          });
      });
      plan = {
        version: 1,
        kind: "COMPACTION",
        environment: "dev",
        installationId: c.installationId,
        id: commandId,
        cutoff: cutoff,
        backupId: backup.fileId,
        removed: removed,
        changes: changes,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      var file = maintenanceWrite_(
        maintenanceFolder_(c),
        "maintenance-compaction-" + commandId + ".json",
        plan,
      );
      props.setProperty("MAINTENANCE_COMPACTION_PENDING", file.getId());
    }
    plan.changes.forEach(function (change) {
      var sheet = resourceSheet_(change.resource).getSheetByName(change.table);
      if (!same_(rowValues_(sheet), change.columns))
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
      var range = sheet.getRange(
        1,
        1,
        change.after.length,
        change.columns.length,
      );
      range.setNumberFormat("@");
      range.setValues(change.after);
      if (change.before > change.after.length)
        sheet
          .getRange(
            change.after.length + 1,
            1,
            change.before - change.after.length,
            change.columns.length,
          )
          .clearContent();
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    });
    maintenanceLog_(commandId, plan.createdAt, "MAINTENANCE_COMPACTED", {
      count: plan.removed,
    });
    props.setProperty(
      "MAINTENANCE_LAST_COMPACTION",
      JSON.stringify({
        id: commandId,
        cutoff: cutoff,
        removed: plan.removed,
        backupId: plan.backupId,
      }),
    );
    props.setProperty("MAINTENANCE_COMPACTION_PENDING", "");
    return {
      environment: "dev",
      compacted: plan.removed,
      backupId: plan.backupId,
    };
  });
}
function maintenanceLog_(id, at, action, detail) {
  var ss = storage_(baseSettings_(), false).spreadsheet;
  securityAppend_(
    ss,
    securityLog_(id, at, "SYSTEM_AUTH", "SYSTEM", action, detail),
  );
  var titles = {
      MAINTENANCE_BACKUP: "Cópia de segurança criada",
      MAINTENANCE_RESTORE: "Restauração isolada verificada",
      MAINTENANCE_RECONCILED: "Sincronização e diários conferidos",
      MAINTENANCE_KEY_ROTATED: "Chave de assinatura atualizada",
      MAINTENANCE_COMPACTED: "Registros técnicos arquivados",
      IDENTITY_ADMIN_RECOVERY: "Recuperação administrativa preparada",
    },
    table = notificationRows_(ss),
    prior = table.rows.filter(function (r) {
      return r.ID_Notificacao === id;
    }),
    row = {
      ID_Notificacao: id,
      Tipo: "MAINTENANCE_COMPLETED",
      Prioridade: "MEDIA",
      Titulo: titles[action] || "Manutenção administrativa concluída",
      Mensagem:
        "Procedimento administrativo registrado. Consulte a auditoria autorizada para conferir o resultado.",
      Entidade_Referencia: "Configuracoes",
      ID_Referencia: id,
      Status: "ABERTA",
      Criado_Em: at,
      Resolvido_Em: "",
      Resolvido_Por: "",
    };
  if (
    prior.length > 1 ||
    (prior.length &&
      !table.columns.every(function (k) {
        return prior[0][k] === row[k];
      }))
  )
    maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
  if (!prior.length) notificationWrite_(table, row);
}
/* Google owner verification is the trust root when application factors are lost.
 * Re-enrollment still requires the NEW mailbox code, a fresh PIN and a new passkey. */
function recoverDevelopmentOwnerAccess(commandId, newEmail, caseReference) {
  var c = maintenanceGuard_(true);
  return withLock_(function () {
    var props = scriptProperties_(),
      email = accessEmail_(newEmail);
    if (
      !identityUuid_(commandId) ||
      typeof caseReference !== "string" ||
      !/^CASE-[A-Z0-9-]{8,80}$/.test(caseReference)
    )
      maintenanceFail_();
    var fingerprint = digest_(
        JSON.stringify([commandId, email, caseReference]),
      ),
      last = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_LAST_OWNER_RECOVERY");
    if (last) {
      last = JSON.parse(last);
      if (last.id === commandId) {
        if (last.fingerprint !== fingerprint)
          maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
        maintenanceFinishMarker_(
          "MAINTENANCE_RECOVERY_PENDING",
          commandId,
          "OWNER_RECOVERY",
        );
        return {
          environment: "dev",
          reenrollmentRequired: true,
          backupId: last.backupId,
        };
      }
    }
    var pointer = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_RECOVERY_PENDING"),
      plan;
    if (pointer) {
      plan = maintenanceRead_(pointer);
      if (
        plan.kind !== "OWNER_RECOVERY" ||
        plan.id !== commandId ||
        plan.fingerprint !== fingerprint
      )
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
    } else {
      maintenanceCommandUnused_(commandId);
      maintenanceQuiescent_();
      var owner = accessOwner_(c);
      if (!owner || owner.row.Perfil !== "SUPER_ADMIN") maintenanceFail_();
      var indexKey = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_PERSONAL_INDEX_KEY");
      if (
        !accessHash_(indexKey) ||
        [c.secret, maintenanceKey_()].includes(indexKey) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(owner.version + 1)
      )
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFIGURATION");
      var emailIndex = hex_(
        Utilities.computeHmacSha256Signature(
          Utilities.newBlob(
            JSON.stringify([
              "index.v1",
              c.environment,
              c.installationId,
              "email",
              email,
            ]),
          ).getBytes(),
          secretBytes_(indexKey),
        ),
      );
      var users = staffUsers_(storage_(c, false).spreadsheet);
      if (
        users.rows.some(function (u) {
          return (
            u.ID_Usuario !== owner.row.ID_Usuario &&
            u.Email_Indice === emailIndex
          );
        })
      )
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
      var backup = maintenanceBackup_(c, commandId);
      plan = {
        version: 1,
        kind: "OWNER_RECOVERY",
        environment: "dev",
        installationId: c.installationId,
        id: commandId,
        userId: owner.row.ID_Usuario,
        epoch: owner.version + 1,
        email: email,
        emailIndex: emailIndex,
        fingerprint: fingerprint,
        caseHash: digest_(caseReference),
        backupId: backup.fileId,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      var file = maintenanceWrite_(
        maintenanceFolder_(c),
        "maintenance-owner-" + commandId + ".json",
        plan,
      );
      props.setProperty("MAINTENANCE_RECOVERY_PENDING", file.getId());
    }
    var main = storage_(c, false).spreadsheet,
      owner = accessOwner_(c);
    if (
      !owner ||
      owner.row.ID_Usuario !== plan.userId ||
      ![plan.epoch - 1, plan.epoch].includes(owner.version)
    )
      maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
    staffPut_(
      main,
      "identity.version." + plan.userId,
      plan.epoch,
      plan.createdAt,
      "SYSTEM_AUTH",
    );
    var sessions = identityRows_(main, "Sessoes");
    sessions.rows
      .filter(function (r) {
        return r.ID_Usuario === plan.userId && !r.Revogado_Em;
      })
      .forEach(function (r) {
        r.Revogado_Em = plan.createdAt;
        accessSaveMain_(sessions, r);
      });
    var priv = authControlStore_(c),
      keys = passkeyCredentials_(priv);
    keys.rows
      .filter(function (r) {
        return r.Subject_ID === plan.userId && !r.Revoked_At;
      })
      .forEach(function (r) {
        r.Revoked_At = plan.createdAt;
        authControlSave_(keys, r);
      });
    var flows = accessFlows_(priv);
    flows.rows
      .filter(function (r) {
        return (
          r.Subject_ID === plan.userId &&
          !["COMPLETE", "REVOKED"].includes(r.State)
        );
      })
      .forEach(function (r) {
        r.State = "REVOKED";
        r.Pin_JSON = "";
        authControlSave_(flows, r);
      });
    var keyFlow = keyFlowRead_(c, plan.userId);
    if (keyFlow) {
      keyFlow.state = "CANCELLED";
      keyFlow.key = null;
      keyFlow.codes = null;
      keyFlowSave_(c, keyFlow);
    }
    var kit = emergencyKit_(c, plan.userId);
    if (kit) {
      kit.state = "INVALID";
      emergencySave_(
        c,
        "IDENTITY_RESCUE_CODES_" + plan.userId,
        kit,
        "emergency.codes",
      );
    }
    props.setProperty("IDENTITY_OWNER_LOGIN_EMAIL", plan.email);
    owner.row.Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido = false;
    owner.row.Email_Indice = plan.emailIndex;
    accessSaveMain_(owner.users, owner.row);
    maintenanceLog_(commandId, plan.createdAt, "IDENTITY_ADMIN_RECOVERY", {
      authorizationVersion: plan.epoch,
      otherSessionsRevoked: true,
      reenrollmentRequired: true,
      reasonRecorded: true,
    });
    props.setProperty(
      "MAINTENANCE_LAST_OWNER_RECOVERY",
      JSON.stringify({
        id: commandId,
        fingerprint: fingerprint,
        backupId: plan.backupId,
      }),
    );
    props.deleteProperty("MAINTENANCE_PERSONAL_INDEX_KEY");
    props.setProperty("MAINTENANCE_RECOVERY_PENDING", "");
    return {
      environment: "dev",
      reenrollmentRequired: true,
      backupId: plan.backupId,
    };
  });
}
function inspectDevelopmentRestore(commandId) {
  var c = maintenanceGuard_();
  return withLock_(function () {
    if (!identityUuid_(commandId)) maintenanceFail_();
    var it = maintenanceFolder_(c).getFilesByName(
      "maintenance-restore-" + commandId + ".json",
    );
    if (!it.hasNext()) maintenanceFail_();
    var restored = maintenanceRead_(it.next().getId());
    if (
      it.hasNext() ||
      restored.kind !== "RESTORE" ||
      !restored.recovered ||
      !restored.restoredProperties ||
      !Array.isArray(restored.tableHashes)
    )
      maintenanceFail_();
    var source = maintenanceRead_(restored.source);
    var checked = maintenanceWithCopy_(
      { properties: restored.restoredProperties },
      restored.aliases,
      function (copy) {
        assertSchema_(storage_(copy, true).spreadsheet);
        restored.tableHashes.forEach(function (t) {
          if (
            !restored.aliases[t.id] ||
            restored.aliases[t.id] === t.id ||
            digest_(
              JSON.stringify(maintenanceTables_(resourceSheet_(t.id))),
            ) !== t.hash
          )
            maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
        });
        source.assets.forEach(function (a) {
          if (
            hex_(
              Utilities.computeDigest(
                Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,
                resourceFile_(a.id).getBlob().getBytes(),
              ),
            ) !== a.sha256
          )
            maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
        });
        return true;
      },
    );
    return {
      environment: "dev",
      isolated: true,
      verified: checked,
      sheets: restored.tableHashes.length,
      assets: source.assets.length,
    };
  });
}
/* Opt-in schedule: installed only by the Google owner; no trigger is installed by publication. */
function installDevelopmentBackupSchedule(hours) {
  var c = maintenanceOwner_();
  return withLock_(function () {
    maintenanceKey_();
    maintenanceFolder_(c);
    if (![1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24].includes(hours)) maintenanceFail_();
    var props = scriptProperties_(),
      raw = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_BACKUP_SCHEDULE"),
      prior = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    var existing = ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().filter(function (t) {
      return t.getHandlerFunction() === "runDevelopmentBackupJob";
    });
    if (existing.length) {
      if (
        existing.length !== 1 ||
        !prior ||
        prior.id !== existing[0].getUniqueId() ||
        prior.hours !== hours ||
        !prior.enabled
      )
        maintenanceFail_("MAINTENANCE_CONFLICT");
      return { environment: "dev", scheduled: true, hours: hours };
    }
    var trigger = ScriptApp.newTrigger("runDevelopmentBackupJob")
      .timeBased()
      .everyHours(hours)
      .create();
    props.setProperty(
      "MAINTENANCE_BACKUP_SCHEDULE",
      JSON.stringify({
        id: trigger.getUniqueId(),
        hours: hours,
        enabled: true,
      }),
    );
    return { environment: "dev", scheduled: true, hours: hours };
  });
}
function removeDevelopmentBackupSchedule() {
  maintenanceOwner_();
  return withLock_(function () {
    var props = scriptProperties_(),
      raw = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_BACKUP_SCHEDULE"),
      p = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    if (!p) return { environment: "dev", scheduled: false };
    p.enabled = false;
    props.setProperty("MAINTENANCE_BACKUP_SCHEDULE", JSON.stringify(p));
    ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()
      .filter(function (t) {
        return (
          t.getUniqueId() === p.id &&
          t.getHandlerFunction() === "runDevelopmentBackupJob"
        );
      })
      .forEach(function (t) {
        ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t);
      });
    return { environment: "dev", scheduled: false };
  });
}
function runDevelopmentBackupJob(event) {
  var c = baseSettings_(),
    props = scriptProperties_(),
    raw = props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_BACKUP_SCHEDULE"),
    p = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  if (
    c.environment !== "dev" ||
    Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase() !== c.owner ||
    !p ||
    !p.enabled ||
    !event ||
    event.triggerUid !== p.id ||
    ![1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24].includes(p.hours) ||
    !ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().some(function (t) {
      return (
        t.getUniqueId() === p.id &&
        t.getHandlerFunction() === "runDevelopmentBackupJob"
      );
    })
  )
    maintenanceFail_("FORBIDDEN");
  return withLock_(function () {
    if (props.getProperty("MAINTENANCE_MODE") === "true")
      return { environment: "dev", skipped: true };
    var hash = digest_(
        JSON.stringify([
          "scheduled-backup.v1",
          c.installationId,
          p.id,
          Math.floor(Date.now() / (p.hours * 3600000)),
        ]),
      ),
      id =
        hash.slice(0, 8) +
        "-" +
        hash.slice(8, 12) +
        "-4" +
        hash.slice(13, 16) +
        "-8" +
        hash.slice(17, 20) +
        "-" +
        hash.slice(20, 32);
    var saved = maintenanceBackup_(c, id),
      body = maintenanceRead_(saved.fileId);
    maintenanceLog_(id, body.createdAt, "MAINTENANCE_BACKUP", {
      count: body.sheets.length,
    });
    return { environment: "dev", backedUp: true };
  });
}

// BEGIN Notifications.gs sha256=8fbf55eb4c9fa90fc1d47fb108f029172a534d5184a1242228450940b946c4fe
/* DEV stock alerts and replenishment reports. Caller holds ScriptLock. */
function notificationEnabled_() { return scriptProperties_().getProperty('NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED') === 'true'; }
function notificationTime_(value) { return typeof value === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)); }
function notificationId_(product) {
  var c = baseSettings_(), hash = digest_(JSON.stringify(['stock-alert.v1', c.installationId, product.ID_Produto, product.Versao_Registro]));
  return hash.slice(0, 8) + '-' + hash.slice(8, 12) + '-4' + hash.slice(13, 16) + '-8' + hash.slice(17, 20) + '-' + hash.slice(20, 32);
}
function notificationRows_(ss) {
  var table = identityRows_(ss, 'Notificacoes'), ids = new Set(), open = new Set();
  if (table.rows.length > 5000) failure_('NOTIFICATION_CAPACITY');
  table.rows.forEach(function (row) {
    var maintenance=row.Tipo==='MAINTENANCE_COMPLETED',stock=['STOCK_ZERO','STOCK_LOW'].includes(row.Tipo),schedule=['SCHEDULE_PUBLISHED','SCHEDULE_CHANGED','SCHEDULE_CANCELLED'].includes(row.Tipo);
    if(!saleUuid_(row.ID_Notificacao)||ids.has(row.ID_Notificacao)||!stock&&!schedule&&!maintenance||!saleUuid_(row.ID_Referencia)||!notificationTime_(row.Criado_Em))failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');
    if(stock&&(!['ALTA','MEDIA'].includes(row.Prioridade)||row.Entidade_Referencia!=='Produtos'||!['ABERTA','EM_ATENDIMENTO','RESOLVIDA'].includes(row.Status)||row.Status==='RESOLVIDA'&&(!notificationTime_(row.Resolvido_Em)||row.Resolvido_Por!=='SYSTEM_STOCK')||row.Status!=='RESOLVIDA'&&(row.Resolvido_Em!==''||row.Resolvido_Por!=='')))failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');
    if(schedule&&(row.Prioridade!=='MEDIA'||row.Entidade_Referencia!=='Escalas'||row.Status!=='ABERTA'||row.Resolvido_Em!==''||row.Resolvido_Por!==''))failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');
    if(maintenance&&(row.Prioridade!=='MEDIA'||row.Entidade_Referencia!=='Configuracoes'||row.Status!=='ABERTA'||row.Resolvido_Em!==''||row.Resolvido_Por!==''))failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');
    catalogText_(row.Titulo,300,true);catalogText_(row.Mensagem,300,true);ids.add(row.ID_Notificacao);
    if(stock&&row.Status!=='RESOLVIDA'){if(open.has(row.ID_Referencia))failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');open.add(row.ID_Referencia);}
  }); return table;
}
function notificationReads_(ss) {
  var table = identityRows_(ss, 'Notificacoes_Usuarios'), keys = new Set();
  if (table.rows.length > 5000) failure_('NOTIFICATION_CAPACITY');
  table.rows.forEach(function (row) {
    var key = row.ID_Notificacao + ':' + row.ID_Usuario;
    if (!saleUuid_(row.ID_Notificacao) || !saleUuid_(row.ID_Usuario) || keys.has(key) || !notificationTime_(row.Lida_Em) || row.Confirmada_Em !== '') failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE'); keys.add(key);
  }); return table;
}
function notificationWrite_(table, row) {
  var values = table.columns.map(function (key) { return row[key]; });
  if (row.number) table.sheet.getRange(row.number, 1, 1, values.length).setValues([values]);
  else { table.sheet.appendRow(values); row.number = table.sheet.getLastRow(); table.rows.push(row); }
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
}
function notificationStateCommands_(audit, notifications) {
  var latest = {}, ids = new Set();
  saleObjects_(audit).filter(function (row) { return row.Acao === 'STOCK_ALERT_STATE'; }).forEach(function (row) {
    var data; try { data = JSON.parse(row.Depois); } catch (_) { failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE'); }
    if (!saleUuid_(row.ID_Log) || ids.has(row.ID_Log) || !saleUuid_(row.ID_Usuario) || !['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(row.Perfil) || row.Entidade !== 'Notificacoes' ||
        !saleUuid_(row.ID_Entidade) || !notificationTime_(row.Data_Hora) || row.Resultado !== 'ACEITO' || row.ID_Requisicao !== row.ID_Log ||
        !data || !same_(Object.keys(data).sort(), ['id', 'state']) || data.id !== row.ID_Entidade || !['ABERTA', 'EM_ATENDIMENTO'].includes(data.state) ||
        !notifications.rows.some(function (n) { return n.ID_Notificacao === data.id; })) failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');
    ids.add(row.ID_Log); latest[data.id] = data.state;
  }); return latest;
}
function synchronizeStockNotifications_(ss) {
  if (!notificationEnabled_()) return;
  var allRows=notificationRows_(ss),table={sheet:allRows.sheet,columns:allRows.columns,rows:allRows.rows.filter(function(r){return r.Entidade_Referencia==='Produtos';})}, products = catalogProducts_(ss), audit = saleTable_(ss, 'Logs_Auditoria'), now = new Date().toISOString();
  if (products.rows.length > 5000 || audit.rows.length > 5000) failure_('NOTIFICATION_CAPACITY');
  var byProduct = {}, byId = {}, writes = [], logs = [];
  table.rows.forEach(function (row) { if (row.Status !== 'RESOLVIDA') byProduct[row.ID_Referencia] = row; byId[row.ID_Notificacao] = row; });
  products.rows.forEach(function (p) {
    catalogText_(p.Titulo, 300, true);
    if (!saleInteger_(p.Estoque_Minimo) || p.Estoque_Minimo > 1000000) failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');
    var type = p.Ativo && p.Estoque_Atual === 0 ? 'STOCK_ZERO' : p.Ativo && p.Estoque_Atual < p.Estoque_Minimo ? 'STOCK_LOW' : null, current = byProduct[p.ID_Produto];
    if (type) {
      if (current && current.Tipo !== type) {
        current.Status = 'RESOLVIDA'; current.Resolvido_Em = now; current.Resolvido_Por = 'SYSTEM_STOCK'; writes.push(current); current = null;
      }
      if (!current) {
        var id = notificationId_(p);
        // A resolved episode at this same version must not reopen by polling.
        if (byId[id]) failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');
        current = { ID_Notificacao: id, Tipo: type, Prioridade: type === 'STOCK_ZERO' ? 'ALTA' : 'MEDIA', Titulo: p.Titulo,
          Mensagem: 'Estoque atual: ' + p.Estoque_Atual + '. Estoque mínimo: ' + p.Estoque_Minimo + '.', Entidade_Referencia: 'Produtos', ID_Referencia: p.ID_Produto,
          Status: 'ABERTA', Criado_Em: now, Resolvido_Em: '', Resolvido_Por: '' };
        writes.push(current); byId[id] = current;
      } else if (current.Titulo !== p.Titulo || current.Mensagem !== 'Estoque atual: ' + p.Estoque_Atual + '. Estoque mínimo: ' + p.Estoque_Minimo + '.') {
        current.Tipo = type; current.Prioridade = type === 'STOCK_ZERO' ? 'ALTA' : 'MEDIA'; current.Titulo = p.Titulo;
        current.Mensagem = 'Estoque atual: ' + p.Estoque_Atual + '. Estoque mínimo: ' + p.Estoque_Minimo + '.'; writes.push(current);
      }
    } else if (current) { current.Status = 'RESOLVIDA'; current.Resolvido_Em = now; current.Resolvido_Por = 'SYSTEM_STOCK'; writes.push(current); }
  });
  // A product must be preserved by logical exclusion, never silently disappear.
  table.rows.forEach(function (row) { if (!products.rows.some(function (p) { return p.ID_Produto === row.ID_Referencia; })) failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE'); });
  var all = table.rows.concat(writes.filter(function (row) { return !row.number; }));
  all.forEach(function (row) {
    logs.push({ ID_Log: row.ID_Notificacao + ':opened', Data_Hora: row.Criado_Em, ID_Usuario: 'SYSTEM_STOCK', Perfil: 'SYSTEM', Acao: 'STOCK_ALERT_OPENED', Entidade: 'Notificacoes', ID_Entidade: row.ID_Notificacao,
      Antes: '', Depois: JSON.stringify({ productId: row.ID_Referencia }), Resultado: 'SUCESSO', ID_Requisicao: row.ID_Notificacao });
    if (row.Status === 'RESOLVIDA') logs.push({ ID_Log: row.ID_Notificacao + ':resolved', Data_Hora: row.Resolvido_Em, ID_Usuario: 'SYSTEM_STOCK', Perfil: 'SYSTEM', Acao: 'STOCK_ALERT_RESOLVED', Entidade: 'Notificacoes', ID_Entidade: row.ID_Notificacao,
      Antes: '', Depois: JSON.stringify({ productId: row.ID_Referencia }), Resultado: 'SUCESSO', ID_Requisicao: row.ID_Notificacao });
  });
  var states = notificationStateCommands_(audit, { rows: all });
  all.forEach(function (row) { if (row.Status !== 'RESOLVIDA' && states[row.ID_Notificacao] && row.Status !== states[row.ID_Notificacao]) { row.Status = states[row.ID_Notificacao]; if (writes.indexOf(row) < 0) writes.push(row); } });
  logs.forEach(function (log) { ensureSaleRow_(audit, ['ID_Log'], log, false); });
  var missing = logs.filter(function (log) { return !audit.rows.some(function (r) { return r[audit.columns.indexOf('ID_Log')] === log.ID_Log; }); }).length;
  if (all.length+allRows.rows.length-table.rows.length > 5000 || audit.rows.length + missing > 5000) failure_('NOTIFICATION_CAPACITY');
  writes.forEach(function (row) { notificationWrite_(table, row); });
  logs.forEach(function (log) { ensureSaleRow_(audit, ['ID_Log'], log, true); });
}
function notificationDto_(row, product, read) {
  return { id: row.ID_Notificacao, productId: row.ID_Referencia, type: row.Tipo, priority: row.Prioridade, title: row.Titulo, state: row.Status,
    createdAt: row.Criado_Em, resolvedAt: row.Resolvido_Em || null, read: !!read, stock: product.Estoque_Atual, minimumStock: product.Estoque_Minimo };
}
function stockReport_(request, ss, principal, notifications) {
  var p = request.payload;
  authControlExact_(p, ['scope', 'supplier', 'format']);
  if (!['zero', 'low'].includes(p.scope) || p.supplier !== null && (typeof p.supplier !== 'string' || p.supplier.length > 160) || !['view', 'csv', 'print', 'copy'].includes(p.format)) failure_('INVALID_NOTIFICATION');
  if (!['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(principal.role) || !['mfa', 'passkey'].includes(principal.assurance) || Date.now() - principal.authenticatedAt > 300000) failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  function supplier(value) { catalogText_(value, 160, false); return value.normalize('NFC').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); }
  var products = catalogProducts_(ss).rows, groups = Object.create(null), count = 0, units = 0, missing = 0;
  products.forEach(function (product) {
    if (!product.Ativo || !(product.Estoque_Atual === 0 || p.scope === 'low' && product.Estoque_Atual < product.Estoque_Minimo)) return;
    var name = supplier(product.Fornecedor), key = name.toLowerCase();
    if (p.supplier !== null && key !== supplier(p.supplier).toLowerCase()) return;
    if (!groups[key]) groups[key] = { supplier: name, items: [] };
    var open = notifications.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Referencia === product.ID_Produto && row.Status !== 'RESOLVIDA'; });
    if (open.length !== 1) failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');
    var suggested = Math.max(1, product.Estoque_Minimo - product.Estoque_Atual);
    groups[key].items.push({ id: product.ID_Produto, title: product.Titulo, isbn: product.ISBN, internalCode: product.Codigo_Interno,
      stock: product.Estoque_Atual, minimumStock: product.Estoque_Minimo, suggestedQuantity: suggested, alertState: open[0].Status, since: open[0].Criado_Em });
    count++; units += suggested; if (!name) missing++;
  });
  var data = { reportId: request.requestId, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), scope: p.scope, supplier: p.supplier,
    groups: Object.keys(groups).sort().map(function (key) { var group = groups[key]; group.items.sort(function (a, b) { return a.title.localeCompare(b.title) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id); }); return group; }),
    totalBooks: count, suggestedUnits: units, missingSupplier: missing };
  // Whole snapshot or explicit refusal; never silently truncate the order list.
  if (count > 5000 || Utilities.base64Encode(Utilities.newBlob(JSON.stringify(data)).getBytes()).length > 3500000) failure_('NOTIFICATION_CAPACITY');
  var audit = saleTable_(ss, 'Logs_Auditoria'); if (audit.rows.length >= 5000) failure_('NOTIFICATION_CAPACITY');
  ensureSaleRow_(audit, ['ID_Log'], { ID_Log: request.requestId, Data_Hora: data.generatedAt, ID_Usuario: principal.id, Perfil: principal.role,
    Acao: p.format === 'view' ? 'STOCK_REPORT_VIEW' : 'STOCK_REPORT_EXPORT', Entidade: 'Produtos', ID_Entidade: request.requestId,
    Antes: '', Depois: JSON.stringify({ scope: p.scope, supplier: p.supplier, format: p.format, books: count, suggestedUnits: units }), Resultado: 'SUCESSO', ID_Requisicao: request.requestId }, true);
  return data;
}
function notificationOperation_(request, c) {
  if (c.environment !== 'dev' || !request.actor || !same_(Object.keys(request.actor), ['sessionTokenHash']) || !accessHash_(request.actor.sessionTokenHash)) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  var principal = identitySessionOperation_({ action: 'identity.session.read', payload: { tokenHash: request.actor.sessionTokenHash } }, c);
  recoverCatalog_(c); var ss = storage_(c, false).spreadsheet; recoverSales_(ss);
  var table = notificationRows_(ss), reads = notificationReads_(ss), p = request.payload, operation = request.action.slice('notifications.'.length);
  var bindings=scheduleNotificationBindings_(ss);
  table.rows.forEach(function(n){if(n.Entidade_Referencia==='Escalas'){var binding=bindings.get(n.ID_Notificacao);if(!binding||binding.scheduleId!==n.ID_Referencia||binding.type!==n.Tipo)failure_('NOTIFICATIONS_UNAVAILABLE');}});
  table={sheet:table.sheet,columns:table.columns,rows:table.rows.filter(function(n){return n.Entidade_Referencia==='Produtos'||n.Entidade_Referencia==='Configuracoes'&&['ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(principal.role)||n.Entidade_Referencia==='Escalas'&&bindings.get(n.ID_Notificacao).userId===principal.id;})};
  var isRead=function(n){return reads.rows.some(function(r){return r.ID_Notificacao===n.ID_Notificacao&&r.ID_Usuario===principal.id;});},pending=function(n){return n.Entidade_Referencia!=='Produtos'?!isRead(n):n.Status!=='RESOLVIDA';};
  if (operation === 'report') return stockReport_(request, ss, principal, {rows:table.rows.filter(function(n){return n.Entidade_Referencia==='Produtos';})});
  if (operation === 'read') {
    authControlExact_(p, ['id']); if (!saleUuid_(p.id) || !table.rows.some(function (row) { return row.ID_Notificacao === p.id; })) failure_('NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND');
    var prior = reads.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Notificacao === p.id && row.ID_Usuario === principal.id; });
    if (!prior.length) { if (reads.rows.length >= 5000) failure_('NOTIFICATION_CAPACITY'); notificationWrite_(reads, { ID_Notificacao: p.id, ID_Usuario: principal.id, Lida_Em: new Date().toISOString(), Confirmada_Em: '' }); }
    return { read: true };
  }
  if (operation === 'state') {
    if (!['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(principal.role)) failure_('FORBIDDEN');
    authControlExact_(p, ['commandId', 'id', 'state']);
    if (!saleUuid_(p.commandId) || !saleUuid_(p.id) || !['ABERTA', 'EM_ATENDIMENTO'].includes(p.state)) failure_('INVALID_NOTIFICATION');
    var target = table.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Notificacao === p.id; })[0]; if (!target||target.Entidade_Referencia!=='Produtos') failure_('NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND');
    var audit = saleTable_(ss, 'Logs_Auditoria'), old = saleObjects_(audit).filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Log === p.commandId; });
    var after = JSON.stringify({ id: p.id, state: p.state });
    if (old.length) { if (old.length !== 1 || old[0].Acao !== 'STOCK_ALERT_STATE' || old[0].ID_Usuario !== principal.id || old[0].Depois !== after) failure_('NOTIFICATION_CONFLICT'); return { accepted: true }; }
    if (target.Status === 'RESOLVIDA') failure_('NOTIFICATION_CONFLICT');
    if (audit.rows.length >= 5000) failure_('NOTIFICATION_CAPACITY');
    ensureSaleRow_(audit, ['ID_Log'], { ID_Log: p.commandId, Data_Hora: new Date().toISOString(), ID_Usuario: principal.id, Perfil: principal.role,
      Acao: 'STOCK_ALERT_STATE', Entidade: 'Notificacoes', ID_Entidade: p.id, Antes: '', Depois: after, Resultado: 'ACEITO', ID_Requisicao: p.commandId }, true);
    synchronizeStockNotifications_(ss); return { accepted: true };
  }
  if (operation === 'summary') {
    authControlExact_(p, []); var active = table.rows.filter(pending);
    return { total: active.length, unread: active.filter(function (row) { return !reads.rows.some(function (r) { return r.ID_Notificacao === row.ID_Notificacao && r.ID_Usuario === principal.id; }); }).length };
  }
  if (operation !== 'list') failure_('FORBIDDEN'); authControlExact_(p, ['offset', 'history']);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(p.offset) || p.offset < 0 || p.offset > 5000 || typeof p.history !== 'boolean') failure_('INVALID_NOTIFICATION');
  var products = catalogProducts_(ss).rows, filtered = table.rows.filter(function (row) { return p.history || pending(row); });
  filtered.sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a.Status === 'RESOLVIDA') - Number(b.Status === 'RESOLVIDA') || Number(b.Prioridade === 'ALTA') - Number(a.Prioridade === 'ALTA') || a.Criado_Em.localeCompare(b.Criado_Em) || a.ID_Notificacao.localeCompare(b.ID_Notificacao); });
  var page = filtered.slice(p.offset, p.offset + 25);
  return { items: page.map(function (row) { if(row.Entidade_Referencia==='Configuracoes')return {id:row.ID_Notificacao,referenceId:row.ID_Referencia,type:row.Tipo,priority:row.Prioridade,title:row.Titulo,message:row.Mensagem,state:row.Status,createdAt:row.Criado_Em,resolvedAt:null,read:isRead(row)};if(row.Entidade_Referencia==='Escalas'){var b=bindings.get(row.ID_Notificacao);return {recipientId:b.userId,id:row.ID_Notificacao,scheduleId:row.ID_Referencia,type:row.Tipo,priority:row.Prioridade,title:row.Titulo,message:row.Mensagem,state:row.Status,createdAt:row.Criado_Em,resolvedAt:null,read:isRead(row),date:b.date,start:b.start,end:b.end};}return notificationDto_(row, products.filter(function (product) { return product.ID_Produto === row.ID_Referencia; })[0], isRead(row)); }),
    total: filtered.length, nextOffset: p.offset + page.length < filtered.length ? p.offset + page.length : null };
}

/* Administrative adjustments and integral reversals. Dispatcher owns ScriptLock.
 * No bank payment is performed. Committed events replay independently of flags. */
function operationCommand_(kind,p){
 var keys=kind==='adjust'?['commandId','expectedVersion','id','newStock','reason']:['commandId','reason','saleId'];authControlExact_(p,keys);
 if(!identityUuid_(p.commandId)||!identityUuid_(kind==='adjust'?p.id:p.saleId)||typeof p.reason!=='string'||!p.reason||p.reason!==p.reason.trim()||p.reason.length>300||/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(p.reason)||/^[=+@-]/.test(p.reason))failure_('INVALID_OPERATION');
 if(kind==='adjust'){if(!Number.isSafeInteger(p.expectedVersion)||p.expectedVersion<1||p.expectedVersion>=1000000000||!Number.isSafeInteger(p.newStock)||p.newStock<0||p.newStock>1000000)failure_('INVALID_OPERATION');return {commandId:p.commandId,id:p.id,expectedVersion:p.expectedVersion,newStock:p.newStock,reason:p.reason};}
 if(kind!=='reverse')failure_('INVALID_OPERATION');return {commandId:p.commandId,saleId:p.saleId,reason:p.reason};
}
function operationEvent_(e,row){
 if(!e||!['STOCK_ADJUSTED','SALE_REVERSED'].includes(e.type)||e.version!==1||!identityUuid_(e.actorId)||!['ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(e.actorRole)||!e.receipt||e.receipt.commandId!==e.idempotencyKey||!identityUuid_(e.idempotencyKey)||!Array.isArray(e.lines)||!e.lines.length||e.lines.length>100)failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
 authControlTime_(e.receipt.createdAt);var command;
 try{command=operationCommand_(e.type==='STOCK_ADJUSTED'?'adjust':'reverse',e.command);}catch(_){failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');}
 if(command.commandId!==e.idempotencyKey||digest_(JSON.stringify(command))!==e.commandHash||row.ID_Evento!==e.idempotencyKey||row.Chave_Idempotencia!==e.idempotencyKey||row.Tipo!==e.type||row.Hash_Comando!==e.commandHash||row.Versao_Esquema!==1||row.Criado_Em!==e.receipt.createdAt||row.Estado_Projecao!=='PENDENTE')failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
 var ids=new Set();e.lines.forEach(function(l){if(!identityUuid_(l.id)||ids.has(l.id)||!Number.isSafeInteger(l.expectedVersion)||l.expectedVersion<1||l.expectedVersion>=1000000000||![l.before,l.after].every(function(n){return Number.isSafeInteger(n)&&n>=0&&n<=1000000;})||l.before===l.after)failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');ids.add(l.id);});
 if(e.type==='STOCK_ADJUSTED'){var l=e.lines[0];if(e.lines.length!==1||l.id!==command.id||l.expectedVersion!==command.expectedVersion||l.after!==command.newStock||e.receipt.id!==l.id||e.receipt.stockBefore!==l.before||e.receipt.stockAfter!==l.after||e.receipt.version!==l.expectedVersion+1)failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');}
 else if(e.receipt.saleId!==command.saleId||e.receipt.state!=='CANCELADA'||!saleInteger_(e.receipt.totalCents)||!['PIX','DINHEIRO','DEBITO','CREDITO'].includes(e.receipt.paymentMethod)||e.lines.some(function(l){return l.after<=l.before;}))failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
}
function operationReversals_(events){
 var reversed={};events.filter(function(e){return e.type==='SALE_REVERSED';}).forEach(function(e){var original=events.filter(function(s){return s.type==='SALE_COMMITTED'&&s.idempotencyKey===e.command.saleId&&[2,3].includes(s.version);});
 if(original.length!==1||reversed[e.command.saleId])failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');var s=original[0];
 if(e.receipt.totalCents!==s.receipt.totalCents||e.receipt.paymentMethod!==s.receipt.paymentMethod||e.lines.length!==s.lines.length||e.receipt.createdAt<s.receipt.createdAt)failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
 s.lines.forEach(function(l){var points=e.lines.filter(function(p){return p.id===l.productId;});if(points.length!==1||points[0].after-points[0].before!==l.quantity)failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');});reversed[e.command.saleId]=e;
 });return reversed;
}
function appendOperation_(ss,e){var journal=saleTable_(ss,'_Eventos_Dominio'),values={ID_Evento:e.idempotencyKey,Tipo:e.type,Chave_Idempotencia:e.idempotencyKey,Hash_Comando:e.commandHash,Conteudo_JSON:JSON.stringify(e),Estado_Projecao:'PENDENTE',Criado_Em:e.receipt.createdAt,Versao_Esquema:1};operationEvent_(e,values);journal.sheet.appendRow(journal.columns.map(function(k){return values[k];}));SpreadsheetApp.flush();recoverSales_(ss);return e.receipt;}
function operationDto_(event,reversed,detail){return {saleId:event.idempotencyKey,actorId:event.actorId,customerId:event.receipt.customerId,createdAt:event.receipt.createdAt,totalCents:event.receipt.totalCents,paymentMethod:event.receipt.paymentMethod,state:reversed[event.idempotencyKey]?'CANCELADA':'CONFIRMADA',items:detail?event.receipt.items.map(function(i){return {productId:i.productId,title:i.title||'',quantity:i.quantity,unitPriceCents:i.unitPriceCents,subtotalCents:i.subtotalCents};}):[]};}
function operationsOperation_(request,c){
 if(!request.actor||!accessHash_(request.actor.sessionTokenHash))failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');var ss=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet,principal=identitySession_(ss,request.actor.sessionTokenHash,Date.now()).principal,op=request.action.slice('operations.'.length),p=request.payload;
 if(principal.role!=='ATENDENTE')staffAdmin_(principal);

 recoverCatalog_(c);recoverSales_(ss);var table=saleTable_(ss,'_Eventos_Dominio'),events=saleObjects_(table).map(function(r){return JSON.parse(r.Conteudo_JSON);}),reversed=operationReversals_(events);
 if(op==='get'||op==='list'){
  var sales=events.filter(function(e){return e.type==='SALE_COMMITTED'&&[2,3].includes(e.version)&&(principal.role!=='ATENDENTE'||e.actorId===principal.id);});
  if(op==='get'){authControlExact_(p,['id']);if(!identityUuid_(p.id))failure_('INVALID_OPERATION');sales=sales.filter(function(e){return e.idempotencyKey===p.id;});if(sales.length!==1)failure_('SALE_NOT_FOUND');}
  else{authControlExact_(p,['from','to','offset']);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(p.offset)||p.offset<0||p.offset>2000)failure_('INVALID_OPERATION');var from=authControlTime_(p.from),to=authControlTime_(p.to);if(to<from||to-from>366*86400000)failure_('INVALID_OPERATION');sales=sales.filter(function(e){var at=Date.parse(e.receipt.createdAt);return at>=from&&at<=to;}).sort(function(a,b){return b.receipt.createdAt.localeCompare(a.receipt.createdAt)||a.idempotencyKey.localeCompare(b.idempotencyKey);});}
  var audit=identityRows_(ss,'Logs_Auditoria');if(audit.rows.length>=5000)failure_('JOURNAL_CAPACITY');accessSaveMain_(audit,{ID_Log:request.requestId,Data_Hora:new Date().toISOString(),ID_Usuario:principal.id,Perfil:principal.role,Acao:op==='get'?'SALE_READ':'SALE_LIST',Entidade:'Vendas',ID_Entidade:op==='get'?p.id:'',Antes:'',Depois:'',Resultado:'SUCESSO',ID_Requisicao:request.requestId});
  if(op==='get')return {sale:operationDto_(sales[0],reversed,true)};var page=sales.slice(p.offset,p.offset+20);return {sales:page.map(function(e){return operationDto_(e,reversed);}),total:sales.length,nextOffset:p.offset+page.length<sales.length?p.offset+page.length:null};
 }
 var command=operationCommand_(op,p),hash=digest_(JSON.stringify(command)),prior=events.filter(function(e){return e.idempotencyKey===command.commandId;});

 if(identityRows_(ss,'Logs_Auditoria').rows.some(function(r){return r.ID_Log===command.commandId;})||catalogJournal_(c).rows.some(function(r){return r.Command_ID===command.commandId;}))failure_('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');

 lines=[{id:command.id,expectedVersion:command.expectedVersion,before:product.Estoque_Atual,after:command.newStock}];receipt={commandId:command.commandId,id:command.id,version:command.expectedVersion+1,stockBefore:product.Estoque_Atual,stockAfter:command.newStock,createdAt:at};}

}
