// BEGIN Reports.gs sha256=faa04fa184f757e566334b98a30eec03cf4f07711a977412567fb1bbcbdf22f7
/* Commercial sources and export authorization. All calls run under ScriptLock.
 * Customer PII stays sealed until the trusted Node report controller. */
function reportFail_(code){failure_(code||'INVALID_REPORT');}
function reportFold_(s){return String(s).normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase();}
function reportFilters_(f){
 var fields=['kind','from','to','employeeId','customerId','productId','query','isbn','author','publisher','supplier','nicheId','category','minCents','maxCents','paymentMethod','stock','activity','movementType','cpfIndex'];authControlExact_(f,fields);
 fields.forEach(function(k){if(['minCents','maxCents'].includes(k)){if(f[k]!==null&&(!Number.isSafeInteger(f[k])||f[k]<0||f[k]>1e12))reportFail_();}else if(typeof f[k]!=='string'||f[k].length>300||/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(f[k]))reportFail_();});
 if(!['SALES','STOCK','MOVEMENTS'].includes(f.kind)||['employeeId','customerId','productId','nicheId'].some(function(k){return f[k]&&!identityUuid_(f[k]);})||f.cpfIndex&&!accessHash_(f.cpfIndex)||!['ALL','ZERO','LOW','POSITIVE'].includes(f.stock)||!['ALL','ACTIVE','INACTIVE'].includes(f.activity)||!['','PIX','DINHEIRO','DEBITO','CREDITO'].includes(f.paymentMethod)||!['','ENTRADA','SAIDA','AJUSTE','ESTORNO'].includes(f.movementType)||f.minCents!==null&&f.maxCents!==null&&f.minCents>f.maxCents)reportFail_();
 if(f.kind==='STOCK'){if(f.from||f.to||f.employeeId)reportFail_();}else{var from=authControlTime_(f.from),to=authControlTime_(f.to);if(to<from||to-from>366*86400000)reportFail_();}
 if(f.kind!=='SALES'&&(f.customerId||f.cpfIndex||f.paymentMethod)||f.kind!=='MOVEMENTS'&&f.movementType||f.kind==='MOVEMENTS'&&(f.minCents!==null||f.maxCents!==null))reportFail_();return f;
}
function reportProduct_(r,links){return {id:r.ID_Produto,title:r.Titulo,isbn:r.ISBN,author:r.Autor,publisher:r.Editora,supplier:r.Fornecedor,category:r.Categoria,stock:r.Estoque_Atual,minimumStock:r.Estoque_Minimo,priceCents:r.Preco_Venda,active:r.Ativo,nicheIds:catalogLinkIds_(links,r.ID_Produto)};}
function reportProductMatch_(p,f,title){return p&&(!f.productId||p.id===f.productId)&&(!f.query||reportFold_(p.title+' '+(title||'')).indexOf(reportFold_(f.query))>=0)&&(!f.isbn||p.isbn===f.isbn)&&['author','publisher','supplier','category'].every(function(k){return !f[k]||reportFold_(p[k]).indexOf(reportFold_(f[k]))>=0;})&&(!f.nicheId||p.nicheIds.includes(f.nicheId))&&(f.activity==='ALL'||p.active===(f.activity==='ACTIVE'))&&(f.stock==='ALL'||f.stock==='ZERO'&&p.stock===0||f.stock==='LOW'&&p.stock>0&&p.stock<=p.minimumStock||f.stock==='POSITIVE'&&p.stock>0);}
function reportBuildSource_(ss,c,f){
 var links=catalogLinks_(ss),allProducts=catalogProducts_(ss).rows.map(function(r){return reportProduct_(r,links);}),productMap=new Map(allProducts.map(function(p){return [p.id,p];})),productIds=new Set(),peopleIds=new Set(),customerIds=new Set(),sales=[],movements=[],legacy=0,customerTable=f.kind==='SALES'?customerRows_(ss):{rows:[]},customerMap=new Map(customerTable.rows.map(function(r){return [r.ID_Cliente,r];}));
 if(f.kind==='SALES'){
  var events=saleObjects_(saleTable_(ss,'_Eventos_Dominio')).map(function(r){return JSON.parse(r.Conteudo_JSON);}),reversed=operationReversals_(events);
  events.filter(function(e){return e.type==='SALE_COMMITTED';}).forEach(function(e){var r=e.receipt;if(r.createdAt<f.from||r.createdAt>f.to)return;if(![2,3].includes(e.version)){legacy++;return;}if(f.employeeId&&e.actorId!==f.employeeId||f.customerId&&r.customerId!==f.customerId||f.cpfIndex&&(!r.customerId||!customerMap.has(r.customerId)||customerMap.get(r.customerId).CPF_Indice!==f.cpfIndex)||f.paymentMethod&&r.paymentMethod!==f.paymentMethod||f.minCents!==null&&r.totalCents<f.minCents||f.maxCents!==null&&r.totalCents>f.maxCents)return;
   if(!r.items.some(function(i){return reportProductMatch_(productMap.get(i.productId),f,i.title);}))return;
   r.items.forEach(function(i){if(!productMap.has(i.productId))reportFail_('REPORT_UNAVAILABLE');productIds.add(i.productId);});peopleIds.add(e.actorId);if(r.customerId){if(!customerMap.has(r.customerId))reportFail_('REPORT_UNAVAILABLE');customerIds.add(r.customerId);}sales.push({id:e.idempotencyKey,at:r.createdAt,operatorId:e.actorId,customerId:r.customerId,paymentMethod:r.paymentMethod,state:reversed[e.idempotencyKey]?'CANCELADA':'CONFIRMADA',reversedAt:reversed[e.idempotencyKey]?reversed[e.idempotencyKey].receipt.createdAt:null,totalCents:r.totalCents,items:r.items.map(function(i){return {productId:i.productId,title:i.title,quantity:i.quantity,unitPriceCents:i.unitPriceCents,subtotalCents:i.subtotalCents};})});
  });
 }else if(f.kind==='STOCK'){
  allProducts.forEach(function(p){if(reportProductMatch_(p,f)&&(f.minCents===null||p.priceCents>=f.minCents)&&(f.maxCents===null||p.priceCents<=f.maxCents))productIds.add(p.id);});
 }else{
  identityRows_(ss,'Movimentacoes_Estoque').rows.forEach(function(r){if(r.Data_Hora<f.from||r.Data_Hora>f.to||f.employeeId&&r.ID_Usuario!==f.employeeId||f.movementType&&r.Tipo!==f.movementType||!reportProductMatch_(productMap.get(r.ID_Produto),f))return;productIds.add(r.ID_Produto);peopleIds.add(r.ID_Usuario);movements.push({id:r.ID_Movimentacao,at:r.Data_Hora,operatorId:r.ID_Usuario,productId:r.ID_Produto,type:r.Tipo,quantity:r.Quantidade,before:r.Saldo_Anterior,after:r.Saldo_Posterior,saleId:r.ID_Venda});});
 }
 var products=allProducts.filter(function(p){return productIds.has(p.id);}),nicheIds=new Set();products.forEach(function(p){p.nicheIds.forEach(function(id){nicheIds.add(id);});});var data={products:products,sales:sales,movements:movements,people:auditPeople_(ss,peopleIds),customers:customerTable.rows.filter(function(r){return customerIds.has(r.ID_Cliente);}).map(function(r){return {id:r.ID_Cliente,contact:r.Nome};}),niches:catalogNiches_(ss).rows.filter(function(n){return nicheIds.has(n.ID_Nicho);}).map(function(n){return {id:n.ID_Nicho,name:n.Nome};}),legacyExcluded:legacy};
 data.snapshot=hmac_(JSON.stringify([c.environment,c.installationId,f,data]),c.secret,'reports.source');data.generatedAt=new Date().toISOString();if(Utilities.base64Encode(Utilities.newBlob(JSON.stringify(data)).getBytes()).length>3500000)reportFail_('REPORT_CAPACITY');return data;
}
function reportsOperation_(request,c){
 if(!request.actor||!accessHash_(request.actor.sessionTokenHash)||Object.keys(request.actor).length!==1)failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');var ss=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet,principal=identitySession_(ss,request.actor.sessionTokenHash,Date.now()).principal;staffAdmin_(principal);securitySettle_(c);
 var p=request.payload;if(request.action==='reports.source'){authControlExact_(p,['filters']);return reportBuildSource_(ss,c,reportFilters_(p.filters));}
 if(request.action!=='reports.record')failure_('FORBIDDEN');authControlExact_(p,['commandId','mode','filters','sourceSnapshot','fingerprint','count','summary']);reportFilters_(p.filters);if(!identityUuid_(p.commandId)||!['VIEW','EXPORT'].includes(p.mode)||!accessHash_(p.sourceSnapshot)||!accessHash_(p.fingerprint)||!Number.isSafeInteger(p.count)||p.count<0||p.count>5000||!p.summary||Array.isArray(p.summary)||typeof p.summary!=='object'||Object.keys(p.summary).length>12||Object.keys(p.summary).some(function(k){return !['salesCount','confirmedCount','reversedCount','grossCents','reversedCents','netCents','unitsNet','averageCents','booksCount','totalUnits','zeroCount','lowCount','salePotentialCents','movementsCount','unitsIn','unitsOut','netUnits'].includes(k)||!Number.isSafeInteger(p.summary[k]);}))reportFail_();
 var source=reportBuildSource_(ss,c,p.filters);if(source.snapshot!==p.sourceSnapshot)reportFail_('REPORT_CHANGED');var table=identityRows_(ss,'Logs_Auditoria'),prior=table.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Log===p.commandId;}),log={ID_Log:p.commandId,Data_Hora:prior.length?prior[0].Data_Hora:source.generatedAt,ID_Usuario:principal.id,Perfil:principal.role,Acao:p.mode==='VIEW'?'COMMERCIAL_REPORT_VIEW':'COMMERCIAL_REPORT_EXPORT',Entidade:'Relatorios',ID_Entidade:'',Antes:'',Depois:JSON.stringify({reportType:p.filters.kind,fingerprint:p.fingerprint,count:p.count,summary:p.summary}),Resultado:'SUCESSO',ID_Requisicao:p.commandId};
 if(prior.length>1||prior.length&&!table.columns.every(function(k){return prior[0][k]===log[k];}))reportFail_('REPORT_CONFLICT');if(!prior.length){if(table.rows.length>=5000)reportFail_('REPORT_CAPACITY');accessSaveMain_(table,log);}return {recorded:true,commandId:p.commandId};
}

;
// END Reports.gs

// BEGIN Sales.gs sha256=f7c1583ca2a1903b82a6be390859a9f07f753b98334584a2a70da386f4242f21
/* Recoverable sale projections, including gated anonymous DEV checkout.
 * Caller MUST hold the installation ScriptLock for the entire read/write cycle.
 * The journal remains append-only; deterministic keys and product versions allow
 * replay after interruption between any two projection writes.
 */
function saleTable_(ss, name) {
  var sheet = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sheet) failure_('SCHEMA_REQUIRED');
  var columns = rowValues_(sheet);
  var rows = sheet.getLastRow() < 2 ? [] : sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, columns.length).getValues();
  return { sheet: sheet, columns: columns, rows: rows };
}
function saleObjects_(table) {
  return table.rows.map(function (row, index) {
    var object = { rowNumber: index + 2 };
    table.columns.forEach(function (key, i) { object[key] = row[i]; });
    return object;
  });
}
function saleUuid_(value) { return typeof value === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/.test(value); }
function saleInteger_(value) { return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0; }
function saleReceiptLine_(line) {
  var out={productId:line.productId,quantity:line.quantity,unitPriceCents:line.unitPriceCents,subtotalCents:line.subtotalCents};
  if(line.title!==undefined){if(typeof line.title!=='string'||!line.title||line.title.length>300||/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(line.title))failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');out.title=line.title;}
  return out;
}
function checkoutReceiptState_(ss,receipt) {
  var reversed=saleObjects_(saleTable_(ss,'_Eventos_Dominio')).some(function(row){if(row.Tipo!=='SALE_REVERSED')return false;return JSON.parse(row.Conteudo_JSON).command.saleId===receipt.saleId;});
  return Object.assign({},receipt,{state:reversed?'CANCELADA':'CONFIRMADA'});
}
function checkoutCommand_(input) {
  if (!input || typeof input !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input) ||
      !same_(Object.keys(input).sort(), ['customerId', 'expectedTotalCents', 'idempotencyKey', 'items', 'paymentMethod']) ||
      !saleUuid_(input.idempotencyKey) || input.customerId !== null && !saleUuid_(input.customerId) || !saleInteger_(input.expectedTotalCents) ||
      !['PIX', 'DINHEIRO', 'DEBITO', 'CREDITO'].includes(input.paymentMethod) || !Array.isArray(input.items) || !input.items.length || input.items.length > 100) failure_('INVALID_SALE');
  var quantities = {};
  input.items.forEach(function (item) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item) || !same_(Object.keys(item).sort(), ['productId', 'quantity']) ||
        !saleUuid_(item.productId) || !Number.isSafeInteger(item.quantity) || item.quantity <= 0) failure_('INVALID_SALE');
    quantities[item.productId] = (quantities[item.productId] || 0) + item.quantity;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quantities[item.productId])) failure_('INVALID_SALE');
  });
  return { idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey, items: Object.keys(quantities).sort().map(function (id) { return { productId: id, quantity: quantities[id] }; }),
    paymentMethod: input.paymentMethod, customerId: input.customerId, expectedTotalCents: input.expectedTotalCents };
}
function checkoutOperation_(request, c) {
  if (c.environment !== 'dev' || !request.actor || !same_(Object.keys(request.actor), ['sessionTokenHash']) || !accessHash_(request.actor.sessionTokenHash)) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  // Authorize again under the same ScriptLock as the stock decision.
  var principal = identitySessionOperation_({ action: 'identity.session.read', payload: { tokenHash: request.actor.sessionTokenHash } }, c);
  if (!['ATENDENTE', 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(principal.role) || principal.role !== 'ATENDENTE' && !['mfa', 'passkey'].includes(principal.assurance)) failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  var command = checkoutCommand_(request.payload), hash = digest_(JSON.stringify(command));
  recoverCatalog_(c);
  var ss = storage_(c, false).spreadsheet;
  recoverSales_(ss);
  var journal = saleTable_(ss, '_Eventos_Dominio'), prior = saleObjects_(journal).filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Evento === command.idempotencyKey; });
  if (prior.length) {
    var existing = JSON.parse(prior[0].Conteudo_JSON);
    if (prior.length !== 1 || ![2,3].includes(existing.version) || existing.commandHash !== hash || existing.actorId !== principal.id) failure_('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
    return checkoutReceiptState_(ss,existing.receipt);
  }
  if(request.action==='sales.receipt')failure_('CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE');
  if (journal.rows.length >= 2000 || saleTable_(ss, 'Logs_Auditoria').rows.length >= 5000) failure_('JOURNAL_CAPACITY');
  // Command IDs share the audit namespace with catalog changes. Refuse a
  // chosen collision before appending an event that could never be projected.
  if (saleObjects_(saleTable_(ss, 'Logs_Auditoria')).some(function (row) { return row.ID_Log === command.idempotencyKey; }) ||
      saleObjects_(saleTable_(ss, 'Vendas')).some(function (row) { return row.ID_Venda === command.idempotencyKey; })) failure_('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
  function rejectBusiness(code) {
    var audit = saleTable_(ss, 'Logs_Auditoria'), log = { ID_Log: request.requestId + ':sale-rejected', Data_Hora: new Date().toISOString(),
      ID_Usuario: principal.id, Perfil: principal.role, Acao: 'SALE_REJECTED', Entidade: 'Vendas', ID_Entidade: command.idempotencyKey,
      Antes: '', Depois: JSON.stringify({ code: code, items: command.items }), Resultado: 'NEGADO', ID_Requisicao: request.requestId };
    ensureSaleRow_(audit, ['ID_Log'], log, true); failure_(code);
  }
  if(command.customerId!==null){
    if(scriptProperties_().getProperty('CUSTOMERS_ENABLED')!=='true')rejectBusiness('CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE');
    recoverCustomers_(ss);if(!customerRows_(ss).rows.some(function(r){return r.ID_Cliente===command.customerId;}))rejectBusiness('CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE');
  }
  var products = catalogProducts_(ss), total = 0;
  var lines = command.items.map(function (item) {
    var matches = products.rows.filter(function (p) { return p.ID_Produto === item.productId; }), product = matches[0];
    if (matches.length !== 1 || product.Ativo !== true) rejectBusiness('PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE');
    if (!saleInteger_(product.Preco_Venda) || product.Preco_Venda > 100000000) failure_('INVALID_SALE');
    if (product.Estoque_Atual < item.quantity) rejectBusiness('INSUFFICIENT_STOCK');
    var subtotal = product.Preco_Venda * item.quantity; total += subtotal;
    if (!saleInteger_(subtotal) || !saleInteger_(total) || product.Versao_Registro >= 1000000000) failure_('INVALID_SALE');
    return { title:product.Titulo, productId: item.productId, quantity: item.quantity, unitPriceCents: product.Preco_Venda, subtotalCents: subtotal,
      expectedVersion: product.Versao_Registro, stockAfter: product.Estoque_Atual - item.quantity };
  });
  if (total !== command.expectedTotalCents) rejectBusiness('SALE_PRICE_CHANGED');
  var receipt = { saleId: command.idempotencyKey, totalCents: total, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), customerId: command.customerId, paymentMethod: command.paymentMethod,
    items: lines.map(saleReceiptLine_) };
  var event = { version: command.customerId===null?2:3, type: 'SALE_COMMITTED', idempotencyKey: command.idempotencyKey, commandHash: hash, actorId: principal.id, actorRole: principal.role, lines: lines, receipt: receipt };
  var values = { ID_Evento: event.idempotencyKey, Tipo: event.type, Chave_Idempotencia: event.idempotencyKey, Hash_Comando: hash,
    Conteudo_JSON: JSON.stringify(event), Estado_Projecao: 'PENDENTE', Criado_Em: receipt.createdAt, Versao_Esquema: event.version };
  validateSaleEvent_(event, values);
  // Durable append precedes ALL business projections. Repeating the same key
  // recovers this event and returns this exact receipt, even after response loss.
  journal.sheet.appendRow(journal.columns.map(function (key) { return values[key]; })); SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  recoverSales_(ss);
  return checkoutReceiptState_(ss,receipt);
}
function validateSaleEvent_(event, row) {
  if (!event || event.type !== 'SALE_COMMITTED' || !saleUuid_(event.idempotencyKey) || !saleUuid_(event.actorId) ||
      !event.receipt || event.receipt.saleId !== event.idempotencyKey || !saleInteger_(event.receipt.totalCents) ||
      typeof event.receipt.createdAt !== 'string' || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(event.receipt.createdAt)) ||
      !Array.isArray(event.lines) || !event.lines.length || event.lines.length > 100) failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
  var seen = new Set(), total = 0;
  event.lines.forEach(function (line) {
    if (!saleUuid_(line.productId) || seen.has(line.productId) || !Number.isSafeInteger(line.quantity) || line.quantity <= 0 ||
        !saleInteger_(line.unitPriceCents) || !saleInteger_(line.subtotalCents) || !saleInteger_(line.expectedVersion) ||
        line.expectedVersion >= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER || !saleInteger_(line.stockAfter) ||
        !saleInteger_(line.stockAfter + line.quantity) || line.subtotalCents !== line.quantity * line.unitPriceCents) failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
    seen.add(line.productId); total += line.subtotalCents;
    if (!saleInteger_(total)) failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
  });
  var command = { idempotencyKey: event.idempotencyKey, items: event.lines.map(function (line) {
    return { productId: line.productId, quantity: line.quantity };
  }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.productId.localeCompare(b.productId); }) };
  if (event.version !== undefined && ![2,3].includes(event.version)) failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
  if ([2,3].includes(event.version)) {
    if (event.version===2&&event.receipt.customerId!==null||event.version===3&&!saleUuid_(event.receipt.customerId))failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
    if (!['ATENDENTE', 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(event.actorRole)) failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
    command.paymentMethod = event.receipt.paymentMethod; command.customerId = event.receipt.customerId; command.expectedTotalCents = total;
    try { checkoutCommand_(command); } catch (_) { failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID'); }
    if (!same_(event.receipt.items, event.lines.map(saleReceiptLine_)) ||
        !same_(event.lines.map(function (line) { return { productId: line.productId, quantity: line.quantity }; }), command.items)) failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
  }
  if (total !== event.receipt.totalCents || event.commandHash !== digest_(JSON.stringify(command)) ||
      row.ID_Evento !== event.idempotencyKey || row.Chave_Idempotencia !== event.idempotencyKey ||
      row.Tipo !== event.type || row.Hash_Comando !== event.commandHash || row.Versao_Esquema !== ([2,3].includes(event.version) ? event.version : 1) ||
      row.Criado_Em !== event.receipt.createdAt || row.Estado_Projecao !== 'PENDENTE') failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
}
function ensureSaleRow_(table, keyColumns, values, write, allowCancel) {
  var row = table.columns.map(function (column) { return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(values, column) ? values[column] : ''; });
  var matches = table.rows.filter(function (candidate) {
    return keyColumns.every(function (key) { var col = table.columns.indexOf(key); return candidate[col] === row[col]; });
  });
  var mayCancel=false;
  if(matches.length===1&&allowCancel){var status=table.columns.indexOf('Status'),copy=matches[0].slice();if(status>=0&&copy[status]==='CONFIRMADA'&&row[status]==='CANCELADA'){copy[status]='CANCELADA';mayCancel=same_(copy,row);}}
  if (matches.length > 1 || (matches.length && !same_(matches[0], row)&&!mayCancel)) failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');
  if(mayCancel&&write){var index=table.rows.indexOf(matches[0]);table.sheet.getRange(index+2,1,1,row.length).setValues([row]);table.rows[index]=row;SpreadsheetApp.flush();}
  if (!matches.length && write) { table.sheet.appendRow(row); table.rows.push(row); SpreadsheetApp.flush(); }
}
function recoverSales_(ss) {
  assertSchema_(ss);
  // Finish reserved customer command IDs before any inventory/audit mutation.
  recoverCustomers_(ss);
  var journal = saleTable_(ss, '_Eventos_Dominio');
  // Bound execution and fail before writes; archival/checkpoint compaction is a
  // separate migration, never silently truncate authoritative history.
  if (journal.rows.length > 2000) failure_('JOURNAL_CAPACITY');
  var events = [], eventKeys = new Set();
  saleObjects_(journal).forEach(function (row) {
    if (!['SALE_COMMITTED','STOCK_RECEIVED','STOCK_ADJUSTED','SALE_REVERSED'].includes(row.Tipo)) failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
    var event;
    try { event = JSON.parse(row.Conteudo_JSON); } catch (_) { failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID'); }
    if(['STOCK_ADJUSTED','SALE_REVERSED'].includes(row.Tipo))operationEvent_(event,row);else if (row.Tipo === 'STOCK_RECEIVED') validateStockEvent_(event, row); else validateSaleEvent_(event, row);
    if (eventKeys.has(event.idempotencyKey)) failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
    eventKeys.add(event.idempotencyKey); events.push(event);
  });
  var reversed=operationReversals_(events);
  var products = saleTable_(ss, 'Produtos'), byId = {};
  saleObjects_(products).forEach(function (product) {
    if (byId[product.ID_Produto]) failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');
    byId[product.ID_Produto] = product;
  });
  var sales = saleTable_(ss, 'Vendas'), items = saleTable_(ss, 'Itens_Venda'), movements = saleTable_(ss, 'Movimentacoes_Estoque'), audit = saleTable_(ss, 'Logs_Auditoria');
  var plans = [], transitions = {};
  events.forEach(function (event) {
    if(['STOCK_ADJUSTED','SALE_REVERSED'].includes(event.type)){
      event.lines.forEach(function(l){if(!transitions[l.id])transitions[l.id]=[];transitions[l.id].push({version:l.expectedVersion,before:l.before,after:l.after});
        plans.push({table:movements,keys:['ID_Movimentacao'],values:{ID_Movimentacao:event.idempotencyKey+':'+l.id,Data_Hora:event.receipt.createdAt,ID_Produto:l.id,Tipo:event.type==='SALE_REVERSED'?'ESTORNO':'AJUSTE',Quantidade:Math.abs(l.after-l.before),Saldo_Anterior:l.before,Saldo_Posterior:l.after,Motivo:event.command.reason,ID_Venda:event.type==='SALE_REVERSED'?event.command.saleId:'',ID_Usuario:event.actorId}});
      });
      var detail={reason:event.command.reason,lines:event.lines};if(event.type==='SALE_REVERSED'){detail.totalCents=event.receipt.totalCents;detail.paymentMethod=event.receipt.paymentMethod;}
      plans.push({table:audit,keys:['ID_Log'],values:{ID_Log:event.idempotencyKey,Data_Hora:event.receipt.createdAt,ID_Usuario:event.actorId,Perfil:event.actorRole,Acao:event.type,Entidade:event.type==='SALE_REVERSED'?'Vendas':'Produtos',ID_Entidade:event.type==='SALE_REVERSED'?event.command.saleId:event.command.id,Antes:'',Depois:JSON.stringify(detail),Resultado:'SUCESSO',ID_Requisicao:event.idempotencyKey}});return;
    }
    if (event.type === 'STOCK_RECEIVED') {
      var r = event.receipt;
      if (!transitions[r.id]) transitions[r.id] = [];
      transitions[r.id].push({ version: r.version - 1, before: r.stockBefore, after: r.stockAfter });
      plans.push({ table: movements, keys: ['ID_Movimentacao'], values: {
        ID_Movimentacao: r.commandId, Data_Hora: r.createdAt, ID_Produto: r.id, Tipo: 'ENTRADA', Quantidade: r.quantity,
        Saldo_Anterior: r.stockBefore, Saldo_Posterior: r.stockAfter, Motivo: event.reason, ID_Venda: '', ID_Usuario: event.actorId } });
      plans.push({ table: audit, keys: ['ID_Log'], values: {
        ID_Log: r.commandId, Data_Hora: r.createdAt, ID_Usuario: event.actorId, Perfil: event.actorRole,
        Acao: 'STOCK_RECEIVED', Entidade: 'Produtos', ID_Entidade: r.id, Antes: JSON.stringify({ stock: r.stockBefore, version: r.version - 1 }),
        Depois: JSON.stringify({ stock: r.stockAfter, version: r.version, quantity: r.quantity, reason: event.reason }), Resultado: 'SUCESSO', ID_Requisicao: r.commandId } });
      return;
    }
    var sale = { ID_Venda: event.idempotencyKey, Data_Hora: event.receipt.createdAt,
      ID_Atendente: event.actorId, Valor_Total: event.receipt.totalCents,
      Status: reversed[event.idempotencyKey]?'CANCELADA':'CONFIRMADA', Origem: [2,3].includes(event.version) ? 'CAIXA_DEV' : 'DEV_TEST', Idempotency_Key: event.idempotencyKey };
    if ([2,3].includes(event.version)) sale.Forma_Pagamento = event.receipt.paymentMethod;
    if(event.version===3)sale.ID_Cliente=event.receipt.customerId;
    plans.push({ table: sales, keys: ['ID_Venda'], values: sale,allowCancel:!!reversed[event.idempotencyKey] });
    if ([2,3].includes(event.version)) plans.push({ table: audit, keys: ['ID_Log'], values: {
      ID_Log: event.idempotencyKey, Data_Hora: event.receipt.createdAt, ID_Usuario: event.actorId, Perfil: event.actorRole,
      Acao: 'SALE_COMMITTED', Entidade: 'Vendas', ID_Entidade: event.idempotencyKey, Antes: '',
      Depois: JSON.stringify({ totalCents: event.receipt.totalCents, paymentMethod: event.receipt.paymentMethod, customerId: event.receipt.customerId,
        items: event.receipt.items }), Resultado: 'SUCESSO', ID_Requisicao: event.idempotencyKey } });
    event.lines.forEach(function (line) {
      var product = byId[line.productId];
      if (!product || !saleInteger_(product.Estoque_Atual) || !saleInteger_(product.Versao_Registro)) failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');
      if (!transitions[line.productId]) transitions[line.productId] = [];
      transitions[line.productId].push({ version: line.expectedVersion, before: line.stockAfter + line.quantity, after: line.stockAfter });
      plans.push({ table: items, keys: ['ID_Venda', 'ID_Produto'], values: {
        ID_Venda: event.idempotencyKey, ID_Produto: line.productId, Quantidade: line.quantity,
        Preco_Unitario: line.unitPriceCents, Subtotal: line.subtotalCents } });
      plans.push({ table: movements, keys: ['ID_Movimentacao'], values: {
        ID_Movimentacao: event.idempotencyKey + ':' + line.productId, Data_Hora: event.receipt.createdAt,
        ID_Produto: line.productId, Tipo: 'SAIDA', Quantidade: line.quantity,
        Saldo_Anterior: line.stockAfter + line.quantity, Saldo_Posterior: line.stockAfter,
        Motivo: 'VENDA', ID_Venda: event.idempotencyKey, ID_Usuario: event.actorId } });
    });
  });
  var identified=events.filter(function(e){return e.version===3&&e.type==='SALE_COMMITTED';}),customers=null,latest={};
  if(identified.length){recoverCustomers_(ss);customers=customerRows_(ss);identified.forEach(function(e){latest[e.receipt.customerId]='';});identified.forEach(function(e){var id=e.receipt.customerId;if(!reversed[e.idempotencyKey]&&latest[id]<e.receipt.createdAt)latest[id]=e.receipt.createdAt;});
    Object.keys(latest).forEach(function(id){var r=customers.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Cliente===id;})[0];if(!r||r.Ultima_Compra&&!identified.some(function(e){return e.receipt.customerId===id&&e.receipt.createdAt===r.Ultima_Compra;}))failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');});
  }
  // Validate ALL projections and stock checkpoints before any mutation.
  plans.forEach(function (plan) { ensureSaleRow_(plan.table, plan.keys, plan.values, false,plan.allowCancel); });
  var missingAudit = plans.filter(function (plan) { return plan.table === audit && !audit.rows.some(function (row) { return row[audit.columns.indexOf('ID_Log')] === plan.values.ID_Log; }); }).length;
  if (audit.rows.length + missingAudit > 5000) failure_('JOURNAL_CAPACITY');
  var chains = inventoryChains_(ss, products, byId, transitions);
  plans.forEach(function (plan) { ensureSaleRow_(plan.table, plan.keys, plan.values, true,plan.allowCancel); });
  Object.keys(chains).forEach(function (id) {
    var product = byId[id], final = chains[id][chains[id].length - 1];
    if (product.Versao_Registro === final.version) return;
    // Stock + checkpoint in ONE row write. Never write the two cells separately.
    var row = products.rows[product.rowNumber - 2].slice();
    row[products.columns.indexOf('Estoque_Atual')] = final.stock;
    row[products.columns.indexOf('Versao_Registro')] = final.version;
    products.sheet.getRange(product.rowNumber, 1, 1, row.length).setValues([row]);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  });
  // Last purchase is derived from authoritative events, including response-loss repair.
  if(customers)Object.keys(latest).forEach(function(id){var r=customers.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Cliente===id;})[0];if(r.Ultima_Compra!==latest[id]){r.Ultima_Compra=latest[id];accessSaveMain_(customers,r);}});
  synchronizeStockNotifications_(ss);
  return { recoveredSales: events.filter(function (event) { return event.type === 'SALE_COMMITTED'; }).length };
}
// Owner-only editor action; no public endpoint, no supplied actor impersonation.
function recoverDevelopmentSales() {
  var c = baseSettings_(); requireOwnerDev_(c);
  return withLock_(function () {
    if (scriptProperties_().getProperty('CATALOG_JOURNAL_ID')) recoverCatalog_(c);
    return recoverSales_(storage_(c, false).spreadsheet);
  });
}

function scheduleDate_(v){if(typeof v!=='string'||!/^20\d\d-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)||v<'2020-01-01'||v>'2099-12-31'||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(v+'T12:00:00Z'))||new Date(v+'T12:00:00Z').toISOString().slice(0,10)!==v)scheduleFail_();return v;}

function scheduleCommands_(ss){return identityRows_(ss,'Configuracoes').rows.filter(function(r){return r.Chave.indexOf('schedule.command.')===0;}).map(function(r){var v;try{v=JSON.parse(r.Valor);}catch(_){scheduleFail_('SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE');}if(!v||v.version!==1||r.Chave!=='schedule.command.'+v.id||!identityUuid_(v.id)||!identityUuid_(v.scheduleId)||!identityUuid_(v.actor)||!['ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(v.role)||!['PENDING','COMPLETE'].includes(v.state)||!accessHash_(v.fingerprint)||v.before!==null&&!Array.isArray(v.before)||!Array.isArray(v.after)||!v.meta||!Array.isArray(v.notifications)||v.notifications.length>2)scheduleFail_('SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE');authControlTime_(v.at);var copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));delete copy.hash;delete copy.state;if(!constantEqual_(v.hash,digest_(JSON.stringify(copy))))scheduleFail_('SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE');return v;});}

function scheduleProject_(ss,v){

function schedulesOperation_(request,c){

// BEGIN SecurityAudit.gs sha256=d70a8126f098882f75a48598a78038c12fe2ea00ac361f7073fb05fdfff1f040
/* Minimal security events and a single private, authenticated write-ahead intent.
 * No browser endpoint; every call requires the signed server envelope/ScriptLock. */
function securityId_(c,kind,value){var h=hmac_(JSON.stringify([c.installationId,kind,value]),c.secret,'security.audit');return h.slice(0,8)+'-'+h.slice(8,12)+'-4'+h.slice(13,16)+'-8'+h.slice(17,20)+'-'+h.slice(20,32);}
function securityLog_(id,at,actor,role,action,detail){return {ID_Log:id,Data_Hora:at,ID_Usuario:actor,Perfil:role,Acao:action,Entidade:'Autenticacao',ID_Entidade:'',Antes:'',Depois:JSON.stringify(detail),Resultado:action==='IDENTITY_ACCESS_DENIED'?'NEGADO':['IDENTITY_AUTH_BLOCKED','IDENTITY_PROOF_BLOCKED'].includes(action)?'BLOQUEADO':'SUCESSO',ID_Requisicao:id};}
function securityAppend_(ss,log){var table=identityRows_(ss,'Logs_Auditoria'),found=table.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Log===log.ID_Log;});if(found.length>1||found.length&&!table.columns.every(function(k){return found[0][k]===log[k];}))failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');if(!found.length){if(table.rows.length>=5000)failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');accessSaveMain_(table,log);}}
function securityIntentHash_(v,c){var copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));delete copy.hash;return hmac_(JSON.stringify([c.environment,c.installationId,copy]),c.secret,'security.intent');}
function securityBegin_(c,v){var props=scriptProperties_();if(props.getProperty('IDENTITY_SECURITY_PENDING'))failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');v.version=1;v.hash=securityIntentHash_(v,c);var raw=JSON.stringify(v);if(Utilities.newBlob(raw).getBytes().length>8000||v.kind!=='SESSIONS'&&identityRows_(storage_(c,false).spreadsheet,'Logs_Auditoria').rows.length>=5000)failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');props.setProperty('IDENTITY_SECURITY_PENDING',raw);recoverSecurityIntent_(c);}
function securitySessionTargets_(table,p){
 var seen=new Set();table.rows.forEach(function(r){if(!identityUuid_(r.ID_Sessao)||seen.has(r.ID_Sessao)||!identityUuid_(r.ID_Usuario))failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');seen.add(r.ID_Sessao);});
 return table.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Usuario===p.actor&&(p.kind==='SELF'?r.ID_Sessao===p.sessionId:r.ID_Sessao!==p.sessionId&&identityTime_(r.Criado_Em)<=p.cutoff)&&(r.Revogado_Em===''||r.Revogado_Em===p.at);});
}
function recoverSecurityIntent_(c){
 var props=scriptProperties_(),raw=props.getProperty('IDENTITY_SECURITY_PENDING');if(!raw)return;var v;try{v=JSON.parse(raw);}catch(_){failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');}if(!v||v.version!==1||!['LIMIT','SESSIONS','PROOF'].includes(v.kind)||!constantEqual_(v.hash,securityIntentHash_(v,c))||!v.log||!identityUuid_(v.log.ID_Log))failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');
 var main=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet;
 if(v.kind==='LIMIT'){
  if(!Array.isArray(v.plans)||v.plans.length!==2)failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');var table=authControlRows_(authControlStore_(c),'_Auth_Limits');
  v.plans.forEach(function(plan){var rows=table.rows.filter(function(r){return r.Key===plan.key;}),current=rows.length?table.columns.map(function(k){return rows[0][k];}):null;if(rows.length>1||!same_(current,plan.before)&&!same_(current,plan.after)||!Array.isArray(plan.after)||plan.after.length!==table.columns.length||plan.after[0]!==plan.key)failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');if(!same_(current,plan.after)){var row={number:rows.length?rows[0].number:undefined};table.columns.forEach(function(k,i){row[k]=plan.after[i];});authControlSave_(table,row);}});
 }else if(v.kind==='PROOF'){
  var plan=v.plan,table=accessFlows_(authControlStore_(c)),rows=table.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID===plan.flowId;});if(rows.length!==1||!identityUuid_(plan.flowId)||rows[0].Attempt_Count!==4&&rows[0].Attempt_Count!==5||!['EMAIL','PIN'].includes(plan.state||'EMAIL')||rows[0].State!==(plan.state||'EMAIL')&&rows[0].State!=='REVOKED')failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');var row=rows[0];if(row.Attempt_Count!==5||row.State!=='REVOKED'){row.Attempt_Count=5;row.State='REVOKED';authControlSave_(table,row);}
 }else{
  var p=v.plan;if(!p||!['SELF','OTHERS'].includes(p.kind)||!identityUuid_(p.actor)||!identityUuid_(p.sessionId)||!Number.isSafeInteger(p.cutoff)||p.cutoff<0||!Number.isSafeInteger(p.count)||p.count<1||p.count>5000||!accessHash_(p.idsHash))failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');identityTime_(p.at);var table=identityRows_(main,'Sessoes'),targets=securitySessionTargets_(table,p);if(targets.length!==p.count||digest_(JSON.stringify(targets.map(function(r){return r.ID_Sessao;}).sort()))!==p.idsHash)failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');targets.forEach(function(row){if(row.Revogado_Em===''){row.Revogado_Em=p.at;accessSaveMain_(table,row);}});
 }
 securityAppend_(main,v.log);props.setProperty('IDENTITY_SECURITY_PENDING','');
}
function securitySettle_(c){recoverEmergencyRecovery_(c);recoverKeyManagement_(c);recoverStaff_(c);recoverProfiles_(c);recoverRecoveryIntents_(c);recoverEmailChanges_(c);recoverNiches_(c);recoverSchedules_(c);var props=scriptProperties_();if(props.getProperty('CATALOG_JOURNAL_ID')){recoverCatalog_(c);recoverSales_(storage_(c,false).spreadsheet);}if(props.getProperty('IDENTITY_CONTROL_SPREADSHEET_ID'))accessRecoverIntents_(authControlStore_(c),c,Date.now());}
function securityProofBlock_(c,row,now,phase,code){securitySettle_(c);var id=securityId_(c,'PROOF_BLOCK',row.ID),log=securityLog_(id,new Date(now).toISOString(),'SYSTEM_AUTH','SYSTEM','IDENTITY_PROOF_BLOCKED',{phase:phase||'EMAIL',code:code||'EMAIL_PROOF_LIMIT'});securityBegin_(c,{kind:'PROOF',plan:{flowId:row.ID,state:phase==='RECOVER'?'PIN':'EMAIL'},log:log});}
function securityBlock_(privateStore,plans,c,now,retry){
 securitySettle_(c);
 var table=authControlRows_(privateStore,'_Auth_Limits'),at=new Date(now).toISOString(),kinds=plans.filter(function(p){return p.row.Attempt_Count>p.maximum;}).map(function(p){return p.row.Key.split(':')[0];}),id=securityId_(c,'BLOCK',plans.map(function(p){return [p.row.Key,p.row.Blocked_Until];}));
 var log=securityLog_(id,at,'SYSTEM_AUTH','SYSTEM','IDENTITY_AUTH_BLOCKED',{phase:'LIMITER',code:kinds.length===2?'ACCOUNT_AND_ORIGIN_LIMIT':kinds[0]==='account'?'ACCOUNT_LIMIT':'ORIGIN_LIMIT',retryAfterSeconds:retry});
 securityBegin_(c,{kind:'LIMIT',log:log,plans:plans.map(function(p){return {key:p.row.Key,before:p.before,after:table.columns.map(function(k){return p.row[k];})};})});
}
function securityRevoke_(request,c){
 recoverSecurityIntent_(c);securitySettle_(c);var ss=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet,table=identityRows_(ss,'Sessoes'),matches=table.rows.filter(function(r){return r.Token_Hash===request.payload.tokenHash;}),self=request.action==='identity.session.revoke';
 if(matches.length!==1)failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');var session=matches[0],id=self?securityId_(c,'LOGOUT',session.ID_Sessao):null;
 if(self&&session.Revogado_Em!==''){
  var prior=identityRows_(ss,'Logs_Auditoria').rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Log===id;});if(prior.length===1&&prior[0].Acao==='IDENTITY_LOGOUT'&&prior[0].ID_Usuario===session.ID_Usuario&&prior[0].Data_Hora===session.Revogado_Em)return {revoked:true};failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
 }
 var now=Date.now(),resolved=identitySession_(ss,request.payload.tokenHash,now),at=new Date(now).toISOString();while(table.rows.some(function(r){return r.Revogado_Em===at;}))at=new Date(Date.parse(at)+1).toISOString();
 var p={kind:self?'SELF':'OTHERS',actor:resolved.principal.id,sessionId:resolved.principal.sessionId,cutoff:now,at:at};var targets=securitySessionTargets_(table,p);if(!targets.length)return {revoked:true};p.count=targets.length;p.idsHash=digest_(JSON.stringify(targets.map(function(r){return r.ID_Sessao;}).sort()));if(!self)id=securityId_(c,'REVOKE_OTHERS',[p.sessionId,p.idsHash]);
 var log=securityLog_(id,at,p.actor,resolved.principal.role,self?'IDENTITY_LOGOUT':'IDENTITY_SESSIONS_REVOKED',{revokedSessions:p.count});securityBegin_(c,{kind:'SESSIONS',plan:p,log:log});return {revoked:true};
}
function securityRecord_(request,c){
 recoverSecurityIntent_(c);securitySettle_(c);var p=request.payload;authControlExact_(p,['commandId','phase','code']);if(!identityUuid_(p.commandId)||!['START','RECOVER','LOGIN','EMAIL','PIN','OPTIONS','COMPLETE'].includes(p.phase)||!['CREDENTIALS_REJECTED','EMAIL_PROOF_REJECTED','PASSKEY_REJECTED','FLOW_REJECTED'].includes(p.code))failure_('SECURITY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE');var ss=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet,prior=identityRows_(ss,'Logs_Auditoria').rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Log===p.commandId;});if(prior.length){var expected=securityLog_(p.commandId,prior[0].Data_Hora,'SYSTEM_AUTH','SYSTEM','IDENTITY_ACCESS_DENIED',{phase:p.phase,code:p.code});securityAppend_(ss,expected);return {recorded:true};}
 securityAppend_(ss,securityLog_(p.commandId,new Date().toISOString(),'SYSTEM_AUTH','SYSTEM','IDENTITY_ACCESS_DENIED',{phase:p.phase,code:p.code}));return {recorded:true};
}

// BEGIN SessionStore.gs sha256=179859c2b00cee9b8801c8aed3c9f4e577e56fcddd4db747df7473fd390f2ed4
/* Persistent session reader/revoker. Internal functions only.
 * processRequest_ MUST hold ScriptLock and validate the signed envelope before
 * invoking identitySessionOperation_. No user/session creation or PIN storage.
 */
function identityUuid_(value) {
  return typeof value === 'string' && /^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/.test(value);
}
function identityRows_(spreadsheet, name) {
  var sheet = rpcSheet_(spreadsheet, name), lastRow = sheet ? sheet.getLastRow() : 0;
  var definition = LIVRARIA_SCHEMA.tables.filter(function (table) { return table.name === name; })[0];
  if (!sheet || !definition || !same_(rowValues_(sheet, lastRow), definition.columns) || lastRow > 5001) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
  var values = rpcRows_(sheet, lastRow, definition.columns.length);
  return { sheet: sheet, columns: definition.columns, rows: values.map(function (values, index) {
    var row = { number: index + 2 };
    definition.columns.forEach(function (column, columnIndex) { row[column] = values[columnIndex]; });
    return row;
  }) };
}
function identityTime_(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  var milliseconds = Date.parse(value);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(milliseconds) || new Date(milliseconds).toISOString() !== value) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  return milliseconds;
}
function identitySession_(spreadsheet, tokenHash, now) {
  recoverEmergencyRecovery_(baseSettings_());recoverKeyManagement_(baseSettings_());recoverSecurityIntent_(baseSettings_());recoverStaff_(baseSettings_());recoverProfiles_(baseSettings_());recoverRecoveryIntents_(baseSettings_());recoverEmailChanges_(baseSettings_());recoverNiches_(baseSettings_());recoverSchedules_(baseSettings_());
  var sessions = identityRows_(spreadsheet, 'Sessoes'), ids = new Set(), hashes = new Set();
  sessions.rows.forEach(function (row) {
    if (!identityUuid_(row.ID_Sessao) || !identityUuid_(row.ID_Usuario) || typeof row.Token_Hash !== 'string' ||
        !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(row.Token_Hash) || ids.has(row.ID_Sessao) || hashes.has(row.Token_Hash)) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    ids.add(row.ID_Sessao); hashes.add(row.Token_Hash);
  });
  var matches = sessions.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.Token_Hash === tokenHash; });
  if (matches.length !== 1) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  var session = matches[0];
  if (typeof session.Dispositivo === 'string' && session.Dispositivo.indexOf('identity-flow:') === 0) {
    var flowId = session.Dispositivo.slice(14), c = baseSettings_();
    var flows = accessFlows_(authControlStore_(c)).rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID === flowId; });
    if (flows.length !== 1 || flows[0].State !== 'COMPLETE' || flows[0].ID !== session.ID_Sessao ||
        flows[0].Subject_ID !== session.ID_Usuario || flows[0].Session_Token_Hash !== tokenHash ||
        (flows[0].Authorization_Version+(flows[0].Purpose==='RECOVER'?1:0)) !== session.Versao_Autorizacao) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  }
  if (session.Revogado_Em !== '' || !['pin', 'mfa', 'passkey'].includes(session.Nivel_Autenticacao) ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(session.Versao_Autorizacao) || session.Versao_Autorizacao < 1) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  var created = identityTime_(session.Criado_Em), expires = identityTime_(session.Expira_Em), activity = identityTime_(session.Ultima_Atividade);
  if (created > now || expires <= now || expires <= created || expires - created > 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000 ||
      activity < created || activity > now || now - activity > 30 * 60 * 1000) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  var users = identityRows_(spreadsheet, 'Usuarios');
  var userMatches = users.rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Usuario === session.ID_Usuario; });
  if (userMatches.length > 1) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
  if (userMatches.length !== 1) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  var user = userMatches[0];
  if (user.Status !== 'ATIVO' || user.Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido !== true ||
      !['ATENDENTE', 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(user.Perfil)) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  if (user.Perfil !== 'ATENDENTE' && !['mfa', 'passkey'].includes(session.Nivel_Autenticacao)) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  var versions = identityRows_(spreadsheet, 'Configuracoes').rows.filter(function (row) { return row.Chave === 'identity.version.' + user.ID_Usuario; });
  if (versions.length !== 1 || !Number.isSafeInteger(versions[0].Valor) || versions[0].Valor < 1) failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
  if (session.Versao_Autorizacao !== versions[0].Valor) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  return { sessions: sessions, session: session, activity: activity, principal: {
    id: user.ID_Usuario, sessionId: session.ID_Sessao, role: user.Perfil,
    assurance: session.Nivel_Autenticacao, authenticatedAt: created, expiresAt: expires,
    authorizationVersion: versions[0].Valor
  } };
}
function identitySessionOperation_(request, c) {
  if (!c || c.environment !== 'dev') failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  if (!request || !['identity.session.read', 'identity.session.revoke', 'identity.session.revokeOthers'].includes(request.action)) failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  var payload = request.payload;
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object' || Array.isArray(payload) || Object.keys(payload).length !== 1 ||
      typeof payload.tokenHash !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(payload.tokenHash)) failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');
  if(request.action!=='identity.session.read')return securityRevoke_(request,c);
  var spreadsheet = storage_(c, false).spreadsheet;
  var now = Date.now(), resolved = identitySession_(spreadsheet, payload.tokenHash, now);
  var table = resolved.sessions;
  if (request.action === 'identity.session.read') {
    // Reduce Sheets writes while keeping the idle window bounded and shared.
    if (now - resolved.activity >= 60 * 1000) {
      invalidateRpcRows_(table.sheet);
      table.sheet.getRange(resolved.session.number, table.columns.indexOf('Ultima_Atividade') + 1, 1, 1).setValues([[new Date(now).toISOString()]]);
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }
    return resolved.principal;
  }
}

;

// BEGIN Staff.gs sha256=ed3de536f84ff9a1b8ec421096d61d8a753b200aed49afd911176b413dab76b1
/* DEV staff management. Dispatcher owns ScriptLock. Contact data is AEAD-sealed
 * in Node; no plaintext personal fields, PINs or bearer tokens in this journal. */
function staffEnabled_() { return scriptProperties_().getProperty('STAFF_ENABLED') === 'true'; }
function staffFail_(code) { failure_(code || 'INVALID_STAFF'); }
function staffSealed_(value) { return typeof value === 'string' && value.length <= 16000 && /^pd1\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(value); }
function staffConfig_(ss, key) {
  var table = identityRows_(ss, 'Configuracoes'), rows = table.rows.filter(function (r) { return r.Chave === key; });
  if (rows.length > 1) staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE'); return { table: table, row: rows[0] };
}
function staffPut_(ss, key, value, at, actor) {
  var existing = staffConfig_(ss, key);
  if (existing.row && existing.row.Valor === value) return;
  accessSaveMain_(existing.table, { number: existing.row && existing.row.number, Chave:key, Valor:value, Atualizado_Em:at, Atualizado_Por:actor });
}
function staffRevision_(ss, id) {
  var row = staffConfig_(ss, 'staff.revision.' + id).row;
  if (!row) return 0;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(row.Valor) || row.Valor < 1) staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE'); return row.Valor;
}
function staffUsers_(ss) {
  var table = identityRows_(ss, 'Usuarios'), ids = new Set(), emails = new Set(), cpfs = new Set();
  table.rows.forEach(function (r) {
    if (!identityUuid_(r.ID_Usuario) || ids.has(r.ID_Usuario) || !['SUPER_ADMIN','ADMIN','ATENDENTE'].includes(r.Perfil) || !['ATIVO','INATIVO'].includes(r.Status) || typeof r.Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido !== 'boolean') staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE');
    ids.add(r.ID_Usuario);
    if (r.Nome === '' && r.Perfil === 'SUPER_ADMIN') return;
    if (!staffSealed_(r.Nome) || r.CPF !== '' || r.Email !== '' || r.Whatsapp !== '' || !accessHash_(r.CPF_Indice) || !accessHash_(r.Email_Indice) || cpfs.has(r.CPF_Indice) || emails.has(r.Email_Indice)) staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE');
    cpfs.add(r.CPF_Indice); emails.add(r.Email_Indice);
  }); return table;
}
function staffDto_(ss, r) {
  return { id:r.ID_Usuario, contact:r.Nome, role:r.Perfil, status:r.Status, activated:r.Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido,
    revision:staffRevision_(ss,r.ID_Usuario), createdAt:r.Criado_Em, lastAccess:r.Ultimo_Acesso };
}
function staffSubject_(c, id) {
  if (!staffEnabled_() || !identityUuid_(id) || id === scriptProperties_().getProperty('IDENTITY_OWNER_USER_ID')) return null;
  var ss=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet, users=staffUsers_(ss), found=users.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Usuario===id;}), epoch=staffConfig_(ss,'identity.version.'+id).row;
  if(found.length!==1||!epoch||!Number.isSafeInteger(epoch.Valor)||epoch.Valor<1||found[0].Status!=='ATIVO'||!['ATENDENTE','ADMIN'].includes(found[0].Perfil))return null;
  return {row:found[0],users:users,version:epoch.Valor};
}
function staffJournal_(ss) {
  return identityRows_(ss,'Configuracoes').rows.filter(function(r){return r.Chave.indexOf('staff.command.')===0;}).map(function(r){
    var v;try{v=JSON.parse(r.Valor);}catch(_){staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE');}
    if(!v||v.version!==1||!identityUuid_(v.commandId)||r.Chave!=='staff.command.'+v.commandId||!identityUuid_(v.id)||!identityUuid_(v.actor)||!['ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(v.role)||!['PENDING','COMPLETE'].includes(v.state)||!accessHash_(v.fingerprint)||!Array.isArray(v.after)||v.before!==null&&!Array.isArray(v.before)||!Number.isSafeInteger(v.revision)||v.revision<1||!Number.isSafeInteger(v.epoch)||v.epoch<1||!staffSealed_(v.reason))staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE');
    authControlTime_(v.at);var clone=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));delete clone.hash;delete clone.state;if(!constantEqual_(digest_(JSON.stringify(clone)),v.hash))staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE');
    return v;
  });
}
function staffProject_(ss,v) {
  var users=identityRows_(ss,'Usuarios'),columns=users.columns;
  if(v.after.length!==columns.length||v.before!==null&&v.before.length!==columns.length||v.after[columns.indexOf('ID_Usuario')]!==v.id||v.after[columns.indexOf('Perfil')]==='SUPER_ADMIN')staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE');
  var found=users.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Usuario===v.id;});
  if(found.length>1||!found.length&&v.before!==null)staffFail_('STAFF_CONFLICT');
  var values=found.length?columns.map(function(k){return found[0][k];}):null;
  if(!same_(values,v.before)&&!same_(values,v.after))staffFail_('STAFF_CONFLICT');
  // Epoch FIRST: no stale session can survive a partially applied disable/promotion.
  staffPut_(ss,'identity.version.'+v.id,v.epoch,v.at,v.actor);
  if(!same_(values,v.after)){var row={number:found.length?found[0].number:undefined};columns.forEach(function(k,i){row[k]=v.after[i];});accessSaveMain_(users,row);}
  staffPut_(ss,'staff.revision.'+v.id,v.revision,v.at,v.actor);
  var audit=identityRows_(ss,'Logs_Auditoria'),logged=audit.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Log===v.commandId;}),log={ID_Log:v.commandId,Data_Hora:v.at,ID_Usuario:v.actor,Perfil:v.role,
    Acao:v.before===null?'STAFF_CREATE':'STAFF_UPDATE',Entidade:'Usuarios',ID_Entidade:v.id,Antes:JSON.stringify({revision:v.revision-1}),Depois:JSON.stringify({revision:v.revision,role:v.after[columns.indexOf('Perfil')],status:v.after[columns.indexOf('Status')],reenrollmentRequired:v.reenrollmentRequired,reasonRecorded:true}),Resultado:'SUCESSO',ID_Requisicao:v.commandId};
  if(logged.length>1||logged.length&&!audit.columns.every(function(k){return logged[0][k]===log[k];}))staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE');
  if(!logged.length)accessSaveMain_(audit,log);
  v.state='COMPLETE';staffPut_(ss,'staff.command.'+v.commandId,JSON.stringify(v),v.at,v.actor);
}
function recoverStaff_(c) {
  var ss=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet,pending=staffJournal_(ss).filter(function(v){return v.state==='PENDING';});
  if(pending.length>1)staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE');pending.forEach(function(v){staffProject_(ss,v);});
}
function staffAdmin_(principal) {
  if(!['ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(principal.role)||!['mfa','passkey'].includes(principal.assurance)||Date.now()-principal.authenticatedAt>300000)failure_('FORBIDDEN');
}
function staffOperation_(request,c) {
  recoverStaff_(c);var ss=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet,p=request.payload;
  if(!request.actor||!accessHash_(request.actor.sessionTokenHash))failure_('UNAUTHENTICATED');

  if(request.action==='staff.list'||request.action==='staff.get'){

    else {authControlExact_(p,['id']);if(!identityUuid_(p.id))staffFail_();}

    var at=new Date().toISOString(),audit=identityRows_(ss,'Logs_Auditoria');if(audit.rows.length>=5000)staffFail_('STAFF_CAPACITY');

    if(request.action==='staff.get'){var found=users.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Usuario===p.id;});if(found.length!==1)staffFail_('STAFF_CONFLICT');return {user:staffDto_(ss,found[0])};}
    var sorted=users.rows.slice().sort(function(a,b){return String(a.Criado_Em).localeCompare(String(b.Criado_Em))||a.ID_Usuario.localeCompare(b.ID_Usuario);}),page=sorted.slice(p.offset,p.offset+25);
    return {users:page.map(function(r){return staffDto_(ss,r);}),total:sorted.length,nextOffset:p.offset+page.length<sorted.length?p.offset+page.length:null};
  }
  if(request.action!=='staff.save')failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  authControlExact_(p,['commandId','id','expectedRevision','reason','role','status','fingerprint','contact','emailIndex','cpfIndex','emailCheck']);
  if(!identityUuid_(p.commandId)||!identityUuid_(p.id)||!Number.isSafeInteger(p.expectedRevision)||p.expectedRevision<0||p.expectedRevision>1000000||!['ATENDENTE','ADMIN'].includes(p.role)||!['ATIVO','INATIVO'].includes(p.status)||!staffSealed_(p.contact)||!staffSealed_(p.reason)||![p.fingerprint,p.emailIndex,p.cpfIndex,p.emailCheck].every(accessHash_))staffFail_();
  if([digest_(accessEmail_(c.owner)),digest_(ownerLoginEmail_(c))].includes(p.emailCheck))staffFail_('STAFF_EMAIL_DUPLICATE');
  var prior=staffJournal_(ss).filter(function(v){return v.commandId===p.commandId;});
  if(prior.length){var v=prior[0];if(v.fingerprint!==p.fingerprint||v.actor!==principal.id||v.id!==p.id)staffFail_('STAFF_CONFLICT');return {id:v.id,revision:v.revision,reenrollmentRequired:v.reenrollmentRequired};}
  var found=users.rows.filter(function(r){return r.ID_Usuario===p.id;}),old=found[0];
  if(principal.id===p.id||old&&old.Perfil==='SUPER_ADMIN'||(p.role==='ADMIN'||old&&old.Perfil==='ADMIN')&&principal.role!=='SUPER_ADMIN')failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  if(staffRevision_(ss,p.id)!==p.expectedRevision||!old&&p.expectedRevision!==0)staffFail_('STAFF_CONFLICT');
  if(users.rows.some(function(r){return r.ID_Usuario!==p.id&&r.CPF_Indice===p.cpfIndex;}))staffFail_('STAFF_CPF_DUPLICATE');
  if(users.rows.some(function(r){return r.ID_Usuario!==p.id&&r.Email_Indice===p.emailIndex;}))staffFail_('STAFF_EMAIL_DUPLICATE');
  var epoch=staffConfig_(ss,'identity.version.'+p.id).row;if(old&&!epoch||!old&&epoch)staffFail_('STAFF_UNAVAILABLE');
  var reset=!old||old.Email_Indice!==p.emailIndex||old.CPF_Indice!==p.cpfIndex||old.Perfil!==p.role||old.Status!==p.status;
  if(old&&old.CPF_Indice!==p.cpfIndex&&principal.role!=='SUPER_ADMIN')failure_('FORBIDDEN');
  var at=new Date().toISOString(),row=old?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(old)):{ID_Usuario:p.id,Criado_Por:principal.id,Criado_Em:at,Foto_Perfil_Drive_ID:'',Ultimo_Acesso:''};
  row.Nome=p.contact;row.CPF='';row.Email='';row.Whatsapp='';row.Email_Indice=p.emailIndex;row.CPF_Indice=p.cpfIndex;row.Perfil=p.role;row.Status=p.status;
  row.Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido=reset?false:old.Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido;
  var configs=identityRows_(ss,'Configuracoes'),audit=identityRows_(ss,'Logs_Auditoria');
  if(configs.rows.length+3>5000||audit.rows.length>=5000||!old&&users.rows.length>=5000||staffJournal_(ss).length>=1000)staffFail_('STAFF_CAPACITY');
  var v={version:1,commandId:p.commandId,id:p.id,actor:principal.id,role:principal.role,state:'PENDING',fingerprint:p.fingerprint,reason:p.reason,at:at,revision:p.expectedRevision+1,epoch:old?epoch.Valor+(reset?1:0):1,reenrollmentRequired:reset,
    before:old?users.columns.map(function(k){return old[k];}):null,after:users.columns.map(function(k){return row[k]===undefined?'':row[k];})};
  var clone=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));delete clone.state;v.hash=digest_(JSON.stringify(clone));
  staffPut_(ss,'staff.command.'+p.commandId,JSON.stringify(v),at,principal.id);staffProject_(ss,v);
  return {id:p.id,revision:v.revision,reenrollmentRequired:reset};
}
function staffAccessOperation_(request,c) {
  recoverStaff_(c);recoverProfiles_(c);recoverRecoveryIntents_(c);recoverEmailChanges_(c);var p=request.payload,ss=authControlStore_(c),main=storage_(c,false).spreadsheet,now=Date.now();
  if(request.action==='identity.staffAccess.lookup'){
    authControlExact_(p,['emailIndex','cpfIndex']);if(p.emailIndex!==''&&!accessHash_(p.emailIndex)||p.cpfIndex!==''&&!accessHash_(p.cpfIndex)||!p.emailIndex&&!p.cpfIndex)accessReject_();
    var matches=staffUsers_(main).rows.filter(function(r){return p.emailIndex&&r.Email_Indice===p.emailIndex||p.cpfIndex&&r.CPF_Indice===p.cpfIndex;});
    if(matches.length!==1)return {account:null};var subject=staffSubject_(c,matches[0].ID_Usuario);if(!subject)return {account:null};
    var pins=accessPins_(ss).rows.filter(function(r){return r.Subject_ID===subject.row.ID_Usuario&&r.Authorization_Version===subject.version;});
    return {account:{subjectId:subject.row.ID_Usuario,authorizationVersion:subject.version,contact:subject.row.Nome,activated:subject.row.Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido,
      record:subject.row.Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido&&pins.length===1?accessPinRecord_(pins[0].Record_JSON):null}};
  }
  if(['identity.staffAccess.start','identity.staffAccess.recover'].includes(request.action)){
    var recovery=request.action==='identity.staffAccess.recover',purpose=recovery?'RECOVER':'ACTIVATE';if(recovery&&!recoveryEnabled_())failure_('IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE');
    authControlExact_(p,['subjectId','contactHash','delivery','flowId','tokenHash','codeHash','code']);
    if(!accessHash_(p.contactHash)||!accessHash_(p.codeHash)||!accessDeliveryCode_(p.code))accessReject_();if([accessEmail_(c.owner),ownerLoginEmail_(c)].includes(accessEmail_(p.delivery)))accessReject_();
    var subject=staffSubject_(c,p.subjectId),table=accessFlows_(ss);
    if(!recovery&&subject&&subject.row.Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido&&digest_(subject.row.Nome)===p.contactHash)return {accepted:true,outcome:'ALREADY_ACTIVE'};
    if(!subject||subject.row.Primeiro_Acesso_Concluido!==recovery||digest_(subject.row.Nome)!==p.contactHash)subject=null;
    if(!recovery&&!subject)return {accepted:true,outcome:'NOT_FOUND'};
    if(subject&&table.rows.some(function(r){return r.Subject_ID===subject.row.ID_Usuario&&now-authControlTime_(r.Created_At)<60000;})){if(!recovery)return {accepted:true,outcome:'THROTTLED'};subject=null;}
    if(subject)table.rows.filter(function(r){return r.Subject_ID===subject.row.ID_Usuario&&!['COMMITTING','COMPLETE','REVOKED'].includes(r.State);}).forEach(function(r){r.State='REVOKED';authControlSave_(table,r);});
    var flow=accessNewFlow_(table,p,subject,purpose,now);
    if(subject){try{if(MailApp.getRemainingDailyQuota()<1)throw Error('QUOTA');MailApp.sendEmail({to:p.delivery,subject:'Livraria IPB DEV — confirmar acesso',body:'Foi solicitado acesso à sua conta na Livraria IPB DEV.\n\nCódigo de uso único (10 minutos):\n'+p.code+'\n\nUse somente em https://dev--merry-chimera-49a1f3.netlify.app/acesso-dev.html\nSe não solicitou, ignore. Não compartilhe o código.'});}catch(_){flow.State='REVOKED';authControlSave_(accessFlows_(ss),flow);if(!recovery)return {accepted:true,outcome:'DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE'};}}
    return recovery?{accepted:true}:{accepted:true,outcome:'SENT'};
  }
  failure_('FORBIDDEN');
}

// BEGIN Stock.gs sha256=4f59fb9c06c6408cfa721f2b5ce172b4a664e337b5ee1e9db872f7b1a448fb55
/* Positive stock receipts and metadata-aware inventory checkpoints.
 * All entry points execute under the same installation ScriptLock as sales. */
function stockCommand_(p) {
  if (!p || typeof p !== 'object' || Array.isArray(p) || !same_(Object.keys(p).sort(), ['commandId', 'expectedVersion', 'id', 'quantity', 'reason']) ||
      !saleUuid_(p.commandId) || !saleUuid_(p.id) || !Number.isSafeInteger(p.expectedVersion) || p.expectedVersion < 1 || p.expectedVersion >= 1000000000 ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(p.quantity) || p.quantity < 1 || p.quantity > 1000000 || typeof p.reason !== 'string' || !p.reason || p.reason !== p.reason.trim() ||
      p.reason.length > 300 || /[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(p.reason) || /^[=+@-]/.test(p.reason)) failure_('INVALID_STOCK_RECEIPT');
  return { commandId: p.commandId, id: p.id, expectedVersion: p.expectedVersion, quantity: p.quantity, reason: p.reason };
}
function validateStockEvent_(event, row) {
  var receipt = event && event.receipt;
  if (!event || event.type !== 'STOCK_RECEIVED' || event.version !== 1 || !saleUuid_(event.actorId) || !['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'ATENDENTE'].includes(event.actorRole) ||
      !receipt || receipt.commandId !== event.idempotencyKey || !saleInteger_(receipt.stockBefore) || !saleInteger_(receipt.stockAfter) || receipt.stockAfter > 1000000 ||
      receipt.stockAfter !== receipt.stockBefore + receipt.quantity || !Number.isSafeInteger(receipt.version) ||
      typeof receipt.createdAt !== 'string' || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(receipt.createdAt))) failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
  var command;
  try { command = stockCommand_({ commandId: receipt.commandId, id: receipt.id, expectedVersion: receipt.version - 1, quantity: receipt.quantity, reason: event.reason }); }
  catch (_) { failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID'); }
  if (event.commandHash !== digest_(JSON.stringify(command)) || row.ID_Evento !== event.idempotencyKey || row.Chave_Idempotencia !== event.idempotencyKey || row.Tipo !== event.type ||
      row.Hash_Comando !== event.commandHash || row.Versao_Esquema !== 1 || row.Criado_Em !== receipt.createdAt || row.Estado_Projecao !== 'PENDENTE') failure_('JOURNAL_INVALID');
}
function receiveStock_(request, c, principal, ss) {
  var command = stockCommand_(request.payload), hash = digest_(JSON.stringify(command)), journal = saleTable_(ss, '_Eventos_Dominio');
  var prior = saleObjects_(journal).filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Evento === command.commandId; });
  if (prior.length) {
    var event = JSON.parse(prior[0].Conteudo_JSON);
    if (prior.length !== 1 || event.type !== 'STOCK_RECEIVED' || event.actorId !== principal.id || event.commandHash !== hash) failure_('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
    return event.receipt;
  }
  var audit = saleTable_(ss, 'Logs_Auditoria');
  if (journal.rows.length >= 2000 || audit.rows.length >= 5000) failure_('JOURNAL_CAPACITY');
  if (saleObjects_(audit).some(function (row) { return row.ID_Log === command.commandId; }) || catalogJournal_(c).rows.some(function (row) { return row.Command_ID === command.commandId; })) failure_('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
  var product = catalogProducts_(ss).rows.filter(function (row) { return row.ID_Produto === command.id; })[0];
  if (!product || !product.Ativo) failure_('PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE');
  if (product.Versao_Registro !== command.expectedVersion) catalogFail_('CATALOG_CONFLICT');
  var stockAfter = product.Estoque_Atual + command.quantity;
  if (!saleInteger_(stockAfter) || stockAfter > 1000000) failure_('STOCK_LIMIT');
  var receipt = { commandId: command.commandId, id: command.id, quantity: command.quantity, version: command.expectedVersion + 1,
    stockBefore: product.Estoque_Atual, stockAfter: stockAfter, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  var event = { type: 'STOCK_RECEIVED', version: 1, idempotencyKey: command.commandId, commandHash: hash, actorId: principal.id, actorRole: principal.role, reason: command.reason, receipt: receipt };
  var values = { ID_Evento: command.commandId, Tipo: event.type, Chave_Idempotencia: command.commandId, Hash_Comando: hash, Conteudo_JSON: JSON.stringify(event),
    Estado_Projecao: 'PENDENTE', Criado_Em: receipt.createdAt, Versao_Esquema: 1 };
  validateStockEvent_(event, values);
  journal.sheet.appendRow(journal.columns.map(function (key) { return values[key]; })); SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  recoverSales_(ss); return receipt;
}
function inventoryChains_(ss, products, byId, transitions) {
  var floors = {}, latestMetadata = {}, chains = {};
  Object.keys(transitions).forEach(function (id) { floors[id] = Math.min.apply(null, transitions[id].map(function (point) { return point.version; })); });
  if (Object.keys(floors).length && scriptProperties_().getProperty('CATALOG_JOURNAL_ID')) {
    var c = baseSettings_(), journal = catalogJournal_(c);
    journal.rows.forEach(function (row) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(floors, row.Product_ID) || row.Expected_Version < floors[row.Product_ID]) return;
      if (row.State !== 'COMPLETE') failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');
      var intent = catalogIntent_(c, row, products.columns), after = intent.desired;
      if (!intent.before) failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');
      var beforeStock = intent.before.values[products.columns.indexOf('Estoque_Atual')];
      if (beforeStock !== after.Estoque_Atual) failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');
      transitions[row.Product_ID].push({ version: row.Expected_Version, before: beforeStock, after: after.Estoque_Atual });
      if (!latestMetadata[row.Product_ID] || after.Versao_Registro > latestMetadata[row.Product_ID].Versao_Registro) latestMetadata[row.Product_ID] = after;
    });
  }
  Object.keys(transitions).forEach(function (id) {
    var steps = transitions[id].sort(function (a, b) { return a.version - b.version; }), product = byId[id];
    if (!product || !saleInteger_(product.Estoque_Atual) || !saleInteger_(product.Versao_Registro)) failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');
    var chain = [{ version: steps[0].version, stock: steps[0].before }];
    steps.forEach(function (step) {
      var last = chain[chain.length - 1];
      if (last.version !== step.version || last.stock !== step.before) failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');
      chain.push({ version: step.version + 1, stock: step.after });
    });
    var metadata = latestMetadata[id];
    // COMPLETE metadata must already be present; inventory recovery may never
    // manufacture a metadata version or restore an old title/photo/status.
    if (metadata && (product.Versao_Registro < metadata.Versao_Registro || products.columns.some(function (key) {
      return !['Estoque_Atual', 'Versao_Registro'].includes(key) && product[key] !== metadata[key];
    }))) failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');
    if (!chain.some(function (point) { return point.version === product.Versao_Registro && point.stock === product.Estoque_Atual; })) failure_('PROJECTION_CONFLICT');
    chains[id] = chain;
  });
  return chains;
}

;
// END Stock.gs
